## Project purpose and collaboration

The long-term vision is a Borderlands Ultimate Vault Hunter Collection spanning multiple main games, Vault Hunters, expanded skills, shared progression, inventory/currency systems and co-op. The immediate playable work is much narrower: **Borderlands 2, Gaige, one independent skill-tree node called Deathtrap Overclock**, eventually granting +15 seconds to Deathtrap when purchased.

The original request at the start of this visible development sequence was:

> Read AGENTS.md and START_IN_CODEX.md. Continue developing our Borderlands Ultimate Vault Hunter Collection project from v0.1.7, focusing on getting Deathtrap Overclock to appear in Gaige's native skill tree. Follow the documented testing and safety requirements.

That visibility objective is now met. The owner prefers downloadable folder-install ZIPs and concise, sequential game instructions. They recently asked, “can we start doing more tests at once”. v0.2.11 therefore combines three related read-only metadata checks in one explicit menu action and one fresh game session. This request did not authorize additional purchases or automatic gameplay effects.

The early design code in archive/early_design_source is an independent model prototype. Its sheets discuss five games, level milestones 60/120/180/240/300, expanded skill branches and a large roster. Those are historical design records, not verified currently available content, playable character ports, or an implemented cross-engine bridge. Do not confuse those systems or their tests with the BL2 runtime.

Development collaboration with the friend is separate from in-game multiplayer. Co-op gameplay remains untested and outside the present experiment.

## Safety and authorization

The project requirements are recorded in AGENTS.md and reproduced completely in the appendices.

1. Preserve the real-game-tested manual duration prototype and visible-node baseline.
2. Use a new independently named SkillDefinition. Do not overwrite MorePep or Myelin.
3. Run experiments only with already backed-up Gaige alone, Offline, in a fresh BL2 process.
4. ARM is an explicit menu action at main menu before Continue. No automatic invasive hooks on import.
5. Validate exact ownership, native assets, runtime references, named networking mode and both player rosters. Missing/loading/foreign data fails closed.
6. Snapshot before native-array writes. Restore only matching owned changes. Preserve independent edits and retain failed snapshots.
7. CANCEL restores native definitions/arrays, not points, purchased grades, save files, or engine/player/UI caches. Restart after every armed test.
8. Do not spend points, respec, travel, apply the manual boost, or start other observers during the current read-only test.
9. Do not call eligibility/cost/purchase/save functions to force diagnostic data. Do not reinterpret unknown output wrappers or metadata as a known signature.
10. New code needs appropriate meaningful mocks, syntax, AST scope checks, inert isolated import and exact package integrity/layout/source checks before a user test.
11. No automatic effects, point/grade/save writes, persistence/co-op/release tests without separate user scope and recovery planning.
12. Distinguish simulated results, direct engine log evidence, user observations and hypotheses. A wrapper or class refusal is not known absence or a broken skill.
13. Keep private backups outside the project. Never parse, restore or package them as part of the diagnostic.
14. Never include original game assets, extracted proprietary binaries or SDK components in the install ZIP.
15. Keep original versioned ZIPs unchanged. Documentation-only reviews may rebuild the default ZIP after preserving the original tested README.
16. Preserve each new game log before a relaunch can replace it.

The owner's one-point purchase report is useful evidence but is not blanket authorization for more purchases, automated purchase helpers, or an effect implementation.

## Runtime architecture

The current runtime is one __init__.py plus pyproject.toml and README.txt. It registers one mods_base.build_mod with Game.BL2, CoopSupport.ClientSide, version0.2.11, auto_enable=True and on_disable=shutdown. Import is inert: factory registration does not install hooks, resolve game objects, load packages, construct a node, spend points or alter gameplay.

There are 19 options. The generated menu table below gives exact labels, identifiers and callbacks. Menu numbers are labels, not keyboard hotkeys.

### Manual duration prototype

find_live locates the owner's active Skill_DeathTrap instance through the skill manager's ActiveSkills and definition name. Pawn.MyActionSkill is not the object on which the working Duration field was found.

apply validates approximately60.0 for both Duration and DurationBaseValue, zero/known duration modifiers, and a maximum duration safety cap180.0. It writes only the live active instance's Duration to75.0, reads it back, and attempts immediate rollback if the write is not verified. DurationBaseValue is not changed. A per-summon signature/record prevents stacking; repeated apply for the same summon does not keep adding15 seconds.

restore touches only the original still-active matching summon and only if its current duration still matches the owned modified value. Independent changes are not overwritten. A stale summon record is cleared without modifying another skill.

The v0.1.1 log verifies60->75, and the user reported longer summon duration. This is not a stopwatch study and is separate from the node's inactive effect. shutdown calls stop_tree_trace and cancel_init_node; it does not call the manual duration restore function. The explicit manual restore option remains available.

### Native candidate and pre-initialization insertion

Candidate name: UVH_DeathtrapOverclock. Display name: Deathtrap Overclock. MaxGrade1, DefaultStartingGrade0, bSubjectToGradeRules=True. Static description:

“Prototype: Extends Deathtrap duration by 15 seconds. (Not active in this node test.)”

_node_make_candidate uses a valid loaded outer associated with MorePep or the branch, refuses an existing candidate name rather than overwriting it, constructs SkillDefinition, checks empty effect/activation/deactivation arrays, sets only the listed candidate metadata, and borrows a native icon from MorePep. It does not copy active effects or skill actions. Constraints were observed empty in the diagnostics; do not infer automatic gameplay semantics from defaults.

The proven method arms PRE and POST_UNCONDITIONAL observers for WillowGame.PlayerSkillTree:Initialize. PRE validates Gaige's exact top-level SkillTreeDefinition argument, the current controller/tree, known pristine branch/layout and solo session. It inserts the independent candidate into first-tier native definitions before the engine initializes the player's flattened runtime lists. The native engine builds cache/index state; the mod does not rewrite SkillDefinitionToIndex or other player caches.

POST rechecks session evidence, runtime registration and both originals, then removes initialization observers. Failed verification rolls back owned native arrays. Cancellation/disable removes all observer families before restoring owned native changes. Failed hook removals stay inert and retained for retry, and block overlapping diagnostics.

Native arrays after insertion: [MorePep, UVH_DeathtrapOverclock, Myelin] and cells [True, True, True]. After verified restoration: [MorePep, Myelin] and [True, False, True].

The live successful tree repeatedly contained39 registered skills, node index14, MorePep index13, Myelin index15, node ParentTierIndex7 and grade0. Little Big Trouble's runtime branch was2 with TierIndices7..12. Runtime branches/tiers/skills are flattened; do not treat them as the nested asset definitions.

The old in-map insertion changed native definitions but did not show the node. PRE insertion did show it. UI caching is a plausible explanation of the earlier failure, not a proven root cause.

### Solo and unchanged-state guards

_init_solo_session resolves named ENetMode.NM_Standalone/NM_ListenServer, requires exactly one ENGINE.GamePlayers entry whose Actor is pc, and exactly one WorldInfo.GRI.PRIArray entry equal to pc.PlayerReplicationInfo with Owner==pc. Numeric NetMode2 alone is insufficient. Clients, dedicated servers, peers, missing/loading data and mismatched ownership refuse.

_upgrade_state is reused unchanged by the later read-only diagnostics. It verifies:

- Same current pc, Gaige PlayerClass, non-null same pawn, owned PlayerSkillTree and recorded init_tree.
- Same WorldInfo and PRI, supported named mode, both sole-player rosters still owned.
- Same owned native first-tier patch, candidate metadata and empty gameplay action/effect arrays.
- Runtime skills3..256, tiers1..64, branches1..16.
- Exactly one target branch; bounded tier indices; known first tier and current references.
- Exactly one runtime entry for each of node/MorePep/Myelin, correct owner/index/current array element/parent tier and membership.
- Exact known nonnegative grades/PRI points; candidate must remain grade0.
- Same (points, ranks, runtime indices, tier index) as the per-call baseline.

Definition/rank order in this baseline is Overclock, MorePep, Myelin. PRI point tuple order is GeneralSkillPoints, SpecialistSkillPoints. Unexpected changes abort observation without refunds or repair.

### Older opt-in observer families

These remain in the current code for preservation and future separately scoped diagnostics. They are not part of the pending item4 test.

- Upgrade: two POST observers of normally occurring CanUpgradeSkill/GetSkillUpgradeCost,24 captures,2048 callback attempts, two copies per result,90-second expiry checked on calls. Eligibility ret is the SDK ESkillTreeFailureReason enum, not Boolean. Cost must be exact nonnegative int. No forced calls.
- Core UI: at most10 discovered loaded functions, PRE and POST_UNCONDITIONAL observations,48 events/2048 attempts/two copies/90-second call-checked expiry. Excludes artifact/equip helpers; prioritizes discovered core navigation/input/info/point-display helpers. Reads current/rollover separately and requires owned exact UI/WPCOwner. Metadata does not authorize invocation.
- Focused state: three POST observers for PlayerSkillTree:GetSkillState, SkillTreeGFxObject:GetSkillDescriptionForGrade and UpdateInfoBox. Uses actual native ret, not copied OutSkillState or locals. Per-function/skill quotas prevent unrelated navigation traffic consuming the entire budget. Four captures per bucket/two per distinct result, total<=36 captures within48-event/2048-attempt/90-second limits.
- Loading/init discovery: legacy read-only loading diagnostics and bounded init observers are retained. Some earlier helper functions are no longer exposed as menu options.

Expiry is checked on a subsequent callback, not a background timer. Always use explicit STOP/CANCEL even if no native calls occur. Clearing capture context precedes hook removal; failures are retained inert. POST_UNCONDITIONAL records do not prove the native function executed if another hook blocked it. A returned value can reflect another hook's override.

### Presentation diagnostics v0.2.8–v0.2.10

The older inspectors remain callable in source; item4 now routes only the new v0.2.11 inspector.

_presentation_metadata validates loaded SkillDefinition.SkillEffectPresentations array metadata, exact name/owner, ArrayProperty/ObjectProperty inner, declared actual AttributePresentationDefinition UClass, dimension1, bounded flags/offsets and no parameter/out/return bits. It does not infer WrappedArray._type behavior.

v0.2.8 reads actual WrappedArray counts<=256, samples<=4 actual exact-class SDK UObject references per skill, bounded paths<=384 and at most16 raw class property descriptors plus bounded lookahead. Empty is distinct from unavailable; metadata completeness is separate from array coverage.

v0.2.9 adds four observed StrProperty reads: Description68, NoConstraintText80, Prefix104, Suffix92, flags4227075, dimension1, exact owner. Payload must be exact str, output clipped512 and escaped. It never evaluates $NUMBER$, HTML or formatting APIs.

v0.2.10 adds the three fixed BoolProperty flags and Attribute ObjectProperty identity/known absence. Descriptor flags3, dim1, Boolean offset116, Attribute offset64, declared actual UClass/name AttributeDefinition. Payload Boolean must be exact bool. None is known absence. A present Attribute must be SDK UObject with Class exactly identical to the declared class before its bounded SDK path is read. That exact-class compatibility helper is deliberately unchanged in v0.2.11.

_presentation_text_reference verifies current baseline state, target/reference class, fresh loaded root metadata, actual current array length, sampled membership and class around reads. Accepted typed Attribute identities/schema are checked around paths. Initial unknown fields are UNAVAILABLE; changing state or references abort before further reads/logging. There are no copies, overrides, gameplay values or formatting calls.

### v0.2.11 combined diagnostic

Four new functions:

- _attribute_class_identity: requires real SDK UClass before reading exact str Name<=96 and class path<=384.
- _attribute_class_reference: revalidates current presentation, Attribute descriptor/field, same SDK object or identical unknown-wrapper/None reference, actual class identity, presentation path and state.
- _attribute_class_ancestry: walks at most8 actual SDK UClass nodes using documented SuperField; detects cycles and distinguishes complete root, capped chain or unavailable metadata. Revalidates captured names/paths/parent links before returning records.
- inspect_overclock_attribute_class: one explicit synchronous item4 pass for current Myelin presentation index1 only, with exact previously observed shield-capacity presentation path and array count2..256.

Unknown wrappers/classes are never coerced, repr'd or traversed. Known None is absence. No Attribute object path is read by this new diagnostic; only presentation and loaded class metadata paths. Matching names do not prove inheritance.

Ancestry statuses: COMPLETE, CAPPED, CYCLE, UNAVAILABLE; known absence uses NOT_APPLICABLE. Declared relationships: EXACT, DERIVED, NO, UNKNOWN. DERIVED requires exact declared UClass identity in verified links; NO requires a complete chain without that identity. A capped chain can prove DERIVED within the observed prefix while still having incomplete coverage. Cycles/unknown metadata do not establish a compatibility rule.

The one field may be read up to39 times including validation guards; this is not39 separate tests. No other presentations' flags/text/Attribute values are rechecked just to repeat completed results. Reused [UVH-PRESENT] SCHEMA messages are fresh schema/membership checks, not independent captures.

Initial getter errors log UNAVAILABLE then abort without stringifying potentially unknown getter exceptions. Stable unknown metadata can produce partial records and FINAL unchanged. Changed/unknown current state aborts, does not repair/refund, and does not log a successful FINAL comparison.

AST proof: of80 prior functions,73 identical and seven change only diagnostic version strings. Four new helpers/inspector; non-function module state unchanged except factory. The seven label-only functions are inspect_overclock_purchase, start_upgrade_trace, start_ui_trace, start_skillstate_trace, inspect_overclock_presentations, inspect_overclock_presentation_text, inspect_overclock_presentation_display. Two old version assertions and one factory-route assertion were updated; prior test behavior retained.

## Purchase report and conversation details

Exact owner report:

> done i spent a point in the overclock skill and it went to 1 of 1 i alt f4'd to not save restarted and did it your way just to give you some extra data

Treat this as positive user-observed purchase/rank1/1 in an earlier process. The retained current log begins after restart and has one unspent point/grade0 at every captured snapshot. ## Collaboration procedure

These are practical coordination suggestions for the owner and friend, not a statement that the unspecified plugin implements them.

- Share this handoff and the actual project workspace/required original ZIPs if exact binaries are needed. The handoff contains source text, not byte-identical archive or PNG files.
- Assign one person to current runtime edits, another to an independently reviewable task such as reading a preserved log or reviewing tests. Agree on files before concurrent edits.
- Keep one person responsible for installation and one game test session/log capture at a time. Label every session by exact version/title and proposed checks.
- Have the friend read the current-status overview, AGENTS, START_IN_CODEX, NEXT_CODEX_TASK andv031 plan before making changes.
- Avoid simultaneous rebuilds of the defaultZIP or editing a version currently under live test.
- Compare source/ZIP hashes before combining edits or interpreting a friend's result. Keep simulated results separate from actual logs/screenshots.
- If the plugin stores source in Git or moves it to another machine, keep original tested packages/evidence intact and adapt local paths. There is no existing Git remote/PR to continue in this snapshot.
- Agree explicitly before using the plugin to send messages, synchronize saves, write game files, publish releases or alter test scope. No such action is represented by this exported file.
- Keep short owner-facing instructions. Menu numbers are not keyboard presses; ask for no hovering unless a specific observer test needs it. Current synchronous metadata test needs no hovering.

The early design archive's MIT LICENSE is included as retained text. Do not infer that game assets, SDK distribution, a plugin, or all future runtime code have the same license merely because that archived model does. No release or Melty listing has been published in the preserved state.

### Screenshot reference

Preserved file: evidence/v028_overclock_user_screenshot.png. Its hash/size are in the file inventory. The documented screenshot shows native Deathtrap Overclock0/1, one skill point, blue title, inactive prototype description and [Enter]Spend Point. The owner did not select item4 in that first run. Its presence proves neither a captured purchase transaction nor an active duration effect. PNG bytes are not embedded in this Markdown; obtain the preserved PNG from the workspace if needed.

```markdown
# Codex instructions for the Ultimate Vault Hunter Collection

## Goals and priorities

1. Focus on a reliable **Borderlands 2 / Gaige skill-tree extension**, not the enormous cross-game vision yet.
2. Preserve the **actually game-tested** manual Deathtrap +15s prototype until an improved replacement has been verified.
3. Prototype a **new**, independently named `SkillDefinition` for "Deathtrap Overclock"; do not silently overwrite an existing Gaige skill or mutate the save.
4. Preserve v0.2.1 as the **first user-confirmed visible native node**. Its real log verifies pre-initialization insertion, runtime registration and native-array rollback. The original visibility objective is met for this solo test; a one-point purchase to1/1 is now user-reported (v0.2.10), while controlled transaction/save verification, persistence and the node's +15-second effect remain later milestones.

## Environment / packaging

- Windows PC, Borderlands 2 on Steam, SDK mods live under `Borderlands 2\sdk_mods`.
- `unrealsdk v3.2.0`, `pyunrealsdk v1.10.0`, Willow2 PythonSDK; Python in-game imports `mods_base`, `unrealsdk`.
- Install convention: build a ZIP with ONE `UltimateVaultHunterDeathtrapBoost/` folder containing `__init__.py`, `pyproject.toml`, README; user deletes/replaces the existing folder and restarts BL2. Keep one installed project mod, not many test mods.
- A mock test's success cannot establish real-engine behavior. Log fields may be SDK wrapper types (`WrappedArray`, `WrappedStruct`) and methods may behave differently in engine.

## Critical verified findings

- User reported Gaige Deathtrap lasted longer after setting **live active skill instance** `Skill_DeathTrap.Duration: 60.0 -> 75.0` while summoned; original `DurationBaseValue=60.0` remained unchanged. See `evidence/v011_duration_write_verified.log`. User's lifespan observation is conversational feedback, not stopwatch measurement.
- The action skill object `Pawn.MyActionSkill` is NOT where the working Duration field was found; actual active object lives in `pc.GetSkillManager().ActiveSkills` where `Definition.Name == 'Skill_DeathTrap'`.
- Gaige `PlayerClass.SkillTreePath = GD_Tulip_Mechro_Streaming.SkillTree.SkillTree_Mechromancer`. v0.1.8 found this top-level definition briefly at main menu, then it became inaccessible; in-map lookups found no top-level tree. Do not assume continuous asset availability or a confirmed garbage-collection cause.
- In-game Gaige branch object `GD_Tulip_Mechromancer_Skills.SkillTrees.Branch_LittleBigTrouble` and its `Layout_LittleBigTrouble` are accessible. Six tiers. Tier 0 original skills `MorePep`, `Myelin`, with occupancy `[True, False, True]`.
- v0.1.6 created a new `SkillDefinition` via `unrealsdk.construct_object`, reported the native Tier0 `[MorePep, DeathtrapOverclock, Myelin]` and layout `[True,True,True]`, but the user explicitly reported **NO visible skill-tree node**. Do not claim success based only on `INSERT VERIFIED` log.
- Tier 4 has two skills but occupancy `[False,True,False]` in one read; don't generalize that every tier's layout occupancy mirrors the skills array.
- v0.1.7 real log: three main-menu attempts returned no accessible branch/layout and aborted without insertion. See `evidence/v017_main_menu_assets_unavailable.log`. This does not test the UI caching hypothesis.
- v0.1.8 real snapshots found native assets briefly at menu, missing two seconds later, and branch/layout plus `pc.PlayerSkillTree` (class `PlayerSkillTree`) in Gaige's map. Trace found zero candidates, registered no observers and captured no calls. See `evidence/v018_assets_transient_playerskilltree_found.log`.
- v0.1.9 real trace registered 16 observers, captured 20 events and removed all observers. At `WillowGame.PlayerSkillTree:Initialize` PRE, Gaige's controller had no pawn, the native assets and exact `args.SkillTreeDef` were available, and `obj.Branches` was empty. POST had four branches. Later UI calls included `InitializeGFxHelper` and `SkillTreeGFxObject:extInitTree`. See `evidence/v019_live_tree_and_init_trace.log`. No node was inserted in that run.
- v0.2.0 real log: the Gaige PRE callback reported `NetMode=2` and aborted because the old guard required numeric 0. No candidate construction or insertion occurred; all observers were removed. The user reported no visible node. See `evidence/v020_netmode_guard_aborted_no_insertion.log`. This run did not test cache/UI insertion and does not establish whether any other player was connected.
- v0.2.1 real game: user reported **"done it worked!"** after the requested visibility test. PRE verified listen_host (`NetMode=2`), one owned local player and one owned roster player. One inert candidate entered the engine's 39-skill runtime tree at index 14/tier 7, grade 0; both original first-tier skills remained. All observers were removed. CANCEL verified original arrays restored. See `evidence/v021_native_node_visible_and_restored.log` and `evidence/v021_visibility_confirmation.md`. This confirms visible-node success in one solo run; it does not establish purchases, persistence, effects or co-op behavior.
- The v0.2.1 guard accepts SDK-named Standalone/ListenServer only when `ENGINE.GamePlayers` contains exactly one local player owning the current controller and `WorldInfo.GRI.PRIArray` contains exactly its owned PRI. Missing/loading data, extra players, clients and dedicated servers fail closed. Recheck after initialization; do not bypass failed evidence. Run Offline. Snapshot rollback restores native arrays, never manually rewrites player caches/indices; restart BL2 after every test. Preserve the tested versioned ZIP unchanged; documentation-only updates may rebuild the default ZIP without changing runtime code.
- v0.2.2 real diagnostic run: two menu attempts refused inspection; four in-map snapshots kept PRI points 1/0 and Overclock rank 0/1, with both originals present. Metadata reflection worked; cancellation restored original arrays and observers were zero. User then reported **"0/1, with no upgrade prompt"**. See `evidence/v022_purchase_diagnostic_result.md`. This does not prove a purchase defect; native skill prompts have not been compared. Raw fields include locals, and SkillType formatting did not expose the enum value. Keep both tested versioned ZIPs untouched.
- v0.2.3 tested baseline: improves only read-only button 4 with enum names/values, LockedSkillDetailStr, bounded SkillConstraintData fields and upgrade-UI metadata priority. All 48 established v0.2.1 functions remain unchanged, including constructor/insertion/rollback, solo guard and manual duration functions. No new hooks, native gameplay calls, loads or writes. **41 mocks plus a live diagnostic run:** four snapshots kept points 1/0 and Overclock rank 0/1; all three definitions have Passive/value0, SkillClass=Skill and locked detail '<Locked>'. Native constraint fields and UI metadata were read successfully, cancellation restored arrays and observers were zero. The user confirmed the blue title and inactive prototype description. See `evidence/v023_live_diagnostic_result.md`. Preserve the tested v0.2.3 ZIP too. Do not evaluate/copy constraints or infer purchase eligibility/callable signatures from metadata; CanUpgradeSkill's return descriptor is ESkillTreeFailureReason, not a Boolean.
- The intended v0.2.3 follow-up run actually used v0.2.2: both its log headers and installed pyproject/runtime hash confirm this. Four snapshots again kept points/ranks unchanged and cancellation restored native arrays with zero observers. The user clarified that Overclock looks like the other skills and they meant absent orange rank-upgrade text, which they attribute to its one-rank cap; that is not proof of purchase failure. See `evidence/v022_repeat_rank_preview_clarification.md`. The later v0.2.3 run resolved this mismatch without a runtime change; always verify the MODS title before arming.

## v0.2.4 baseline (live setup/cleanup; zero query calls)

v0.2.4's tested package: buttons 5/6 manually start/stop two bounded
POST observers of normal CanUpgradeSkill/GetSkillUpgradeCost calls. 57 local
mocks passed. The live run verified setup/stop/restoration, but callbacks=0.
The user confirmed highlighting all three skills; eligibility/cost are unanswered.
See evidence/v024_live_observer_result.md. Do not repeat the same trace or force
calls by buying. UI callback ownership/return handling remains mock-tested only. Require loaded function metadata
matching v0.2.3, current owned Gaige/tree/pawn, both sole-player rosters,
known unchanged PRI points/ranks/indices and an inert grade-zero candidate.
Require SkillTreeGFxObject.WPCOwner==pc and CurrentSkill among the three target
definitions. CurrentSkill_Rollover is reported separately, never substituted.
Use actual POST ret: SDK ESkillTreeFailureReason member for eligibility, exact
nonnegative int for cost. Unknown state refuses capture. Never invoke/override
the functions, edit arguments/returns or treat the failure enum as Boolean.
Limits: 24 captures, 2048 callback attempts, two copies per result; 90 seconds
checked on the next call. STOP/CANCEL/disable/error/session change/limits remove
observers. Failed removals retain inert hooks for retry. STOP checks final state.
Of the 48 v0.2.1 functions, only cancel_init_node changes, adding observer cleanup;
the snapshot's version header also changes from v0.2.3. Insertion, solo guard,
rollback, manual duration and other established functions remain unchanged.
See evidence/v024_observer_plan.md. Preserve all tested versioned ZIPs.
```

Origin: Project file. Original bytes: 2938. SHA256: 77a07164d06bb4e553836f7dfa96d0bd357449ef557bd3b26822f9852a87beaa. UTF-8 BOM: False. Original newline style: LF. Trailing LF: True.

````markdown
# Borderlands: Ultimate Vault Hunter Collection — development source

**STATUS: NOT PLAYABLE, NOT READY FOR MELTY.** This is the first code milestone: data-driven roster/skill/progression groundwork and a read-only Borderlands 2 SDK diagnostic. It does **not** port playable characters or include their original abilities yet. There is no fake executable, footage, replacement character models, copied game asset, or published release.

## What we are building
- Borderlands 1 GOTY Enhanced → The Pre-Sequel → Borderlands 2 → Borderlands 3 → Borderlands 4.
- Campaign level milestones 60 / 120 / 180 / 240 / 300.
- All **26** known main-game and DLC Vault Hunters (including BL4 C4SH and Loveless), selected from original installations only.
- Every character preserves signature action skills and original trees. Add new character-specific branches, with level-60/120/240 tiers as **design placeholders**, not gameplay-ready skill trees.
- Co-op with a friend; authoritative state and save consistency are future engine integrations.
- Eventually unified progression, money, eridium, inventory, Oz kits on every Vault Hunter, unlocked fast travel, replay and loot levels capped at 300.

## Repository layout
- `sheets/`: the source-of-truth JSON records of games, Vault Hunters, proposed new branches, and engine systems.
- `ultimate_vh/preflight.py`: verifies every sheet cell, campaign range and cross-sheet reference.
- `ultimate_vh/generate.py`: translates every JSON row into an immutable Python record in `generated/sheet_records.py`.
- `ultimate_vh/progression.py`: isolated, tested level, skill-effect, co-op-manifest and fast-travel rules; **not game hooks**.
- `ultimate_vh/save.py`: checksum-protected atomic sidecar save, never overwrites a game's original saves.
- `adapters/bl2_sdk_probe/`: *experimental, read-only* mod-menu diagnostic for BL2 PythonSDK; no new Vault Hunters yet.
- `tests/`: automated tests of the source-only domain model.
- `docs/RUNTIME_GATES.md`: exact unmet in-game and Melty release prerequisites.

## Development commands
Run from the project root with Python 3.10+ (no third-party Python libraries):

```bash
python -m ultimate_vh.preflight
python -m ultimate_vh.generate
python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
```

## Distribution/credits
Design by project requester; programming prototype created with ChatGPT. This original prototype's code is offered under MIT (see LICENSE). Game titles, names, content and characters are owned by their respective rights holders; no rights to those assets are claimed or distributed. Upstream Borderlands SDK loaders are **not included**; review their licenses before bundling. The user has NOT specified whether a final Melty release should permit remixing.

Current blocker: the execution sandbox has no access to the user's Windows game installations or live gameplay and cannot connect to Melty's publishing API. See `docs/RUNTIME_GATES.md`.
````

Origin: Project file. Original bytes: 1203. SHA256: 97222509fb424c94e414f2b1b45f2dceda35b5c8ed71c9ce4516e22342f74c9d. UTF-8 BOM: False. Original newline style: LF. Trailing LF: True.

```python
"""BL2 SDK loader diagnostic only. NO new hunters playable yet.

Place this source folder inside BL2/sdk_mods after installing bl-sdk's manager.
Do not ship/publish as the promised mashup.
"""
from mods_base import build_mod, ButtonOption, CoopSupport, Game, get_pc
from unrealsdk import logging

def probe_host(_option):
    try:
        pc=get_pc(possibly_loading=True)
        if pc is None:
            logging.info('[UVH] No active local player (menu or loading).')
            return
        logging.info('[UVH] Borderlands 2 local player controller accessible: %s',str(pc.Name))
        logging.info('[UVH] Only SDK integration verified. No imported characters, skills, or co-op yet.')
    except Exception as exc:
        logging.error('[UVH] SDK probe failed: %s',str(exc))

build_mod(
    name='Ultimate Vault Hunters - Integration Probe',
    author='Community prototype',
    description='Read-only host integration diagnostic. Does NOT unlock other games\' Vault Hunters.',
    version='0.0.1',
    supported_games=Game.BL2,
    coop_support=CoopSupport.ClientSide,
    options=[ButtonOption('probe_host',display_name='Check host integration',on_press=probe_host)],
    auto_enable=True,
)
```

Origin: Project file. Original bytes: 1989. SHA256: 945a02ea97859a7aab574abc0002f004a852c34477005bdac9f0c60da07a56f3. UTF-8 BOM: False. Original newline style: LF. Trailing LF: True.

```markdown
# Runtime gates — hard blockers before gameplay/publishing

These are **not** feature checkmarks. Source builds and unit tests are not game tests.

1. Installations and game licenses: verify the five game directories on a Windows test machine, including the two BL4 DLC Vault Hunters (separate paid entitlements may be required). The chat sandbox cannot inspect the user's PC.
2. Loader: get a supported BL2/TPS/BL1 PythonSDK loader in a way compatible with Melty one-click packaging and its distribution license; Melty's game_info/one_click_check must confirm.
3. Native gameplay: inspect the character select and actor templates, action skills, skill trees, cosmetics, animations and voice assets in the user's owned installs. Record exact resource IDs, then implement in-game hooks. Current JSON names are human references only.
4. Cross-engine: implement on-demand content extraction or bridging from UE3/UE4/UE5 legally, with no game files uploaded. Test each one in the actual host game. Existing engines cannot load the other engines' native game packages directly.
5. Co-op: host and join in TWO running installations, verify that each player uses the same transformed actors and original skills; never claim tested from model-only simulations.
6. Saves: back up native saves, build adapters and test reloading real inventory/skills across restarts and co-op. Sidecar save proof does NOT migrate native inventory.
7. Real capture: screenshot the mod working in the game; don't use fabricated art/mockups.
8. Melty: connect an authorized publisher, confirm game_info for each game, search_mashups, inspect_package, validate_recipe, one_click_check, upload, media, user authorization and publish verification. No release or listing exists.

The toolkit from github.com/rehan-remade/universal-modder was researched via its public documentation. Git clone failed because this container cannot resolve github.com. No toolkit or SDK dependency was installed, and no game was launched.
```

```python
"""An import contract test, NOT a test inside Borderlands 2."""
from __future__ import annotations
import importlib.util, types, sys, unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

class AdapterContractTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_probe_registers_without_native_game(self):
        sent={}
        fake_mods=types.ModuleType('mods_base')
        fake_mods.build_mod=lambda **kwargs: sent.update(kwargs)
        fake_mods.ButtonOption=lambda *a,**kw: ('ButtonOption',a,kw)
        fake_mods.CoopSupport=types.SimpleNamespace(ClientSide='ClientSide')
        fake_mods.Game=types.SimpleNamespace(BL2='BL2')
        fake_mods.get_pc=lambda possibly_loading=False: types.SimpleNamespace(Name='TestController')
        fake_sdk=types.ModuleType('unrealsdk')
        entries=[]
        fake_sdk.logging=types.SimpleNamespace(info=lambda *args: entries.append(('info',args)),error=lambda *args: entries.append(('error',args)))
        source=Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent/'adapters'/'bl2_sdk_probe'/'UltimateVaultHunterProbe'/'__init__.py'
        spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('probe_mod',source)
        mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        with patch.dict(sys.modules,{'mods_base':fake_mods,'unrealsdk':fake_sdk}):
            spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
            self.assertEqual(sent['supported_games'],'BL2')
            self.assertEqual(sent['coop_support'],'ClientSide')
            mod.probe_host(None)
        self.assertTrue(any(entry[0]=='info' for entry in entries))

if __name__=='__main__':unittest.main()
```

```python
import unittest, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from ultimate_vh.preflight import load_sheets,inspect
from ultimate_vh.progression import (GAMES, VAULT_HUNTERS, EXPANDED_SKILLS,HunterState,
                                     accessible_campaigns,can_fast_travel,loot_level,session_compatible)
from ultimate_vh.save import save_state,load_state

class DesignTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_preflight(self):self.assertEqual(inspect(load_sheets()),[])
    def test_count(self):self.assertEqual((len(GAMES),len(VAULT_HUNTERS),len(EXPANDED_SKILLS)),(5,26,78))
    def test_dlc_hunters(self):
        self.assertIn('bl4_loveless',[h.id for h in VAULT_HUNTERS])
        self.assertIn('bl4_c4sh',[h.id for h in VAULT_HUNTERS])
    def test_unique_names(self):self.assertEqual(len({h.id for h in VAULT_HUNTERS}),26)
    def test_stage_gates(self):
        self.assertEqual(accessible_campaigns(set()),['bl1'])
        self.assertEqual(accessible_campaigns({'bl1'}),['bl1','tps'])
        self.assertEqual(accessible_campaigns({'bl1','tps','bl2','bl3'}),[g.id for g in GAMES])
    def test_gear_cap(self):self.assertEqual(loot_level(299,2),300)
    def test_scale(self):self.assertEqual(loot_level(120,2),122)
    def test_bad_scale(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):loot_level(200,3)
    def test_hunter(self):HunterState('bl4_loveless').validate()
    def test_hunter_reject(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):HunterState('unknown').validate()
    def test_skill_unlock(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):HunterState('bl1_roland',level=59,skills={'bl1_roland_tier1':1}).validate()
    def test_skill_prerequisite(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):HunterState('bl1_roland',level=120,skills={'bl1_roland_tier2':1}).validate()
    def test_skill_effect(self):
        s=HunterState('bl1_roland',level=120,skills={'bl1_roland_tier1':3,'bl1_roland_tier2':1})
        self.assertEqual(s.effective_bonus('action_cooldown'),0.09)
    def test_fast_travel(self):
        s=HunterState('bl1_lilith',completed_campaigns={'bl1'},unlocked_locations={'bl1:fyrestone','tps:concordia'})
        self.assertTrue(can_fast_travel(s,'bl1:fyrestone'))
        self.assertTrue(can_fast_travel(s,'tps:concordia'))
        self.assertFalse(can_fast_travel(s,'bl2:sanctuary'))
    def test_save_round_trip(self):
        s=HunterState('bl1_lilith',level=65,experience=23,money=500,eridium=3,completed_campaigns={'bl1'},unlocked_locations={'bl1:fyrestone'},equipment_refs=[{'game':'bl1','object_key':'opaque_owned_game_ref','level':60}])
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
            p=Path(td)/'test.json';save_state(p,s)
            self.assertEqual(load_state(p),s)
    def test_save_detects_tamper(self):
        s=HunterState('bl1_lilith')
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
            p=Path(td)/'test.json';save_state(p,s)
            p.write_text(p.read_text().replace('"level": 1','"level": 2'))
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):load_state(p)
    def test_match_same_manifest(self):
        self.assertTrue(session_compatible([HunterState('bl1_lilith'),HunterState('bl2_maya')],['sha','sha']))
    def test_match_diff_manifest(self):
        self.assertFalse(session_compatible([HunterState('bl1_lilith'),HunterState('bl2_maya')],['sha','other']))
    def test_incorrect_skill(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):HunterState('bl1_lilith',level=300,skills={'bl1_roland_tier1':1}).validate()
    def test_level_cap(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):HunterState('bl1_lilith',level=301).validate()

if __name__=='__main__':unittest.main()
```

```python
"""Generate one immutable Python model instance per JSON sheet row."""
from __future__ import annotations
from pathlib import Path
from .preflight import load_sheets, require_clean, ROOT

TYPES={
    'games':'GameRecord',
    'vault_hunters':'VaultHunterRecord',
    'expanded_skills':'SkillRecord',
    'systems':'SystemRecord',
}

def generate(root=ROOT):
    sheets=require_clean(load_sheets(root))
    root=Path(root)
    dest=root/'generated'/'sheet_records.py'
    body=['# AUTO-GENERATED. Edit sheets/*.json, not this file.',
          'from dataclasses import dataclass',
          '',
          '@dataclass(frozen=True)',
          'class GameRecord:',
          '    id: str; name: str; campaign_min_level: int; campaign_max_level: int',
          '    engine_family: str; original_content_from_owned_install: bool',
          '    melty_loader_status: str; steam_install_key: str; chronological_order: int; completed_campaign_required: str',
          '',
          '@dataclass(frozen=True)',
          'class VaultHunterRecord:',
          '    id: str; display_name: str; source_game: str; role: str; signature_action_reference: str',
          '    core_style: str; requires_content: str; original_skill_trees: str; new_branch_id: str',
          '    playable_host_status: str; native_objects: str',
          '',
          '@dataclass(frozen=True)',
          'class SkillRecord:',
          '    id: str; vault_hunter: str; branch_id: str; branch_name: str; skill_name: str',
          '    skill_kind: str; unlock_level: int; max_rank: int; stat: str; bonus_per_rank: float',
          '    prerequisite: str; design_status: str',
          '',
          '@dataclass(frozen=True)',
          'class SystemRecord:',
          '    id: str; host_hook: str; protocol: str; behavior: str; status: str',
          '']
    for sheet,rows in sheets.items():
        body.append(f'{sheet.upper()} = (')
        for row in rows:
            args=', '.join(f'{k}={v!r}' for k,v in row.items())
            body.append(f'    {TYPES[sheet]}({args}),')
        body.append(')')
        body.append('')
    dest.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    dest.write_text('\n'.join(body), encoding='utf-8')
    return dest

if __name__=='__main__':
    print(generate())
```

```python
"""Sheet preflight. Refuse code generation on missing values or broken references."""
from __future__ import annotations
import json
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
REQUIRED = {
    'games': ('id','name','campaign_min_level','campaign_max_level','engine_family','original_content_from_owned_install','melty_loader_status','steam_install_key','chronological_order','completed_campaign_required'),
    'vault_hunters': ('id','display_name','source_game','role','signature_action_reference','core_style','requires_content','original_skill_trees','new_branch_id','playable_host_status','native_objects'),
    'expanded_skills': ('id','vault_hunter','branch_id','branch_name','skill_name','skill_kind','unlock_level','max_rank','stat','bonus_per_rank','prerequisite','design_status'),
    'systems': ('id','host_hook','protocol','behavior','status'),
}

def load_sheets(root=ROOT):
    return {name: json.loads((Path(root)/'sheets'/f'{name}.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8')) for name in REQUIRED}

def inspect(sheets):
    errors=[]
    for name,required in REQUIRED.items():
        rows=sheets.get(name, [])
        if not isinstance(rows,list) or not rows: errors.append(f'{name}: sheet must be nonempty');continue
        ids=set()
        for idx,row in enumerate(rows):
            if not isinstance(row,dict): errors.append(f'{name}[{idx}]: not a row');continue
            for field in required:
                if field not in row or row[field] is None or row[field] == '' or row[field] == []:
                    errors.append(f'{name}[{idx}].{field}: empty or missing')
            if row.get('id') in ids: errors.append(f'{name}[{idx}].id: duplicate {row.get("id")}')
            ids.add(row.get('id'))
    game_ids={g['id'] for g in sheets['games']}
    hunters={h['id']:h for h in sheets['vault_hunters']}
    skills={s['id']:s for s in sheets['expanded_skills']}
    for h in hunters.values():
        if h['source_game'] not in game_ids:errors.append(f'{h["id"]}: unknown source game')
        if h['new_branch_id'] not in {s['branch_id'] for s in skills.values()}:errors.append(f'{h["id"]}: unresolved branch')
    for s in skills.values():
        if s['vault_hunter'] not in hunters:errors.append(f'{s["id"]}: unknown hunter')
        elif s['branch_id'] != hunters[s['vault_hunter']]['new_branch_id']: errors.append(f'{s["id"]}: wrong branch')
        if s['prerequisite'] != 'none' and s['prerequisite'] not in skills:errors.append(f'{s["id"]}: invalid prerequisite')
        if not (1<=s['unlock_level']<=300):errors.append(f'{s["id"]}: invalid level')
        if not (1<=s['max_rank']<=10):errors.append(f'{s["id"]}: invalid max rank')
        if not (0 < s['bonus_per_rank'] <= 1):errors.append(f'{s["id"]}: invalid bonus')
    order=sorted(sheets['games'],key=lambda g:g['chronological_order'])
    if [x['chronological_order'] for x in order]!=list(range(1,len(order)+1)):errors.append('game order has gaps')
    for i,g in enumerate(order):
        if g['campaign_min_level'] != (1 if i==0 else order[i-1]['campaign_max_level']+1):errors.append(f'{g["id"]}: level range not contiguous')
        if g['campaign_max_level'] != 60*(i+1):errors.append(f'{g["id"]}: unexpected milestone')
        if g['completed_campaign_required'] != ('none' if i==0 else order[i-1]['id']):errors.append(f'{g["id"]}: incorrect gate')
    if order[-1]['campaign_max_level']!=300: errors.append('max player/weapon level must be 300')
    if len(hunters)!=26:errors.append('expected 26 hunters including both Borderlands 4 DLC hunters')
    return errors

def require_clean(sheets):
    errors=inspect(sheets)
    if errors: raise ValueError('Preflight failed:\n'+'\n'.join(errors))
    return sheets

if __name__=='__main__':
    sheets=load_sheets()
    errors=inspect(sheets)
    if errors:
        print('Preflight FAILED:\n'+'\n'.join(errors));raise SystemExit(1)
    print(f'Preflight PASS: {len(sheets["games"])} campaigns, {len(sheets["vault_hunters"])} hunters, {len(sheets["expanded_skills"])} expansion skills, {len(sheets["systems"])} systems.')
```

```python
"""Testable progression and skill math, not yet connected to Unreal Engine."""
from __future__ import annotations
from dataclasses import dataclass,field
from generated.sheet_records import GAMES, VAULT_HUNTERS, EXPANDED_SKILLS

GAMES_BY_ID={g.id:g for g in GAMES}
HUNTERS_BY_ID={h.id:h for h in VAULT_HUNTERS}
SKILLS_BY_ID={s.id:s for s in EXPANDED_SKILLS}
MAX_LEVEL=300

@dataclass
class HunterState:
    hunter_id: str
    level: int=1
    experience: int=0
    money: int=0
    eridium: int=0
    completed_campaigns: set[str]=field(default_factory=set)
    unlocked_locations: set[str]=field(default_factory=set)
    skills: dict[str,int]=field(default_factory=dict)
    # Opaque references only; no copied textures, items, or game binaries.
    equipment_refs: list[dict]=field(default_factory=list)

    def validate(self):
        if self.hunter_id not in HUNTERS_BY_ID:raise ValueError('Unknown hunter')
        if not 1 <= self.level <= MAX_LEVEL:raise ValueError('Invalid level')
        if self.money<0 or self.eridium<0 or self.experience<0:raise ValueError('Negative resource')
        for loc in self.unlocked_locations:
            if ':' not in loc or loc.split(':',1)[0] not in GAMES_BY_ID:raise ValueError('Invalid fast-travel reference')
        for game in self.completed_campaigns:
            if game not in GAMES_BY_ID:raise ValueError('Unknown completed campaign')
        for skill_id,rank in self.skills.items():
            skill=SKILLS_BY_ID.get(skill_id)
            if skill is None or skill.vault_hunter!=self.hunter_id:raise ValueError('Wrong skill for hunter')
            if not 0<=rank<=skill.max_rank:raise ValueError('Invalid skill rank')
            if rank and self.level<skill.unlock_level:raise ValueError('Skill unlocked too early')
            if rank and skill.prerequisite!='none' and self.skills.get(skill.prerequisite,0)<1:
                raise ValueError('Missing prerequisite')
        for ref in self.equipment_refs:
            if not {'game','object_key','level'}.issubset(ref):raise ValueError('Missing equipment reference')
            if ref['game'] not in GAMES_BY_ID or not 1<=ref['level']<=MAX_LEVEL:raise ValueError('Invalid gear reference')
        return self

    def effective_bonus(self,stat):
        self.validate()
        return round(sum(SKILLS_BY_ID[sid].bonus_per_rank*rank for sid,rank in self.skills.items() if SKILLS_BY_ID[sid].stat==stat),6)

def accessible_campaigns(completed):
    finished=set(completed)
    known=[]
    for game in sorted(GAMES, key=lambda x:x.chronological_order):
        if game.completed_campaign_required!='none' and game.completed_campaign_required not in finished:break
        known.append(game.id)
    return known

def can_fast_travel(state:HunterState, location:str)->bool:
    state.validate()
    return location in state.unlocked_locations and location.split(':',1)[0] in accessible_campaigns(state.completed_campaigns)

def loot_level(player_level:int, roll_bonus:int=0)->int:
    """Clamp drop to player level through +2. Rolls beyond cap stay at 300."""
    if not 1<=player_level<=MAX_LEVEL:raise ValueError('Invalid player level')
    if not 0<=roll_bonus<=2:raise ValueError('Only level through +2 permitted')
    return min(MAX_LEVEL,player_level+roll_bonus)

def session_compatible(states:list[HunterState], manifest_hashes:list[str])->bool:
    """Validation contract only; does not open a network connection or host a session."""
    if not states or len(states)!=len(manifest_hashes):return False
    if len(set(manifest_hashes))!=1:return False
    try:
        for s in states:s.validate()
    except ValueError:return False
    return True
```

```python
"""Atomic, versioned *sidecar* saves; does NOT modify any real Borderlands save files."""
from __future__ import annotations
import json, hashlib, os, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from .progression import HunterState
SAVE_VERSION=1

def save_state(path:Path,state:HunterState):
    state.validate()
    path=Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    obj={'hunter_id':state.hunter_id,'level':state.level,'experience':state.experience,
         'money':state.money,'eridium':state.eridium,'completed_campaigns':sorted(state.completed_campaigns),
         'unlocked_locations':sorted(state.unlocked_locations),'skills':state.skills,
         'equipment_refs':state.equipment_refs}
    payload=json.dumps(obj,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))
    data={'version':SAVE_VERSION,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(payload.encode()).hexdigest(),'data':obj}
    fd,tmp=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.uvh-',dir=path.parent)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd,'w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
            json.dump(data,f,indent=2,sort_keys=True);f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())
        os.replace(tmp,path)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(tmp):os.unlink(tmp)

def load_state(path:Path)->HunterState:
    blob=json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    if blob.get('version')!=SAVE_VERSION:raise ValueError('Unsupported save version')
    payload=json.dumps(blob['data'],sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))
    if hashlib.sha256(payload.encode()).hexdigest()!=blob['sha256']:raise ValueError('Save checksum mismatch')
    obj=blob['data']
    obj['completed_campaigns']=set(obj['completed_campaigns'])
    obj['unlocked_locations']=set(obj['unlocked_locations'])
    return HunterState(**obj).validate()
```

```python
"""UVH: manual Deathtrap boost, opt-in inert node test and loading diagnostics.

No automatic gameplay changes. The optional trace observes native calls without
blocking or overriding them. Node insertion writes shared definitions only on an
explicit menu button; keep a backed-up Gaige save and never buy the test node.
"""
import math
from mods_base import ButtonOption, CoopSupport, Game, build_mod, get_pc
from unrealsdk import logging

TAG = '[UVH-BOOST]'
EXTRA_SECONDS = 15.0
EXPECTED_DEFAULT = 60.0
MAX_DURATION = 180.0
_record = None


def log(message):
    logging.info('{} {}'.format(TAG, message))


def read(obj, field):
    try:
        return getattr(obj, field)
    except Exception:
        return None


def name(obj):
    return str(read(obj, 'Name') or '')


def finite_num(value):
    return type(value) in (float, int) and math.isfinite(value)


def near(a, b):
    return finite_num(a) and finite_num(b) and math.isclose(a, b, rel_tol=0, abs_tol=0.05)


def signature(skill):
    # Names sometimes get reused by UE; activation time distinguishes each summon.
    return (name(skill), read(skill, 'ActivatedTime'), name(read(skill, 'SkillInstigator')))


def find_live():
    """Return (skill, action, pc) for our own active Deathtrap or (None, ...)."""
    pc = get_pc(possibly_loading=True)
    if pc is None:
        log('No local controller. Load Gaige into a map.')
        return None, None, None
    if name(read(pc, 'PlayerClass')) != 'CharClass_Mechromancer':
        log('Not Gaige. No gameplay changes.')
        return None, None, pc
    action = read(read(pc, 'Pawn'), 'MyActionSkill')
    if name(read(action, 'Class')) != 'DeathtrapActionSkill':
        log('Deathtrap is not summoned. Summon first.')
        return None, action, pc
    try:
        manager = pc.GetSkillManager()
        skills = read(manager, 'ActiveSkills')
        count = len(skills)
    except Exception as exc:
        log('Could not access ActiveSkills ({})'.format(type(exc).__name__))
        return None, action, pc
    for i in range(min(count, 64)):
        try:
            skill = skills[i]
            if name(read(skill, 'Definition')) != 'Skill_DeathTrap':
                continue
            instigator = read(skill, 'SkillInstigator')
            if name(instigator) != name(pc) or not name(pc):
                log('Deathtrap skill owner did not match player controller; aborting.')
                return None, action, pc
            return skill, action, pc
        except Exception as exc:
            log('Could not read ActiveSkills[{}] ({})'.format(i, type(exc).__name__))
    log('No active Skill_DeathTrap instance found.')
    return None, action, pc


def display(skill):
    log('Skill={} | Grade={} | Duration={} | Base={} | ActivatedTime={} | modifiers={}'.format(
        name(skill), read(skill, 'Grade'), read(skill, 'Duration'),
        read(skill, 'DurationBaseValue'), read(skill, 'ActivatedTime'),
        _modifier_count(skill)))


def _modifier_count(skill):
    stack = read(skill, 'DurationModifierStack')
    if stack is None:
        return 'unavailable'
    try:
        return len(stack)
    except Exception:
        return 'unavailable'


def inspect(_option=None):
    log('BEGIN inspect v0.1.1')
    try:
        skill, _action, _pc = find_live()
        if skill is not None:
            display(skill)
            if _record is not None:
                log('Last test record: {} -> {} on {}'.format(
                    _record['before'], _record['after'], _record['sig']))
            else:
                log('No duration change recorded in this session.')
    except Exception as exc:
        log('ERROR inspect: {}: {}'.format(type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:130]))
    finally:
        log('END inspect')


def apply(_option=None):
    global _record
    log('BEGIN experimental +15 seconds (live skill instance only)')
    try:
        skill, _action, _pc = find_live()
        if skill is None:
            return
        sig = signature(skill)
        if _record is not None:
            if sig == _record['sig']:
                log('NOT APPLIED: Already tested on this summon; prevents stacking.')
                display(skill)
                return
            log('Previous summon ended. Clearing stale duration record.')
            _record = None

        current = read(skill, 'Duration')
        base = read(skill, 'DurationBaseValue')
        modifier_count = _modifier_count(skill)
        display(skill)
        if not near(current, EXPECTED_DEFAULT) or not near(base, EXPECTED_DEFAULT):
            log('NOT APPLIED: Expected unmodified Duration and DurationBaseValue ~= 60.0.')
            return
        if modifier_count != 0:
            log('NOT APPLIED: Skill has duration modifiers or modifiers inaccessible.')
            return
        after = current + EXTRA_SECONDS
        if after > MAX_DURATION:
            log('NOT APPLIED: requested Duration exceeds safety limit.')
            return
        try:
            skill.Duration = float(after)
        except Exception as exc:
            log('WRITE REJECTED: {}: {}'.format(type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:110]))
            return
        observed = read(skill, 'Duration')
        if not near(observed, after):
            log('WRITE NOT VERIFIED: expected {}, got {}; attempting rollback.'.format(after, observed))
            try:
                skill.Duration = current
            except Exception as rollback_exc:
                log('WARNING rollback failed: {}'.format(type(rollback_exc).__name__))
            return
        _record = {'sig': sig, 'before': current, 'after': after}
        log('WRITE VERIFIED: live Skill_DeathTrap.Duration {} -> {}'.format(current, observed))
        log('DurationBaseValue left unchanged. A successful write does not yet prove longer in-game lifespan.')
        log('No shared definitions, tree points, cooldown pools or saves changed.')
    except Exception as exc:
        log('ERROR apply: {}: {}'.format(type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:130]))
    finally:
        log('END apply')


def restore(_option=None):
    global _record
    log('BEGIN restore live duration')
    try:
        if _record is None:
            log('Nothing to restore; no successful modification recorded.')
            return
        skill, _action, _pc = find_live()
        if skill is None or signature(skill) != _record['sig']:
            log('Original Deathtrap summon is no longer active. No other skill touched.')
            _record = None
            return
        current = read(skill, 'Duration')
        if not near(current, _record['after']):
            log('NOT RESTORED: current Duration {} changed independently; avoiding overwrite.'.format(current))
            _record = None
            return
        before = _record['before']
        skill.Duration = before
        checked = read(skill, 'Duration')
        if near(checked, before):
            log('RESTORED: live Skill_DeathTrap.Duration {} -> {}'.format(current, checked))
            _record = None
        else:
            log('RESTORE READBACK MISMATCH: got {}'.format(checked))
    except Exception as exc:
        log('ERROR restore: {}: {}'.format(type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:130]))
    finally:
        log('END restore')




def _tree_info(val):
    if val is None:
        return '<none>'
    if type(val) in (str, int, bool, float):
        return repr(val)[:160]
    label = name(val)
    clazz = name(read(val, 'Class'))
    if label:
        return '{} [{}]'.format(label[:75], clazz[:75] or type(val).__name__)
    try:
        return '<{} len={}>'.format(type(val).__name__, len(val))
    except Exception:
        return '<{}>'.format(type(val).__name__)


def _tree_fields(label, obj):
    if obj is None:
        log('[UVH-TREE] {} unavailable'.format(label))
        return
    tokens = ('skill', 'tree', 'train', 'point', 'branch', 'grade', 'purchase', 'unlock', 'node')
    try:
        fields = sorted(set(k for k in dir(obj) if not k.startswith('_')
                            and any(t in k.lower() for t in tokens)))
    except Exception as exc:
        log('[UVH-TREE] {} names ERROR {}'.format(label, type(exc).__name__))
        return
    log('[UVH-TREE] {} matching names ({}): {}'.format(
        label, len(fields), ', '.join(fields[:85]) or '<none>'))
    for key in fields[:80]:
        try:
            val = getattr(obj, key)
            if callable(val):
                continue
            log('[UVH-TREE] {}.{} = {}'.format(label, key, _tree_info(val)))
            # Sample a few referenced tree/branch structs, without walking the entire graph.
            if any(x in key.lower() for x in ('tree', 'branch', 'node')) and not isinstance(val, (str, bytes)):
                if isinstance(val, (tuple, list)):
                    for i, entry in enumerate(val[:3]):
                        log('[UVH-TREE] {}.{}[{}] = {}'.format(label, key, i, _tree_info(entry)))
        except Exception as exc:
            log('[UVH-TREE] {}.{} READ ERROR {}'.format(label, key, type(exc).__name__))


def inspect_native_tree(_option=None):
    """Inspect native Gaige skill-tree access, never spend or mutate points."""
    log('[UVH-TREE] BEGIN v0.1.2 native tree/skill-point inspection (READ ONLY)')
    try:

        if pc is None:
            log('[UVH-TREE] No player controller; load Gaige and retry.')
            return
        cls = read(pc, 'PlayerClass')
        if name(cls) != 'CharClass_Mechromancer':
            log('[UVH-TREE] Current class {} is not Gaige; skipping.'.format(name(cls)))
            return
        pri = read(pc, 'PlayerReplicationInfo')
        log('[UVH-TREE] Class={} SkillTreePath={}'.format(name(cls), _tree_info(read(cls, 'SkillTreePath'))))
        log('[UVH-TREE] GeneralSkillPoints={} SpecialistSkillPoints={}'.format(
            _tree_info(read(pri, 'GeneralSkillPoints')),
            _tree_info(read(pri, 'SpecialistSkillPoints'))))
        _tree_fields('PlayerClass', cls)
        _tree_fields('PlayerReplicationInfo', pri)
        _tree_fields('PlayerController', pc)
        try:
            import unrealsdk
            trees = unrealsdk.find_all('SkillTreeDefinition', exact=False)
            log('[UVH-TREE] Loaded SkillTreeDefinition count={}'.format(len(trees)))
            for i, tree in enumerate(trees):
                if i >= 16:

                log('[UVH-TREE] loadedTree[{}] = {}'.format(i, _tree_info(tree)))

            log('[UVH-TREE] find_all SkillTreeDefinition ERROR {}: {}'.format(
                type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:100]))

    except Exception as exc:
        log('[UVH-TREE] ERROR {}: {}'.format(type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:120]))
    finally:
        log('[UVH-TREE] END')



# Native skill branches referenced by BL2 skill-tree patch mods.  We only inspect
# these objects (and their original packages); no asset or save property writes.
def _find_native(path, types=('Object',)):
    import unrealsdk
    for kind in types:
        try:
            obj = unrealsdk.find_object(kind, path)
            if obj is not None:
                return obj, kind
        except Exception:
            pass
    return None, None


def _native_describe(obj):
    if obj is None:
        return '<missing>'
    try:
        return '{} | {}'.format(_tree_info(obj), str(obj)[:190])
    except Exception:
        return _tree_info(obj)


def _read_tiers(label, obj):
    fields = ('Branches', 'Tiers', 'Skills', 'SkillTreeBranches', 'Layout',
              'RequiredPoints', 'PointsToUnlockNextTier', 'bCellIsOccupied',
              'SkillDefinition', 'SkillTree', 'SkillName', 'SkillDescription')
    for field in fields:
        value = read(obj, field)
        if value is None:
            continue
        log('[UVH-NODES] {}.{} = {}'.format(label, field, _native_describe(value)))
        if isinstance(value, (str, bytes)):
            continue
        try:
            count = len(value)
        except Exception:
            continue
        log('[UVH-NODES] {}.{} length={}'.format(label, field, count))
        for i in range(min(count, 7)):
            try:
                item = value[i]
                log('[UVH-NODES] {}.{}[{}] = {}'.format(label, field, i, _native_describe(item)))
                for nested in ('Skills', 'PointsToUnlockNextTier', 'bCellIsOccupied',
                               'SkillDefinition', 'SkillName'):
                    v = read(item, nested)
                    if v is not None:
                        log('[UVH-NODES] {}.{}[{}].{} = {}'.format(
                            label, field, i, nested, _native_describe(v)))
                        if nested in ('Skills', 'bCellIsOccupied'):
                            try:
                                for j in range(min(len(v), 4)):
                                    log('[UVH-NODES] {}.{}[{}].{}[{}] = {}'.format(
                                        label, field, i, nested, j, _native_describe(v[j])))
                            except Exception:
                                pass
            except Exception as exc:
                log('[UVH-NODES] {}.{}[{}] inspect failed {}'.format(
                    label, field, i, type(exc).__name__))

def inspect_node_blueprint(_option=None):

             'GD_Tulip_Mechromancer_Skills.SkillTrees.Layout_BestFriendsForever'),
        )
        for branch_name, branch_path, layout_path in pairs:

                            if used:

                        log('[UVH-NODEPREP] {} tier={} map {}'.format(branch_name, i, ', '.join(mapping)))
                    else:
                        log('[UVH-NODEPREP] WARN tier={} skill count != occupied slots'.format(i))

        for label, path in samples:
            obj, kind = _find_native(path, ('SkillDefinition', 'Object'))

            if obj is None:

            try:

                        'point', 'description', 'name', 'dependency', 'unlock'))]

def _node_first_tier():
    """Only use this exact verified Gaige branch and its unused middle column."""
    branch_path = 'GD_Tulip_Mechromancer_Skills.SkillTrees.Branch_LittleBigTrouble'
    layout_path = 'GD_Tulip_Mechromancer_Skills.SkillTrees.Layout_LittleBigTrouble'
    branch, _ = _find_native(branch_path, ('SkillTreeBranchDefinition', 'Object'))
    layout, _ = _find_native(layout_path, ('SkillTreeBranchLayoutDefinition', 'Object'))
    if branch is None or layout is None:
        log('[UVH-NEWNODE] Missing assets: branch={} layout={}'.format(
            _native_describe(branch), _native_describe(layout)))
        return None

        btier = branch.Tiers[0]
        ltier = layout.Tiers[0]
        originals = [x for x in btier.Skills]
        occupied = [bool(x) for x in ltier.bCellIsOccupied]
        if [name(x) for x in originals] != ['MorePep', 'Myelin'] or occupied != [True, False, True]:
            log('[UVH-NEWNODE] First tier is not in expected pristine state; no writes.')
            return None
        return branch, layout, btier, ltier, originals, occupied
    except Exception as exc:
        log('[UVH-NEWNODE] Cannot inspect first tier: {}: {}'.format(type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:110]))
        return None


def _node_has_exact_contents(btier, ltier, new):
    try:
        skills = [x for x in btier.Skills]
        flags = [bool(x) for x in ltier.bCellIsOccupied]
        return (len(skills) == 3 and
                name(skills[0]) == 'MorePep' and skills[1] == new and
                name(skills[2]) == 'Myelin' and flags == [True, True, True])
    except Exception:
        return False


def _node_set_array(owner, prop, values):
    """Try property array assignment; then element-level mutation if supported."""
    try:
        setattr(owner, prop, list(values))
        if list(getattr(owner, prop)) == list(values):
            return True, 'assign'
    except Exception as exc:
        log('[UVH-NEWNODE] {} assignment unsupported: {}: {}'.format(prop, type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:90]))
    arr = read(owner, prop)
    if arr is None:
        return False, 'missing'
    try:
        arr[:] = list(values)
        if list(read(owner, prop)) == list(values):
            return True, 'slice'
    except Exception as exc:
        log('[UVH-NEWNODE] {} slice unsupported: {}'.format(prop, type(exc).__name__))
    try:
        # Useful for WrappedArray implementations supporting clear/extend.
        arr.clear()
        arr.extend(list(values))
        if list(read(owner, prop)) == list(values):
            return True, 'clear+extend'
    except Exception as exc:
        log('[UVH-NEWNODE] {} list methods unsupported: {}'.format(prop, type(exc).__name__))
    return False, 'unsupported'


def _node_restore_snapshot(record):
    """Restore both native branch and layout arrays and verify the readback."""
    btier, ltier = record['btier'], record['ltier']
    old_skills, old_cells = record['skills'], record['cells']
    success_skills, how_skills = _node_set_array(btier, 'Skills', old_skills)
    success_cells, how_cells = _node_set_array(ltier, 'bCellIsOccupied', old_cells)
    try:
        observed = [name(x) for x in btier.Skills]
        flags = [bool(x) for x in ltier.bCellIsOccupied]
        success = (success_skills and success_cells and
                   observed == ['MorePep', 'Myelin'] and flags == [True, False, True])
    except Exception:
        success = False
        observed, flags = '<cannot read>', '<cannot read>'
    log('[UVH-NEWNODE] RESTORE result={} skills={} cells={} (methods {}, {})'.format(
        success, observed, flags, how_skills, how_cells))
    if not success:
        log('[UVH-NEWNODE] SAFETY: Exit BL2 WITHOUT SAVING and restart before playing.')
    return success


def _node_make_candidate(branch):
    import unrealsdk
    template, _ = _find_native(
        'GD_Tulip_Mechromancer_Skills.LittleBigTrouble.MorePep', ('SkillDefinition', 'Object'))
    if template is None:
        log('[UVH-NEWNODE] Existing MorePep template missing.')
        return None
    # Creating inside a known UObject guarantees a valid Unreal outer even if
    # this SDK version does not expose UObject.Outer. Does NOT overwrite template.
    outer = read(template, 'Outer') or branch
    for path in (
        'GD_Tulip_Mechromancer_Skills.SkillTrees.Branch_LittleBigTrouble.UVH_DeathtrapOverclock',
        'GD_Tulip_Mechromancer_Skills.LittleBigTrouble.UVH_DeathtrapOverclock',
    ):
        existing, _ = _find_native(path, ('Object',))
        if existing is not None:
            log('[UVH-NEWNODE] Candidate name already exists; restart before another test. No overwrite.')
            return None
    try:
        obj = unrealsdk.construct_object('SkillDefinition', outer, 'UVH_DeathtrapOverclock')
    except Exception as exc:
        log('[UVH-NEWNODE] construct_object FAILED {}: {}'.format(type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:170]))
        return None
    if (obj is None or name(read(obj, 'Class')) != 'SkillDefinition'
            or name(obj) != 'UVH_DeathtrapOverclock' or obj == template):
        log('[UVH-NEWNODE] Candidate construction did not return SkillDefinition.')
        return None
    # Never copy another active skill's gameplay effects or activation actions.
    for attr in ('SkillEffectDefinitions', 'SkillActivationActions', 'SkillDeactivationActions'):
        val = read(obj, attr)
        try:
            if val is None or len(val) != 0:
                log('[UVH-NEWNODE] ABORT: candidate {} is missing or nonempty'.format(attr))
                return None
        except Exception:
            log('[UVH-NEWNODE] ABORT: cannot verify empty {}'.format(attr))
            return None
    requested = (
        ('SkillName', 'Deathtrap Overclock'),
        ('SkillDescription', 'Prototype: Extends Deathtrap duration by 15 seconds. (Not active in this node test.)'),
        ('MaxGrade', 1),
        ('DefaultStartingGrade', 0),
        ('bSubjectToGradeRules', True),
    )
    for prop, val in requested:
        try:
            setattr(obj, prop, val)
            if read(obj, prop) != val:
                log('[UVH-NEWNODE] {} readback mismatch; abort.'.format(prop))
                return None
        except Exception as exc:
            log('[UVH-NEWNODE] {} write failed {}: {}'.format(prop, type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:95]))
            return None
    try:
        obj.SkillIcon = template.SkillIcon  # temporary built-in icon, not custom art
    except Exception as exc:
        log('[UVH-NEWNODE] Icon binding failed {}, continuing with no icon.'.format(type(exc).__name__))
    log('[UVH-NEWNODE] NEW SkillDefinition created: {} | max rank={} | effects=0'.format(
        _native_describe(obj), read(obj, 'MaxGrade')))
    return obj


def add_overclock_node(_option=None):
    global _uvh_node_state
    log('[UVH-NEWNODE] BEGIN v0.2.1 EARLY MENU node insertion (NO POINT SPENDING)')
    record = None
    try:
        if _init_armed or _init_hooks:
            log('[UVH-NEWNODE] NOT INSERTED: initialization experiment is armed; use its CANCEL button first.')
            return
        try:
            pc = get_pc(possibly_loading=True)
        except Exception:
            pc = None
        if pc is not None and read(pc, 'Pawn') is not None:
            log('[UVH-NEWNODE] NOT INSERTED: character already loaded. Return to the MAIN MENU and try there.')
            return
        log('[UVH-NEWNODE] Menu preflight: controller={} class={} pawn={}'.format(
            name(pc) or '<none>', name(read(pc, 'PlayerClass')) or '<none>',
            name(read(pc, 'Pawn')) or '<none>'))
        # The exact Gaige branch may not be in memory on the main menu.
        # Load its data package before accessing it, without changing saves.
        import unrealsdk
        try:
            pkg = unrealsdk.load_package('GD_Tulip_Mechromancer_Skills')
            log('[UVH-NEWNODE] load_package completed; returned {} (None is not necessarily failure)'.format(
                _tree_info(pkg)))
        except Exception as exc:
            log('[UVH-NEWNODE] load_package raised {}: {}'.format(type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:140]))
        if _uvh_node_state is not None:
            log('[UVH-NEWNODE] Already inserted this session; will not stack.')
            return
        objects = _node_first_tier()
        if objects is None:
            log('[UVH-NEWNODE] Gaige skill assets unavailable at main menu or unexpected layout; no changes made.')
            return
        branch, layout, btier, ltier, originals, occupied = objects
        new = _node_make_candidate(branch)
        if new is None:
            return
        record = dict(btier=btier, ltier=ltier, skills=originals, cells=occupied, node=new)
        wanted = [originals[0], new, originals[1]]
        s_ok, s_method = _node_set_array(btier, 'Skills', wanted)
        l_ok, l_method = _node_set_array(ltier, 'bCellIsOccupied', [True, True, True])
        # Confirm through a fresh native lookup too, not just the local struct proxy.
        re_branch, _ = _find_native(
            'GD_Tulip_Mechromancer_Skills.SkillTrees.Branch_LittleBigTrouble',
            ('SkillTreeBranchDefinition', 'Object'))
        re_layout, _ = _find_native(
            'GD_Tulip_Mechromancer_Skills.SkillTrees.Layout_LittleBigTrouble',
            ('SkillTreeBranchLayoutDefinition', 'Object'))
        observed_live = (re_branch is not None and re_layout is not None and
                         _node_has_exact_contents(re_branch.Tiers[0], re_layout.Tiers[0], new))
        if not s_ok or not l_ok or not _node_has_exact_contents(btier, ltier, new) or not observed_live:
            log('[UVH-NEWNODE] INSERT NOT VERIFIED: skills={}, layout={}; rolling back.'.format(s_ok, l_ok))
            _node_restore_snapshot(record)
            return
        _uvh_node_state = record
        log('[UVH-NEWNODE] INSERT VERIFIED: Tier0=[MorePep, DeathtrapOverclock, Myelin]')
        log('[UVH-NEWNODE] Layout.Tier0=[True, True, True] (methods {}, {})'.format(s_method,l_method))
        log('[UVH-NEWNODE] Visual test only! DO NOT BUY the new node. 15s bonus still via manual button.')
        log('[UVH-NEWNODE] Now load Gaige via CONTINUE (do not buy node); inspect Skills tab.')
    except Exception as exc:
        log('[UVH-NEWNODE] ERROR {}: {}'.format(type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:160]))
        if record is not None and _uvh_node_state is None:
            _node_restore_snapshot(record)
    finally:
        log('[UVH-NEWNODE] END')


def remove_overclock_node(_option=None):
    global _uvh_node_state
    log('[UVH-NEWNODE] BEGIN remove prototype node')
    try:
        if _uvh_node_state is None:
            log('[UVH-NEWNODE] Nothing added by this mod session.')
            return
        record = _uvh_node_state
        if 'init_tree' in record:
            cancel_init_node()
            return
        if not _node_has_exact_contents(record['btier'], record['ltier'], record['node']):
            log('[UVH-NEWNODE] Other modifications detected; will not overwrite them. Restart game.')
            return
        if _node_restore_snapshot(record):
            _uvh_node_state = None
            log('[UVH-NEWNODE] Prototype node removed; original tree restored.')
    except Exception as exc:
        log('[UVH-NEWNODE] Removal ERROR {}: {}'.format(type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:160]))
    finally:
        log('[UVH-NEWNODE] END remove')


def check_overclock_preload(_option=None):
    """Read-only comparison of the *current* native branch with the insertion snapshot."""
    log('[UVH-PRELOAD] BEGIN check current tree state (READ ONLY)')
    try:
        try:
            pc = get_pc(possibly_loading=True)
        except Exception:
            pc = None
        log('[UVH-PRELOAD] Controller={} class={} pawn={}'.format(
            name(pc) or '<none>', name(read(pc, 'PlayerClass')) or '<none>',
            name(read(pc, 'Pawn')) or '<none>'))
        branch, _ = _find_native(
            'GD_Tulip_Mechromancer_Skills.SkillTrees.Branch_LittleBigTrouble',
            ('SkillTreeBranchDefinition','Object'))
        layout, _ = _find_native(
            'GD_Tulip_Mechromancer_Skills.SkillTrees.Layout_LittleBigTrouble',
            ('SkillTreeBranchLayoutDefinition','Object'))
        if branch is None or layout is None:
            log('[UVH-PRELOAD] Branch/layout not loaded in current world; no writes.')
            return
        skills = list(branch.Tiers[0].Skills)
        cells = [bool(x) for x in layout.Tiers[0].bCellIsOccupied]
        log('[UVH-PRELOAD] CURRENT branch={} skills={} layout={}'.format(
            _native_describe(branch), [name(x) for x in skills], cells))
        if _uvh_node_state is not None:
            record = _uvh_node_state
            log('[UVH-PRELOAD] State saved: current branch is same object={} node still in current tree={}'.format(
                branch == record['btier'] or branch.Tiers[0] == record['btier'],
                len(skills) == 3 and skills[1] == record['node']))
        else:
            log('[UVH-PRELOAD] No node inserted by this mod session.')
        # Check the streaming tree too, but never attempt to edit it.
        try:
            obj, _ = _find_native(
                'GD_Tulip_Mechro_Streaming.SkillTree.SkillTree_Mechromancer',
                ('SkillTreeDefinition','Object'))
            log('[UVH-PRELOAD] Top-level streaming SkillTreeDefinition = {}'.format(_native_describe(obj)))
        except Exception as exc:
            log('[UVH-PRELOAD] Top-level inspection {}: {}'.format(type(exc).__name__,str(exc)[:100]))
    except Exception as exc:
        log('[UVH-PRELOAD] ERROR {}: {}'.format(type(exc).__name__,str(exc)[:160]))
    finally:
        log('[UVH-PRELOAD] END')

# v0.1.8 diagnostics never load packages, construct skills, call native gameplay
# functions, or write UObject/struct properties. SDK _path_name is a metadata API.
_DIAG_PATHS = (
    ('StreamingTree', 'SkillTreeDefinition',
     'GD_Tulip_Mechro_Streaming.SkillTree.SkillTree_Mechromancer'),
```
