    if type(tier_index) is not int or not 0 <= tier_index < len(tiers):
        raise ValueError('target tier index unavailable')
    tier = tiers[tier_index]
    if read(tier, 'TierNumber') != 0 or not 3 <= len(tier.SkillIndices) <= 16:
        raise ValueError('first runtime tier unavailable')
    grades, indices = [], []
    for definition in context['definitions']:
        if name(read(definition, 'Class')) != 'SkillDefinition':
            raise ValueError('unverified skill definition class')
        entries = [entry for entry in skills if read(entry, 'Definition') == definition]
        if len(entries) != 1:
            raise ValueError('candidate/original registration is not unique')
        entry = entries[0]
        index, grade = read(entry, 'Index'), read(entry, 'Grade')
        if (read(entry, 'Owner') != tree or type(index) is not int or not 0 <= index < len(skills)
                or read(skills[index], 'Definition') != definition
                or read(entry, 'ParentTierIndex') != tier_index or index not in tier.SkillIndices
                or type(grade) is not int or grade < 0):
            raise ValueError('skill owner/index/tier/rank unavailable')
        grades.append(grade)
        indices.append(index)
    points = (read(pri, 'GeneralSkillPoints'), read(pri, 'SpecialistSkillPoints'))
    if grades[0] != 0 or any(type(value) is not int or value < 0 for value in points):
        raise ValueError('candidate rank must be zero and both PRI point fields known')
    state = (points, tuple(grades), tuple(indices), tier_index)
    if context.get('baseline') is not None and state != context['baseline']:
        raise ValueError('points/ranks/runtime indices changed; no refund or repair attempted')
    return state


def stop_upgrade_trace(_option=None):
    """Clear capture first, then retry removal of only our registered observers."""
    global _upgrade_context, _upgrade_hooks
    import unrealsdk
    context = _upgrade_context
    _upgrade_context = None  # Any callback left after removal failure is inert.
    if context is not None:
        try:
            state = _upgrade_state(context)
            log('[UVH-UPGRADE] FINAL points={} ranks={} unchanged_from_start=True'.format(state[0], state[1]))
        except Exception as exc:
            log('[UVH-UPGRADE] FINAL UNVERIFIED {}: {}; no refund or repair.'.format(
                type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:180]))
    pending = []
    for path, phase, ident in _upgrade_hooks:
        try:
            unrealsdk.hooks.remove_hook(path, phase, ident)
            if unrealsdk.hooks.has_hook(path, phase, ident):
                pending.append((path, phase, ident))
        except Exception as exc:
            pending.append((path, phase, ident))
            log('[UVH-UPGRADE] Removal ERROR {}: {}'.format(path, type(exc).__name__))
    _upgrade_hooks = pending
    log('[UVH-UPGRADE] STOP remaining={} captured={} callbacks={} skipped={}'.format(
        len(pending), len(_upgrade_results), _upgrade_callbacks, _upgrade_skipped))
    for path in _UPGRADE_PATHS:
        for definition in ('UVH_DeathtrapOverclock', 'MorePep', 'Myelin'):
            values = [result[2] for result in _upgrade_results if result[:2] == (path, definition)]
            log('[UVH-UPGRADE] SUMMARY {} {} results={}'.format(path.rsplit(':', 1)[-1], definition, values))
    log('[UVH-UPGRADE] Missing results mean NOT OBSERVED; no purchase/effect/persistence conclusion. Cancel and restart.')
    return not pending


def _upgrade_callback(path):
    def observe(obj, args, ret, func):
        global _upgrade_busy, _upgrade_callbacks, _upgrade_skipped
        context = _upgrade_context
        if context is None or _upgrade_busy:
            return None
        _upgrade_busy = True
        try:
            import time
            _upgrade_callbacks += 1
            if (_upgrade_callbacks >= _UPGRADE_CALLBACK_LIMIT
                    or time.monotonic() - context['started'] >= _UPGRADE_SECONDS):
                log('[UVH-UPGRADE] LIMIT callback/time bound reached (time checked on calls).')
                stop_upgrade_trace()
                return None
            _upgrade_state(context)
            rollover = None
            if path == _UPGRADE_PATHS[0]:
                if name(read(obj, 'Class')) != 'SkillTreeGFxObject' or read(obj, 'WPCOwner') != context['pc']:
                    if _upgrade_skipped < 6:
                        log('[UVH-UPGRADE] IGNORED UI class={} owner_matches={} current={} rollover={}'.format(
                            name(read(obj, 'Class')), read(obj, 'WPCOwner') == context['pc'],
                            name(read(obj, 'CurrentSkill')), name(read(obj, 'CurrentSkill_Rollover'))))
                    _upgrade_skipped += 1
                    return None
                definition = read(obj, 'CurrentSkill')
                rollover = read(obj, 'CurrentSkill_Rollover')
            else:
                if obj != context['pc']:
                    if _upgrade_skipped < 6:
                        log('[UVH-UPGRADE] IGNORED cost controller ownership mismatch.')
                    _upgrade_skipped += 1
                    return None
                definition = read(args, 'Skill')
            if definition not in context['definitions']:
                if _upgrade_skipped < 6:
                    log('[UVH-UPGRADE] IGNORED {} unverified/other selection={} rollover={}'.format(
                        path.rsplit(':', 1)[-1], name(definition) or '<unavailable>', name(rollover) or '<unavailable>'))
                _upgrade_skipped += 1
                return None
            if path == _UPGRADE_PATHS[0]:
                if not isinstance(ret, context['failure_enum']) or ret not in context['failure_enum'].__members__.values():
                    raise ValueError('unverified failure-reason return: ' + _purchase_scalar(ret))
                value = _purchase_scalar(ret)  # Actual POST ret; never args.ReturnValue or bool(ret).
            else:
                if type(ret) is not int or ret < 0:
                    raise ValueError('unverified point-cost return: ' + _purchase_scalar(ret))
                value = str(ret)
            key = (path, name(definition), value)
            if _upgrade_hits.get(key, 0) >= 2:
                _upgrade_skipped += 1
                return None
            _upgrade_hits[key] = _upgrade_hits.get(key, 0) + 1
            _upgrade_results.append(key)
            log('[UVH-UPGRADE] RESULT {} skill={} return={} rollover={} baseline_points={} baseline_ranks={}'.format(
                path, name(definition), value, name(rollover) or '<unavailable>',
                context['baseline'][0], context['baseline'][1]))
            if len(_upgrade_results) >= _UPGRADE_EVENT_LIMIT:
                log('[UVH-UPGRADE] LIMIT captured event bound reached.')
                stop_upgrade_trace()
        except Exception as exc:
            log('[UVH-UPGRADE] ABORT {}: {}'.format(type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:180]))
            stop_upgrade_trace()
        finally:
            _upgrade_busy = False
        return None  # POST observer never blocks, overrides, invokes or edits the native call.
    return observe


def start_upgrade_trace(_option=None):
    global _upgrade_context, _upgrade_results, _upgrade_hits, _upgrade_callbacks, _upgrade_skipped
    import unrealsdk
    import time
    from enum import Enum
    if (_upgrade_context is not None or _upgrade_hooks or _trace_hooks or _init_hooks or _init_armed
            or _ui_context is not None or _ui_hooks or _skillstate_context is not None or _skillstate_hooks):
        log('[UVH-UPGRADE] NOT STARTED: stop existing observers; initialization must be complete.')
        return False
    try:
        pc, record = get_pc(possibly_loading=True), _uvh_node_state
        if record is None or 'init_tree' not in record or len(record['skills']) != 2:
            raise ValueError('load Gaige after ARM with an owned inert node')
        modes = unrealsdk.find_enum('ENetMode')
        failure_enum = unrealsdk.find_enum('ESkillTreeFailureReason')
        if (not isinstance(failure_enum, type) or not issubclass(failure_enum, Enum)
                or failure_enum.__name__ != 'ESkillTreeFailureReason'):
            raise ValueError('failure-reason enum type unavailable')
        context = dict(pc=pc, tree=record['init_tree'], record=record, pawn=read(pc, 'Pawn'),
                       world=read(pc, 'WorldInfo'), pri=read(pc, 'PlayerReplicationInfo'),
                       modes=(modes.NM_Standalone, modes.NM_ListenServer), failure_enum=failure_enum,
                       definitions=(record['node'], record['skills'][0], record['skills'][1]),
                       started=time.monotonic())
        context['baseline'] = _upgrade_state(context)
        _upgrade_metadata()
        _upgrade_results, _upgrade_hits = [], {}
        _upgrade_callbacks, _upgrade_skipped = 0, 0
        for path in _UPGRADE_PATHS:
            phase, ident = unrealsdk.hooks.Type.POST, 'UVH_UPGRADE_' + path.rsplit(':', 1)[-1]
            if unrealsdk.hooks.has_hook(path, phase, ident):
                raise ValueError('observer identifier already exists; not owned or removed')
            if not unrealsdk.hooks.add_hook(path, phase, ident, _upgrade_callback(path)):
                raise ValueError('observer registration refused')
            _upgrade_hooks.append((path, phase, ident))
        _upgrade_context = context  # Both registrations and every preflight check passed.
        log('[UVH-UPGRADE] START v0.2.9 POST observers=2 points={} ranks={} READ ONLY; DO NOT BUY.'.format(
            context['baseline'][0], context['baseline'][1]))
        log('[UVH-UPGRADE] Highlight Overclock/More Pep/Myelin; CurrentSkill identifies the query, rollover is separate.')
        return True
    except Exception as exc:
        log('[UVH-UPGRADE] NOT STARTED {}: {}'.format(type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:180]))
        if _upgrade_hooks:
            stop_upgrade_trace()
        return False


_UI_FUNCTION_LIMIT = 10
_UI_EVENT_LIMIT = 48
_UI_CALLBACK_LIMIT = 2048
_UI_SECONDS = 90.0  # Expiry checked on calls; always use STOP even if no calls occur.
_ui_hooks = []
_ui_context = None
_ui_results = []
_ui_hits = {}
_ui_callbacks = 0
_ui_skipped = 0
_ui_busy = False


def _ui_candidates():
    """Only loaded, canonical SkillTreeGFxObject functions; no guessed hook paths."""
    import unrealsdk
    found = {}
    tokens = ('nav', 'rollover', 'select', 'inputkey', 'infobox', 'init', 'refresh',
              'skillpointproperties', 'initialskilldata', 'skilldescription', 'skillicon')
    # All names below were discovered in v0.2.5; priority never invents a path.
    # Six missed helpers + Init and the three live navigation anchors fit ten.
    preferred = ('PostNav', 'Navigate', 'HandleInputKey', 'UpdateInfoBox',
                 'Flash_SetSkillPointProperties', 'Flash_SetSkillPointProperties_AS',
                 'Init', 'Nav_Down', 'Nav_Left', 'Nav_Right', 'extInitTree',
                 'Nav_Up', 'Nav_Back', 'Flash_SendInitialSkillData')
    priorities = {method: index for index, method in enumerate(preferred)}
    scanned = 0
    for index, func in enumerate(unrealsdk.find_all('Function', exact=False)):
        if index >= 30000:
            raise ValueError('UI discovery exceeds 30000 function objects')
        scanned += 1
        method_lower = name(func).lower()
        if (name(read(func, 'Class')) != 'Function'
                or name(read(func, 'Outer')) != 'SkillTreeGFxObject'
                or 'artifact' in method_lower or 'equip' in method_lower
                or not any(token in method_lower for token in tokens)):
            continue
        path = _trace_hook_path(func)
        if path is None or path.split(':')[0] != 'WillowGame.SkillTreeGFxObject':
            continue
        if path in found:
            raise ValueError('duplicate UI function descriptor: ' + path)
        found[path] = func
    def order(path):
        method = path.rsplit(':', 1)[-1]
        return priorities.get(method, len(preferred)), path
    paths = sorted(found, key=order)
    log('[UVH-UI] DISCOVERY scanned={} candidates={} function_limit={}'.format(scanned, len(paths), _UI_FUNCTION_LIMIT))
    for path in paths[:24]:
        log('[UVH-UI] CANDIDATE {}'.format(path))
    for path in paths[:_UI_FUNCTION_LIMIT]:
        func = found[path]
        log('[UVH-UI] SELECTED {}'.format(path))
        fields = []
        # Read descriptors only. Never infer/call a signature or read args/ret.
        for index, prop in enumerate(func._properties()):
            if index >= 8:
                fields.append('<fields capped at 8>')
                break
            fields.append('{}:{}:flags={}'.format(name(prop), name(read(prop, 'Class')), read(prop, 'PropertyFlags')))
        log('[UVH-UI] METADATA {} params={} size={} return_offset={} fields={}'.format(
            path, read(func, 'NumParams'), read(func, 'ParamsSize'), read(func, 'ReturnValueOffset'), fields))
    return paths[:_UI_FUNCTION_LIMIT]


def _ui_view(context, ui):
    """Read selection only from an exact UI owned by the guarded local Gaige."""
    if name(read(ui, 'Class')) != 'SkillTreeGFxObject' or read(ui, 'WPCOwner') != context['pc']:
        return None
    skills = context['tree'].Skills
    if not 3 <= len(skills) <= 256:
        raise ValueError('runtime skill size changed during UI read')
    def selected(field):
        definition = read(ui, field)
        if definition is None:
            return '<none/unavailable>'
        if name(read(definition, 'Class')) != 'SkillDefinition':
            return '<unverified>'
        matches = [entry for entry in skills if read(entry, 'Definition') == definition]
        if len(matches) != 1:
            return '<unverified>'
        entry = matches[0]
        index = read(entry, 'Index')
        if (read(entry, 'Owner') != context['tree'] or type(index) is not int
                or not 0 <= index < len(skills) or read(skills[index], 'Definition') != definition):
            return '<unverified>'
        return name(definition)
    current, rollover = selected('CurrentSkill'), selected('CurrentSkill_Rollover')
    ui_points = read(ui, 'NumSkillPoints')
    if type(ui_points) is not int or ui_points < 0:
        ui_points = '<unavailable>'
    unlocked = read(context['tree'].Tiers[context['baseline'][3]], 'bUnlocked')
    if type(unlocked) is not bool:
        unlocked = '<unavailable>'
    return current, rollover, ui_points, unlocked


def _ui_inventory(context, stage):
    """Bounded direct owned-UI snapshots at START/STOP, even with zero callbacks."""
    import unrealsdk
    _upgrade_state(context)
    scanned, owned = 0, 0
    for index, ui in enumerate(unrealsdk.find_all('SkillTreeGFxObject', exact=True)):
        if index >= 32:
            raise ValueError('UI object inventory exceeds 32')
        scanned += 1
        view = _ui_view(context, ui)
        if view is None:
            continue
        owned += 1
        if owned <= 4:
            log('[UVH-UI] SNAPSHOT {} object={} current={} rollover={} ui_points={} tier_unlocked={}'.format(
                stage, _diag_path(ui), *view))
    log('[UVH-UI] INVENTORY {} scanned={} owned={} printed_limit=4'.format(stage, scanned, owned))


def stop_ui_trace(_option=None):
    """Clear capture, verify final state/owned UI and remove only our hooks."""
    global _ui_context, _ui_hooks
    import unrealsdk
    context = _ui_context
    _ui_context = None
    if context is not None:
        try:
            state = _upgrade_state(context)
            log('[UVH-UI] FINAL points={} ranks={} unchanged_from_start=True'.format(state[0], state[1]))
            _ui_inventory(context, 'STOP')
        except Exception as exc:
            log('[UVH-UI] FINAL UNVERIFIED {}: {}'.format(type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:180]))
    pending = []
    for path, phase, ident in _ui_hooks:
        try:
            unrealsdk.hooks.remove_hook(path, phase, ident)
            if unrealsdk.hooks.has_hook(path, phase, ident):
                pending.append((path, phase, ident))
        except Exception as exc:
            pending.append((path, phase, ident))
            log('[UVH-UI] Removal ERROR {}: {}'.format(path, type(exc).__name__))
    _ui_hooks = pending
    log('[UVH-UI] STOP remaining={} captured={} callbacks={} skipped={}'.format(
        len(pending), len(_ui_results), _ui_callbacks, _ui_skipped))
    paths = sorted({result[0] for result in _ui_results})
    for path in paths:
        log('[UVH-UI] SUMMARY {} events={}'.format(path, sum(result[0] == path for result in _ui_results)))
    log('[UVH-UI] Selection snapshots/events are not eligibility or cost. DO NOT BUY; cancel and restart.')
    return not pending


def _ui_callback(path, phase):
    def observe(obj, args, ret, func):
        global _ui_busy, _ui_callbacks, _ui_skipped
        context = _ui_context
        if context is None or _ui_busy:
            return None
        _ui_busy = True
        try:
            import time
            _ui_callbacks += 1
            if (_ui_callbacks >= _UI_CALLBACK_LIMIT or time.monotonic() - context['started'] >= _UI_SECONDS):
                log('[UVH-UI] LIMIT callback/time bound reached (time checked on calls).')
                stop_ui_trace()
                return None
            _upgrade_state(context)
            view = _ui_view(context, obj)
            if view is None:
                if _ui_skipped < 4:
                    log('[UVH-UI] IGNORED {} {} unverified UI class/owner.'.format(phase, path))
                _ui_skipped += 1
                return None
            key = (path, phase) + view
            if _ui_hits.get(key, 0) >= 2:
                _ui_skipped += 1
                return None
            _ui_hits[key] = _ui_hits.get(key, 0) + 1
            _ui_results.append(key)
            log('[UVH-UI] EVENT {} {} {} object={} current={} rollover={} ui_points={} tier_unlocked={}'.format(
                len(_ui_results), phase, path, _diag_path(obj), *view))
            if len(_ui_results) >= _UI_EVENT_LIMIT:
                log('[UVH-UI] LIMIT event bound reached.')
                stop_ui_trace()
        except Exception as exc:
            log('[UVH-UI] ABORT {}: {}'.format(type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:180]))
            stop_ui_trace()
        finally:
            _ui_busy = False
        return None  # No args/ret reads, native invocation, writes, block or override.
    return observe


def start_ui_trace(_option=None):
    global _ui_context, _ui_results, _ui_hits, _ui_callbacks, _ui_skipped
    import unrealsdk
    import time
    if (_ui_context is not None or _ui_hooks or _upgrade_context is not None or _upgrade_hooks
            or _trace_hooks or _init_hooks or _init_armed or _skillstate_context is not None or _skillstate_hooks):
        log('[UVH-UI] NOT STARTED: stop other observers; initialization must be complete.')
        return False
    try:
        pc, record = get_pc(possibly_loading=True), _uvh_node_state
        if record is None or 'init_tree' not in record or len(record['skills']) != 2:
            raise ValueError('ARM at main menu, then Continue as Gaige with the owned inert node')
        modes = unrealsdk.find_enum('ENetMode')
        context = dict(pc=pc, tree=record['init_tree'], record=record, pawn=read(pc, 'Pawn'),
                       world=read(pc, 'WorldInfo'), pri=read(pc, 'PlayerReplicationInfo'),
                       modes=(modes.NM_Standalone, modes.NM_ListenServer),
                       definitions=(record['node'], record['skills'][0], record['skills'][1]),
                       started=time.monotonic())
        context['baseline'] = _upgrade_state(context)
        paths = _ui_candidates()
        if not paths:
            raise ValueError('no verified UI navigation/refresh function metadata loaded')
        _ui_results, _ui_hits = [], {}
        _ui_callbacks, _ui_skipped = 0, 0
        _ui_inventory(context, 'START')
        for path in paths:
            for label, phase in (('PRE', unrealsdk.hooks.Type.PRE),
                                 ('POST_ANY', unrealsdk.hooks.Type.POST_UNCONDITIONAL)):
                ident = 'UVH_UI_' + label + '_' + path.rsplit(':', 1)[-1]
                if unrealsdk.hooks.has_hook(path, phase, ident):
                    raise ValueError('UI observer identifier already exists; not owned')
                if not unrealsdk.hooks.add_hook(path, phase, ident, _ui_callback(path, label)):
                    raise ValueError('UI observer registration refused')
                _ui_hooks.append((path, phase, ident))
        _ui_context = context
        log('[UVH-UI] START v0.2.9 functions={} observers={} points={} ranks={} READ ONLY; DO NOT BUY.'.format(
            len(paths), len(_ui_hooks), context['baseline'][0], context['baseline'][1]))
        log('[UVH-UI] Open Skills, hover/navigate Overclock/More Pep/Myelin, then button 8 STOP and button 3 CANCEL.')
        return True
    except Exception as exc:
        log('[UVH-UI] NOT STARTED {}: {}'.format(type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:180]))
        if _ui_hooks:
            stop_ui_trace()
        return False


_SKILLSTATE_PATHS = ('WillowGame.PlayerSkillTree:GetSkillState',
                     'WillowGame.SkillTreeGFxObject:GetSkillDescriptionForGrade',
                     'WillowGame.SkillTreeGFxObject:UpdateInfoBox')
_SKILLSTATE_EVENT_LIMIT = 48
_SKILLSTATE_CALLBACK_LIMIT = 2048
_SKILLSTATE_SECONDS = 90.0  # Checked on callbacks; always press STOP.
_skillstate_hooks = []
_skillstate_context = None
_skillstate_results = []
_skillstate_hits = {}
_skillstate_counts = {}
_skillstate_callbacks = 0
_skillstate_skipped = 0
_skillstate_busy = False


def _skillstate_metadata():
    """Verify loaded input/return descriptors; never read locals or out values."""
    import unrealsdk
    signatures = ((3, 28, 24), (6, 32, 20), (0, 0, 65535))
    schemas = (
        {'SkillDef': ('ObjectProperty', 128, 0),
         'OutSkillState': ('StructProperty', 384, 4), 'ReturnValue': ('BoolProperty', 1408, 24)},
        {'SkillDef': ('ObjectProperty', 128, 0), 'Grade': ('IntProperty', 128, 4),
         'GradeModifier': ('IntProperty', 128, 8), 'PlayerOwner': ('ObjectProperty', 128, 12),
         'bIncludeHTML': ('BoolProperty', 128, 16), 'ReturnValue': ('StrProperty', 4195712, 20)},
        {})
    found = {}
    for index, func in enumerate(unrealsdk.find_all('Function', exact=False)):
        if index >= 30000:
            raise ValueError('skill-state discovery exceeds 30000 functions')
        path = _trace_hook_path(func)
        if path not in _SKILLSTATE_PATHS:
            continue
        if (path in found or name(read(func, 'Class')) != 'Function'
                or name(read(func, 'Outer')) != path.split(':')[0].split('.')[-1]):
            raise ValueError('duplicate or foreign skill-state function descriptor')
        slot = _SKILLSTATE_PATHS.index(path)
        if tuple(read(func, field) for field in ('NumParams', 'ParamsSize', 'ReturnValueOffset')) != signatures[slot]:
            raise ValueError('unexpected signature metadata: ' + path)
        fields = {}
        for field_index, prop in enumerate(func._properties()):
            if field_index >= 16 or name(prop) in fields:
                raise ValueError('too many or duplicate function fields')
            fields[name(prop)] = prop
        for field, spec in schemas[slot].items():
            prop = fields.get(field)
            actual = (name(read(prop, 'Class')), read(prop, 'PropertyFlags'), read(prop, 'Offset_Internal'))
            if actual != spec or read(prop, 'ArrayDim') != 1:
                raise ValueError('unexpected parameter metadata: ' + path + '.' + field)
        for field, prop in fields.items():
            flags = read(prop, 'PropertyFlags')
            if type(flags) is not int or (field not in schemas[slot] and flags & 0x580):
                raise ValueError('unverified additional parameter flags: ' + path)
        if slot in (0, 1) and name(read(fields['SkillDef'], 'PropertyClass')) != 'SkillDefinition':
            raise ValueError('unverified skill input class')
        if slot == 1 and name(read(fields['PlayerOwner'], 'PropertyClass')) != 'WillowPlayerController':
            raise ValueError('unverified description player input class')
        if slot == 0:
            struct = read(fields['OutSkillState'], 'Struct')
            if name(read(struct, 'Class')) != 'ScriptStruct' or name(struct) != 'SkillTreeSkillStateData':
                raise ValueError('unverified native skill-state struct descriptor')
            for field_index, prop in enumerate(struct._properties()):
                if field_index >= 12:
                    log('[UVH-STATE] STRUCT metadata capped at 12 fields.')
                    break
                log('[UVH-STATE] STRUCT {} type={} flags={} offset={} array_dim={}'.format(
                    name(prop), name(read(prop, 'Class')), read(prop, 'PropertyFlags'),
                    read(prop, 'Offset_Internal'), read(prop, 'ArrayDim')))
        log('[UVH-STATE] METADATA {} signature={} fields={}'.format(
            path, signatures[slot], [(field, name(read(prop, 'Class')), read(prop, 'PropertyFlags'))
                                    for field, prop in fields.items()]))
        found[path] = func
    if set(found) != set(_SKILLSTATE_PATHS):
        raise ValueError('all three focused functions must be loaded and verified')
    return found


def stop_skillstate_trace(_option=None):
    """Clear capture before final verification and owned-hook removal/retry."""
    global _skillstate_context, _skillstate_hooks
    import unrealsdk
    context = _skillstate_context
    _skillstate_context = None
    if context is not None:
        try:
            state = _upgrade_state(context)
            log('[UVH-STATE] FINAL points={} ranks={} unchanged_from_start=True'.format(state[0], state[1]))
        except Exception as exc:
            log('[UVH-STATE] FINAL UNVERIFIED {}: {}; no refund/repair.'.format(type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:180]))
    pending = []
    for path, phase, ident in _skillstate_hooks:
        try:
            unrealsdk.hooks.remove_hook(path, phase, ident)
            if unrealsdk.hooks.has_hook(path, phase, ident):
                pending.append((path, phase, ident))
        except Exception as exc:
            pending.append((path, phase, ident))
            log('[UVH-STATE] Removal ERROR {}: {}'.format(path, type(exc).__name__))
    _skillstate_hooks = pending
    log('[UVH-STATE] STOP remaining={} captured={} callbacks={} skipped={}'.format(
        len(pending), len(_skillstate_results), _skillstate_callbacks, _skillstate_skipped))
    for path in _SKILLSTATE_PATHS:
        for label in ('UVH_DeathtrapOverclock', 'MorePep', 'Myelin'):
            count = sum(row[:2] == (path, label) for row in _skillstate_results)
            log('[UVH-STATE] SUMMARY {} skill={} captures={} {}'.format(
                path.rsplit(':', 1)[-1], label, count, 'OBSERVED' if count else 'NOT OBSERVED'))
    log('[UVH-STATE] Query Boolean is not eligibility. OutSkillState/locals were NOT read. DO NOT BUY; cancel/restart.')
    return not pending


def _skillstate_emit(path, definition, detail):
    """Reserve four captures per path/target; unrelated traffic uses no events."""
    global _skillstate_skipped
    label = name(definition)
    bucket, key = (path, label), (path, label, detail)
    if _skillstate_counts.get(bucket, 0) >= 4 or _skillstate_hits.get(key, 0) >= 2:
        _skillstate_skipped += 1
        return
    _skillstate_counts[bucket] = _skillstate_counts.get(bucket, 0) + 1
    _skillstate_hits[key] = _skillstate_hits.get(key, 0) + 1
    _skillstate_results.append(key)
    log('[UVH-STATE] RESULT {} skill={} detail={}'.format(path, label, detail))
    if len(_skillstate_results) >= _SKILLSTATE_EVENT_LIMIT:
        log('[UVH-STATE] LIMIT event bound reached.')
        stop_skillstate_trace()


def _skillstate_callback(path):
    def observe(obj, args, ret, func):
        global _skillstate_busy, _skillstate_callbacks, _skillstate_skipped
        context = _skillstate_context
        if context is None or _skillstate_busy:
            return None
        _skillstate_busy = True
        try:
            import time
            _skillstate_callbacks += 1
            if (_skillstate_callbacks >= _SKILLSTATE_CALLBACK_LIMIT
                    or time.monotonic() - context['started'] >= _SKILLSTATE_SECONDS):
                log('[UVH-STATE] LIMIT callback/time bound reached (time checked on calls).')
                stop_skillstate_trace()
                return None
            _upgrade_state(context)
            if path == _SKILLSTATE_PATHS[0]:
                if obj != context['tree']:
                    _skillstate_skipped += 1
                    return None  # No args/ret reads for a foreign tree.
                view = None
            else:
                view = _ui_view(context, obj)
                if view is None:
                    _skillstate_skipped += 1
                    return None  # Ownership checked before inputs/return text.
            if path == _SKILLSTATE_PATHS[2]:
                definition = read(obj, 'CurrentSkill_Rollover')
                if definition not in context['definitions']:
                    definition = read(obj, 'CurrentSkill')
                if definition not in context['definitions']:
                    _skillstate_skipped += 1
                    return None
                _skillstate_emit(path, definition, ('UI_VIEW',) + view)
                return None  # Zero-param UpdateInfoBox: never read args, ret or locals.
            if read(args, '_type') != context['functions'][path]:
                raise ValueError('hook input struct does not match verified function')
            definition = read(args, 'SkillDef')
            if definition not in context['definitions']:
                _skillstate_skipped += 1
                return None  # Never read out/return values for unrelated skills.
            if path == _SKILLSTATE_PATHS[0]:
                if type(ret) is not bool:
                    raise ValueError('unverified GetSkillState Boolean return')
                _skillstate_emit(path, definition, ('QUERY_RETURN', ret))
                # Hook args are copied inputs. OutSkillState is NOT a final output.
            else:
                if read(args, 'PlayerOwner') != context['pc']:
                    _skillstate_skipped += 1
                    return None
                grade, modifier, html = (read(args, field) for field in ('Grade', 'GradeModifier', 'bIncludeHTML'))
                if (type(grade) is not int or not 0 <= grade <= 128
                        or type(modifier) is not int or not -128 <= modifier <= 128
                        or type(html) is not bool or type(ret) is not str):
                    raise ValueError('unverified grade-description input/return types or bounds')
                if name(definition) not in view[:2]:
                    _skillstate_skipped += 1
                    return None
                _skillstate_emit(path, definition, ('DESCRIPTION', grade, modifier, html,
                                                   len(ret), ret[:512], view))
        except Exception as exc:
            log('[UVH-STATE] ABORT {}: {}'.format(type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:180]))
            stop_skillstate_trace()
        finally:
            _skillstate_busy = False
        return None  # Never invoke, write, block, override or return the query result.
    return observe


def start_skillstate_trace(_option=None):
    global _skillstate_context, _skillstate_results, _skillstate_hits, _skillstate_counts
    global _skillstate_callbacks, _skillstate_skipped
    import unrealsdk
    import time
    if (_skillstate_context is not None or _skillstate_hooks or _ui_context is not None or _ui_hooks
            or _upgrade_context is not None or _upgrade_hooks or _trace_hooks or _init_hooks or _init_armed):
        log('[UVH-STATE] NOT STARTED: stop other observers; initialization must be complete.')
        return False
    try:
        pc, record = get_pc(possibly_loading=True), _uvh_node_state
        if record is None or 'init_tree' not in record or len(record['skills']) != 2:
            raise ValueError('ARM before Continue as Gaige with the owned inert node')
        modes = unrealsdk.find_enum('ENetMode')
        context = dict(pc=pc, tree=record['init_tree'], record=record, pawn=read(pc, 'Pawn'),
                       world=read(pc, 'WorldInfo'), pri=read(pc, 'PlayerReplicationInfo'),
                       modes=(modes.NM_Standalone, modes.NM_ListenServer),
                       definitions=(record['node'], record['skills'][0], record['skills'][1]),
                       started=time.monotonic())
        context['baseline'] = _upgrade_state(context)
        context['functions'] = _skillstate_metadata()
        _skillstate_results, _skillstate_hits, _skillstate_counts = [], {}, {}
        _skillstate_callbacks, _skillstate_skipped = 0, 0
        for path in _SKILLSTATE_PATHS:
            phase, ident = unrealsdk.hooks.Type.POST, 'UVH_STATE_' + path.rsplit(':', 1)[-1]
            if unrealsdk.hooks.has_hook(path, phase, ident):
                raise ValueError('focused observer identifier already exists; not owned')
            if not unrealsdk.hooks.add_hook(path, phase, ident, _skillstate_callback(path)):
                raise ValueError('focused observer registration refused')
            _skillstate_hooks.append((path, phase, ident))
        _skillstate_context = context
        log('[UVH-STATE] START v0.2.9 POST observers=3 points={} ranks={} READ ONLY; DO NOT BUY.'.format(
            context['baseline'][0], context['baseline'][1]))
        log('[UVH-STATE] Four captures per function/skill; inputs/actual ret only. No OutSkillState or locals reads.')
        log('[UVH-STATE] Highlight all three; button 10 STOP, button 3 CANCEL, fully exit.')
        return True
    except Exception as exc:
        log('[UVH-STATE] NOT STARTED {}: {}'.format(type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:180]))
        if _skillstate_hooks:
            stop_skillstate_trace()
        return False


def _presentation_metadata(definition):
    """Resolve one loaded array descriptor; no discovery or native invocation."""
    import unrealsdk
    cls = read(definition, 'Class')
    if (not isinstance(cls, unrealsdk.unreal.UClass) or name(cls) != 'SkillDefinition'):
        raise ValueError('unverified SkillDefinition class metadata')
    prop = cls._find_prop('SkillEffectPresentations')  # SDK reflection, not a game call.
    inner = read(prop, 'Inner')
    presentation_class = read(inner, 'PropertyClass')
    for field, kind in ((prop, 'ArrayProperty'), (inner, 'ObjectProperty')):
        flags, offset, dim = (read(field, attr) for attr in ('PropertyFlags', 'Offset_Internal', 'ArrayDim'))
        if (name(read(field, 'Class')) != kind or type(flags) is not int or not 0 <= flags < 2 ** 64
                or flags & 0x580 or type(offset) is not int or not 0 <= offset <= 1048576
                or type(dim) is not int or dim != 1):
            raise ValueError('unverified presentation array/inner descriptor')
    if (name(prop) != 'SkillEffectPresentations' or read(prop, 'Outer') != cls
            or not isinstance(presentation_class, unrealsdk.unreal.UClass)
            or name(presentation_class) != 'AttributePresentationDefinition'):
        raise ValueError('unverified presentation property owner/element class')
    log('[UVH-PRESENT] SCHEMA skill={} type=ArrayProperty inner=ObjectProperty element_class={} flags={} offset={}'.format(
        name(definition)[:96], name(presentation_class), read(prop, 'PropertyFlags'), read(prop, 'Offset_Internal')))
    return presentation_class


def _presentation_class_fields(cls):
    """At most 16 raw descriptors, never presentation instance values or functions."""
    seen = set()
    for index, prop in enumerate(cls._properties()):
        if index >= 16:
            log('[UVH-PRESENT] METADATA CAPPED at 16 properties; remaining fields unobserved.')
            return 'CAPPED'
        field = name(prop)
        kind = name(read(prop, 'Class'))
        flags, offset, dim = (read(prop, attr) for attr in ('PropertyFlags', 'Offset_Internal', 'ArrayDim'))
        if (not field or len(field) > 96 or field in seen or not kind.endswith('Property')
                or len(kind) > 96 or type(flags) is not int
                or not 0 <= flags < 2 ** 64 or type(offset) is not int or not 0 <= offset <= 1048576
                or type(dim) is not int or not 1 <= dim <= 128):
            raise ValueError('unverified/duplicate presentation field metadata')
        seen.add(field)
        log('[UVH-PRESENT] PROPERTY {}.{} type={} flags={} offset={} array_dim={} object_class={} struct={} enum={} inner_type={}'.format(
            name(cls), field, kind, flags, offset, dim,
            name(read(prop, 'PropertyClass'))[:96] or '-', name(read(prop, 'Struct'))[:96] or '-',
            name(read(prop, 'Enum'))[:96] or '-', name(read(read(prop, 'Inner'), 'Class'))[:96] or '-'))
    log('[UVH-PRESENT] METADATA properties={} complete=True (descriptors only).'.format(len(seen)))
    return 'COMPLETE'


def _presentation_details(context, definition, metadata):
    """Read the owned target's array/count and at most four object identities."""
    import unrealsdk
    if definition not in context['definitions'] or read(definition, 'Class') != context['skill_class']:
        raise ValueError('unverified target definition identity/class')
    cls = _presentation_metadata(definition)
    if metadata.get('class') is not None and metadata['class'] != cls:
        raise ValueError('presentation element class differs between targets')
    _upgrade_state(context)  # Recheck after metadata, before the first payload read.
    values = getattr(definition, 'SkillEffectPresentations')
    if not isinstance(values, unrealsdk.unreal.WrappedArray):
        raise ValueError('unverified presentation array wrapper')
    count = len(values)
    if not 0 <= count <= 256:
        raise ValueError('presentation array size exceeds 256; no entries read')
    shown = min(count, 4)
    log('[UVH-PRESENT] ARRAY skill={} count={} sample={} capped={}'.format(name(definition)[:96], count, shown, count > shown))
    for index in range(shown):
        _upgrade_state(context)
        entry = values[index]
        if not isinstance(entry, unrealsdk.unreal.UObject) or read(entry, 'Class') != cls:
            raise ValueError('unverified presentation reference class at index ' + str(index))
        _upgrade_state(context)
        path = entry._path_name()  # SDK object identity helper only.
        if type(path) is not str or not path or len(path) > 384:
            raise ValueError('unverified/oversized presentation object path')
        log('[UVH-PRESENT] REFERENCE skill={} index={} class={} path={!r}'.format(
            name(definition)[:96], index, name(cls), path))
    _upgrade_state(context)
    if len(values) != count or read(definition, 'Class') != context['skill_class']:
        raise ValueError('presentation array length/definition class changed during snapshot')
    if not metadata:
        metadata['class'] = cls
        try:
            metadata['status'] = _presentation_class_fields(cls)
        except Exception as exc:
            metadata['status'] = 'UNAVAILABLE'
            log('[UVH-PRESENT] METADATA UNAVAILABLE {}: {}'.format(type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:180]))
    return (count, shown, metadata['status'])


def inspect_overclock_presentations(_option=None):
    """Explicit synchronous read-only comparison; installs no observers."""
    import unrealsdk
    log('[UVH-PRESENT] BEGIN v0.2.9 snapshot (READ ONLY; DO NOT BUY)')
    if (_init_armed or _init_hooks or _trace_hooks or _upgrade_context is not None or _upgrade_hooks
            or _ui_context is not None or _ui_hooks or _skillstate_context is not None or _skillstate_hooks):
        log('[UVH-PRESENT] NOT INSPECTED: initialization/other observers must be stopped.')
        return False
    try:
        pc, record = get_pc(possibly_loading=True), _uvh_node_state
        if record is None or 'init_tree' not in record or len(record['skills']) != 2:
            raise ValueError('ARM before Continue as Gaige with the owned inert node')
        modes = unrealsdk.find_enum('ENetMode')
        context = dict(pc=pc, tree=record['init_tree'], record=record, pawn=read(pc, 'Pawn'),
                       world=read(pc, 'WorldInfo'), pri=read(pc, 'PlayerReplicationInfo'),
                       modes=(modes.NM_Standalone, modes.NM_ListenServer),
                       definitions=(record['node'], record['skills'][0], record['skills'][1]),
                       skill_class=read(record['node'], 'Class'))
        context['baseline'] = _upgrade_state(context)
        log('[UVH-PRESENT] BASELINE points={} ranks={}'.format(context['baseline'][0], context['baseline'][1]))
        metadata, verified = {}, 0
        for definition in context['definitions']:
            _upgrade_state(context)
            try:
                count, shown, status = _presentation_details(context, definition, metadata)
                verified += 1
                log('[UVH-PRESENT] SUMMARY skill={} array=VERIFIED count={} references={}/{} metadata={}'.format(
                    name(definition)[:96], count, shown, count, status))
            except Exception as exc:
                log('[UVH-PRESENT] SUMMARY skill={} array=UNAVAILABLE {}: {}'.format(
                    name(definition)[:96], type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:180]))
            _upgrade_state(context)  # A changed state aborts, rather than proceeding to another target.
        state = _upgrade_state(context)
        log('[UVH-PRESENT] FINAL points={} ranks={} unchanged_from_start=True'.format(state[0], state[1]))
        log('[UVH-PRESENT] END verified_arrays={}/3 observers_added=0; no writes/native queries. Cancel and restart.'.format(verified))
        log('[UVH-PRESENT] Counts/references/metadata do not prove rendered text or eligibility. DO NOT BUY.')
        return verified == 3
    except Exception as exc:
        log('[UVH-PRESENT] ABORT {}: {}; no repair/refund attempted. CANCEL and exit.'.format(
            type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:180]))
        return False


# These four StrProperty descriptors were observed in the v0.2.8 live log.
_PRESENTATION_TEXT_FIELDS = (('Description', 68), ('NoConstraintText', 80),
                             ('Prefix', 104), ('Suffix', 92))


def _presentation_text_property(cls, field):
    """Validate one allowlisted loaded descriptor before an instance read."""
    import unrealsdk
    offsets = dict(_PRESENTATION_TEXT_FIELDS)
    if (field not in offsets or not isinstance(cls, unrealsdk.unreal.UClass)
            or name(cls) != 'AttributePresentationDefinition'):
        raise ValueError('unverified presentation text class/field')
    prop = cls._find_prop(field)  # SDK reflection only, never native formatting.
    flags, offset, dim = (read(prop, attr) for attr in ('PropertyFlags', 'Offset_Internal', 'ArrayDim'))
    if (name(prop) != field or read(prop, 'Outer') != cls
            or name(read(prop, 'Class')) != 'StrProperty'
            or type(flags) is not int or flags != 4227075
            or type(offset) is not int or offset != offsets[field]
            or type(dim) is not int or dim != 1):
        raise ValueError('text descriptor differs from verified name/owner/type/flags/offset/dimension')
    return prop


def _presentation_text_reference(context, definition, cls, count, index, entry):
    """Recheck current state and membership before/after each named text read."""
    import unrealsdk
    _upgrade_state(context)
    if (definition not in context['definitions']
            or read(definition, 'Class') != context['skill_class']
            or not isinstance(entry, unrealsdk.unreal.UObject) or read(entry, 'Class') != cls):
        raise ValueError('presentation target/reference identity or class changed')
    if _presentation_metadata(definition) != cls:
        raise ValueError('presentation element class changed')
    _upgrade_state(context)  # Metadata must not change points/ranks before payload.
    values = getattr(definition, 'SkillEffectPresentations')
    if (not isinstance(values, unrealsdk.unreal.WrappedArray) or len(values) != count
            or not 0 <= index < min(count, 4) or values[index] != entry):
        raise ValueError('presentation array length/reference changed')
    _upgrade_state(context)
    if read(entry, 'Class') != cls or read(definition, 'Class') != context['skill_class']:
        raise ValueError('presentation class changed during reference check')


def _presentation_text_details(context, definition, metadata):
    """At most four references and four escaped string values per reference."""
    import unrealsdk
    _upgrade_state(context)
    if definition not in context['definitions'] or read(definition, 'Class') != context['skill_class']:
        raise ValueError('unverified target definition identity/class')
    cls = _presentation_metadata(definition)
    if metadata.get('class') is not None and metadata['class'] != cls:
        raise ValueError('presentation element class differs between targets')
    metadata['class'] = cls  # Per-call metadata identity only; no game state write.
    _upgrade_state(context)
    values = getattr(definition, 'SkillEffectPresentations')
    if not isinstance(values, unrealsdk.unreal.WrappedArray):
        raise ValueError('unverified presentation array wrapper')
    count = len(values)
    if not 0 <= count <= 256:
        raise ValueError('presentation array size exceeds 256; no entries read')
    shown, verified = min(count, 4), 0
    log('[UVH-TEXT] ARRAY skill={} count={} sample={} capped={}'.format(
        name(definition)[:96], count, shown, count > shown))
    for index in range(shown):
        _upgrade_state(context)
        entry = values[index]
        _presentation_text_reference(context, definition, cls, count, index, entry)
        path = entry._path_name()
        _presentation_text_reference(context, definition, cls, count, index, entry)
        if type(path) is not str or not path or len(path) > 384:
            raise ValueError('unverified/oversized presentation object path')
        log('[UVH-TEXT] REFERENCE skill={} index={} class={} path={!r}'.format(
            name(definition)[:96], index, name(cls), path))
        for field, _offset in _PRESENTATION_TEXT_FIELDS:
            _presentation_text_reference(context, definition, cls, count, index, entry)
            try:
                _presentation_text_property(cls, field)
                _presentation_text_reference(context, definition, cls, count, index, entry)
                value = getattr(entry, field)
                _presentation_text_reference(context, definition, cls, count, index, entry)
                if type(value) is not str:
                    raise ValueError('text payload is not an exact string')
                log('[UVH-TEXT] VALUE skill={} index={} field={} status=VERIFIED length={} clipped={} text={!r}'.format(
                    name(definition)[:96], index, field, len(value), len(value) > 512, value[:512]))
                verified += 1
            except Exception as exc:
                log('[UVH-TEXT] VALUE skill={} index={} field={} status=UNAVAILABLE {}: {!r}'.format(
                    name(definition)[:96], index, field, type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:180]))
            # State/reference changes abort before another field, even if caught above.
            _presentation_text_reference(context, definition, cls, count, index, entry)
    _upgrade_state(context)
    current = getattr(definition, 'SkillEffectPresentations')
    if (read(definition, 'Class') != context['skill_class']
            or not isinstance(current, unrealsdk.unreal.WrappedArray) or len(current) != count):
        raise ValueError('presentation array length/definition class changed during snapshot')
    _upgrade_state(context)
    return count, shown, verified, shown * len(_PRESENTATION_TEXT_FIELDS)


def inspect_overclock_presentation_text(_option=None):
    """Explicit synchronous text comparison; no observers, evaluation or writes."""
    import unrealsdk
    log('[UVH-TEXT] BEGIN v0.2.9 snapshot (READ ONLY; DO NOT BUY)')
    if (_init_armed or _init_hooks or _trace_hooks or _upgrade_context is not None or _upgrade_hooks
            or _ui_context is not None or _ui_hooks or _skillstate_context is not None or _skillstate_hooks):
        log('[UVH-TEXT] NOT INSPECTED: initialization/other observers must be stopped.')
        return False
    try:
        pc, record = get_pc(possibly_loading=True), _uvh_node_state
        if record is None or 'init_tree' not in record or len(record['skills']) != 2:
            raise ValueError('ARM before Continue as Gaige with the owned inert node')
        modes = unrealsdk.find_enum('ENetMode')
        context = dict(pc=pc, tree=record['init_tree'], record=record, pawn=read(pc, 'Pawn'),
                       world=read(pc, 'WorldInfo'), pri=read(pc, 'PlayerReplicationInfo'),
                       modes=(modes.NM_Standalone, modes.NM_ListenServer),
                       definitions=(record['node'], record['skills'][0], record['skills'][1]),
                       skill_class=read(record['node'], 'Class'))
        context['baseline'] = _upgrade_state(context)
        log('[UVH-TEXT] BASELINE points={} ranks={}'.format(context['baseline'][0], context['baseline'][1]))
        metadata, complete, total_verified, total_fields = {}, 0, 0, 0
        for definition in context['definitions']:
            _upgrade_state(context)
            try:
                count, shown, verified, expected = _presentation_text_details(context, definition, metadata)
            except Exception as exc:
                log('[UVH-TEXT] SUMMARY skill={} array=UNAVAILABLE {}: {!r}'.format(
                    name(definition)[:96], type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:180]))
                raise  # Unknown/changing arrays/references abort before another target.
            status = 'NOT_APPLICABLE' if expected == 0 else ('VERIFIED' if verified == expected else 'PARTIAL')
            log('[UVH-TEXT] SUMMARY skill={} array=VERIFIED count={} references={}/{} fields={}/{} text={}'.format(
                name(definition)[:96], count, shown, count, verified, expected, status))
            total_verified += verified
            total_fields += expected
            complete += verified == expected
            _upgrade_state(context)
        state = _upgrade_state(context)
        log('[UVH-TEXT] FINAL points={} ranks={} unchanged_from_start=True'.format(state[0], state[1]))
        log('[UVH-TEXT] END complete_targets={}/3 fields={}/{} observers_added=0; no writes/native queries.'.format(
            complete, total_verified, total_fields))
        log('[UVH-TEXT] Raw strings are not rendered previews or eligibility. DO NOT BUY; CANCEL and exit.')
        return complete == 3
    except Exception as exc:
        log('[UVH-TEXT] ABORT {}: {!r}; no repair/refund attempted. CANCEL and exit.'.format(
            type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:180]))
        return False

Little Big Trouble is runtime branch 2 with `TierIndices=[7,8,9,10,11,12]`; runtime lists are flat rather than nested tiers inside branches. v0.2.1 replaces that unsupported solo assumption. The installed SDK networking source documents `WorldInfo.GRI.PRIArray` as the roster updated on player joins/leaves, and uses `unrealsdk.find_enum('ENetMode')` for network roles. Installed mods_base obtains the local controller through `ENGINE.GamePlayers[0].Actor`. The new gate reads those same properties without invoking native gameplay functions: allow named Standalone/ListenServer only with exactly one local player matching pc and exactly one roster entry matching pc.PlayerReplicationInfo with Owner==pc. Clients/dedicated servers, extra players, missing/loading data and identity mismatches refuse insertion. Numeric 2 alone never authorizes mutation. These field semantics are supported by installed SDK code, and the one-player listen-host positive path was verified at PRE in the successful v0.2.1 run. Refusal/peer-arrival cases remain mock-tested only. CHECK reports current session evidence even after an abort, without constructing/inserting a node. Test Offline; do not enable co-op.

- `v021_native_node_visible_and_restored.log`: at 01:12:56.828Z (October 9 18:12:56 America/Los_Angeles), Gaige PRE verified listen_host (`NetMode=2`), one local player and one roster player with both identity matches True. It constructed an independent inert SkillDefinition and verified insertion before native Initialize. POST and two later CHECK calls found exactly one candidate and both original skills among 39 runtime skills. The candidate was index 14, parent tier 7, grade 0; first-tier SkillIndices were `[13,14,15]`. Tier bUnlocked was initially False and later True. All observers were removed. CANCEL at 01:13:42.159Z verified original skills `[MorePep,Myelin]` and cells `[True,False,True]` restored. # v0.2.2: live read-only diagnostics and restoration

The user completed the requested diagnostic run and reported **"done"**.
The complete game log is preserved in `v022_purchase_rank_metadata_and_restored.log`.
This is engine evidence for button 4; it is not a purchase test. In a follow-up,
the user reported the tooltip showed **"0/1, with no upgrade prompt"**.
This confirms the displayed rank; it leaves upgrade behavior unresolved.
No native-skill tooltip comparison or purchase attempt was reported.

On October 9, 2026 at 21:12–21:13 America/Los_Angeles
(October 10 04:12–04:13 UTC):

- Two button-4 attempts at main menu refused inspection because there was no
  active recorded Gaige node. Neither attempt reached metadata discovery.
- At 04:12:12.105Z, PRE verified one owned local player and one owned PRI roster
  player in `listen_host` mode. Insertion and native initialization again produced
  one Overclock entry and both original first-tier skills among 39 runtime skills.
  Insertion observers were removed at 04:12:12.109Z.
- Four completed snapshots began at 04:12:27.379Z, 04:12:28.124Z,
  04:13:13.096Z and 04:13:13.732Z. Every snapshot passed the recorded/current
  tree, solo session, native patch, runtime entry and first-tier checks.
- Every snapshot reported `PRI.GeneralSkillPoints=1`,
  `PRI.SpecialistSkillPoints=0`, and Overclock rank 0 / max rank 1 / starting rank 0.
  The controller's equivalent point fields were unavailable (`<none>`);
  the diagnostic reported this rather than inventing values.
- The node remained index 14 / tier 7, with `unlocked=True` and
  `unlock_points=0`. Both MorePep and Myelin had one runtime entry at rank 0.
- Overclock's `SkillClass=Skill`, with grade rules enabled, matched the two
  original definitions. Its constraints, effects and activation/deactivation
  actions were empty. The originals each had one constraint; that difference
  alone does not establish a defect or purchase eligibility.
- `SkillType` printed as `<ESkillType len=0>` for all three definitions. This
  formatting does not expose the enum value; do not infer their types are equal.
- Each metadata scan inspected 20120 objects, discovered 53 function paths,
  logged 32 paths and detailed 12 functions. Reflection produced field
  descriptors without invoking the discovered functions.
- At 04:13:14.619Z, cancellation reported `RESTORE result=True` with
  skills `['MorePep', 'Myelin']` and cells `[True, False, True]`.
  A second cancellation had no remaining patch; observers remained zero.
  The preserved log contains no ERROR or Traceback entry.

The four snapshots show unchanged sampled points and ranks. Their timestamps
do not establish exactly when the user hovered the tooltip. The log cannot prove
save-file equality, a point refund, purchase eligibility/cost or persistence.
The mod's button-4 source performs reads and reflection only, with no native
purchase/grade/reset/save calls. No saves were parsed, edited or restored by Codex.
BL2 was not running when Codex checked processes after preserving the log.
Use a fresh game process before normal play; native-array restoration alone does
not rewrite the cached prototype tree.

## Metadata interpretation

Observed descriptors include `PlayerSkillTree:UpgradeSkill` (SkillDefinition
argument and Boolean return), `SetSkillGrade` (SkillDefinition, integer grade and
Boolean return), `WillowPlayerController:GetSkillUpgradeCost` (SkillDefinition and
integer return), and `PlayerSkillTree:GetSkillState` (SkillDefinition, out
SkillTreeSkillStateData struct and Boolean return). These are raw descriptors,
not verified callable signatures or permission to invoke these functions.

`_properties()` also returns local fields: `GetSkillGradeByDef.SkillState` has
flags 0 / offset 8 while ParamsSize is 8; `ApplySkillSaveGameData.SPD` has flags 0.
Do not treat every enumerated property as a function argument. Save/reset/grade
functions were inspected as metadata only and must remain uncalled in this scope.

## Preserved artifacts

The installed runtime and pyproject matched the workspace byte for byte at review.
Keep both versioned ZIPs unchanged. Documentation updates may rebuild only the
default ZIP, with the same runtime source and version.
After the status updates, syntax compilation, isolated package import and exact
three-file ZIP/source verification passed again. Runtime and both versioned-ZIP
hashes remained unchanged; only the default ZIP's README was updated.

```markdown
# v0.2.3: investigate the absent upgrade prompt

After v0.2.2, the user reported Overclock's tooltip showed
**"0/1, with no upgrade prompt"**. The engine log shows one unspent general point,
an unlocked first tier and grade 0. This is enough to investigate the UI path;
it does not prove an incorrect SkillType, missing constraint or purchase defect.
The user has not compared the native first-row skills' prompts in the same UI.

Two limitations in v0.2.2's diagnostics are addressed:

- `_tree_info` uses `len()` on values it cannot classify. SDK enum members are
  IntFlag values, so `<ESkillType len=0>` does not print their actual name/value.
  v0.2.3's purchase-only formatter explicitly reads Python Enum name/value.
  The general formatter and all established v0.2.1 functions stay unchanged.
- v0.2.2 logged only constraint counts and prioritized purchase/reset/save
  function metadata. v0.2.3 reads up to four SkillConstraintData structs per
  definition, up to eight reflected property values per struct, and the
  LockedSkillDetailStr. Unknown struct types are not traversed. It does not
  evaluate constraints, follow their object graphs or copy them into Overclock.
  Metadata detail now prioritizes CanUpgradeSkill, Flash_SetSkillPointProperties
  and its _AS variant alongside cost/state/grade/description query metadata.
  The existing limits remain 30000 scanned objects, 32 paths, 12 detailed
  functions and 16 fields per function. No discovered function is invoked.

Primary SDK reference: [pyunrealsdk enum bindings](https://github.com/bl-sdk/pyunrealsdk/blob/master/src/pyunrealsdk/unreal_bindings/uenum.cpp).
The installed v1.10.0 `_uenum.pyi` independently describes IntFlag enums.
The installed WrappedStruct stub documents `_type`; its UStruct metadata
supports `_properties()`. These are read as data, never executed as scripts.

Only the two existing v0.2.2 diagnostic functions changed, plus two new helpers
and version/description metadata. No new hooks, gameplay calls, loads or writes.
The node constructor, solo guards, insertion/rollback and manual duration
functions remain unchanged. Test source models enum values and constraint
descriptors, but it cannot establish real-engine UI behavior.

Local validation: 41 simulated tests passed, including zero-valued enum display,
constraint field output without evaluation, bounds, unknown struct refusal,
reflection failures and upgrade-UI metadata priority. Syntax compilation,
isolated packaged-runtime import and exact three-file ZIP/source verification
also passed. AST comparison verified all 48 v0.2.1 function bodies unchanged;
against v0.2.2, only the two diagnostic functions changed. Both tested ZIP hashes
and the v0.2.2 log hash were verified unchanged. At build time there was no live
result; the later v0.2.3 run is documented in v023_live_diagnostic_result.md.

Install ZIP: `dist/UltimateVaultHunterDeathtrapBoost_v0.2.3_folder_install.zip`
(21349 bytes). SHA256:
`4573834f5bfad6f8eb4bc8c34051c3edfa4e893ba22e358ce5761431d1e17de6`.

Run the documented backed-up Gaige Offline test: ARM, Continue, button 4, compare
Overclock/More Pep/Myelin tooltips without purchasing, button 4 again, CANCEL,
exit. Record whether each skill shows an upgrade prompt or locked message using
the same input method. Do not respec, travel, buy any skill or use manual boost.
Preserve the log before restarting; use a fresh process before normal play.

Follow-up: the next user run still loaded v0.2.2, confirmed by log headers and
installed hashes. See v022_repeat_rank_preview_clarification.md. The user meant
missing orange rank-upgrade text; do not infer a purchase failure. A subsequent
run correctly loaded v0.2.3 and verified its diagnostic reads and restoration.
The user confirmed the blue title and inactive prototype description. The current
snapshot milestone is complete; see v023_live_diagnostic_result.md. Preserve the
tested v0.2.3 ZIP alongside earlier baselines; no runtime change was needed.

  has one entry. The diagnostic did not traverse that array or evaluate/copy

- Each metadata scan inspected 20120 objects, discovered 53 function paths,

## Useful metadata, not observed gameplay calls

`SkillTreeGFxObject:CanUpgradeSkill` has one parameter descriptor, a return byte
with enum **ESkillTreeFailureReason**, ParamsSize 1 / return offset 0. Its `retVal`
and `SkillState` descriptors have flags 0 and are locals. Do not assume a Boolean
return or a SkillDefinition argument. No return value was actually captured.

`Flash_SetSkillPointProperties` has zero parameters; its `_AS` variant has one
four-byte parameter. Other detailed functions include GetSkillUpgradeCost,
GetSkillState, GetSkillGradeByDef and GetSkillDescriptionForGrade. Discovery and
reflection do not invoke any of them or verify callable semantics.

The four sampled point/rank values stayed unchanged. The log does not prove
save-file equality, purchase cost/eligibility, refunds, persistence or the
node's +15-second effect. No saves were parsed, edited or restored by Codex.
The established manual +15-second feature remains separate and unchanged.

# v0.2.4: live setup/stop/restoration passed; zero observed calls

The user initially said "done" and described an unsuccessful in-map arm,
returning to main menu, arming and loading again, then button 5 working.
They subsequently confirmed that all three skills were highlighted after
button 5. They also clarified that BL2 was still open and button 3 had not
yet been pressed. After the follow-up they pressed 3 and closed BL2, confirming
"Done — restored and exited". Do not mistake the first report for a completed
restoration or rely on the initial process-name probe as proof of closure.

The initial snapshot is v024_user_test.log (16459 bytes). The completed log is
v024_upgrade_observers_zero_calls_and_restored.log (20349 bytes); it extends the
initial snapshot. Both are preserved byte for byte. Installed pyproject is
v0.2.4 and installed runtime SHA256 matches the workspace/versioned package.
No source code changed during this review. Keep all four versioned ZIPs intact.

## Observed sequence (October 10 UTC / October 9 Pacific)

- 05:38:03.692, 05:38:04.917 and 05:39:49.448: ARM refused because Gaige was
  already loaded; it required returning to main menu. Three early observer-start
  attempts also refused because there was no owned node record. No insertion
  or diagnostic hooks were started by these attempts. The user recalls button
  4 in the early sequence; the preserved log contains no button-4 snapshot
  headers, so do not infer a completed snapshot from that recollection.
- 05:40:46.690: ARM accepted at main menu. A repeat press reported already armed.
- 05:40:50.966–.973: PRE verified NetMode=2/listen_host, one owned local player
  and one owned roster player. It constructed the independent inert definition
  and verified insertion before the native initializer. Runtime readback had
  one candidate and both originals among 39 skills, node grade 0/index14/tier7,
  first-tier indices [13,14,15]. bUnlocked=False at this initialization snapshot;
  later tier unlock state was not sampled. This initial value also occurred in
  earlier successful runs and is not evidence of a persistent locked tier.
  Initialization observers were removed (remaining=0).
- 05:41:03.856: START v0.2.4 registered both POST observers. Preflight passed
  loaded function descriptors, SDK enum type, current owned tree, inert node,
  solo rosters and known points/ranks/indices. PRI points=(1,0), ranks=(0,0,0)
  in node/MorePep/Myelin order. A repeat start correctly refused an active trace.
- The user confirmed opening Skills and highlighting all three definitions.
  The log itself does not show UI navigation events or selected UI objects.
- 05:41:32.672: STOP verified final points=(1,0), ranks=(0,0,0), unchanged from
  start. remaining=0, captured=0, callbacks=0, skipped=0; all six summaries [].
  The observer window was about 28.8 seconds, below the 90-second bound.
  Another STOP at 05:41:33.767 remained zero. There was no timeout/error abort.
- 05:44:44.923–.924: after the clarification, CANCEL again verified observers
  zero, then RESTORE result=True: original skills MorePep/Myelin and cells
  True/False/True restored via assignment. NATIVE ARRAYS RESTORED was logged.
- 05:44:45.939: another cancellation had no remaining initialization patch
  and observers stayed zero. The user confirmed exiting the game afterward.
- No ERROR or Traceback appears in the completed log. The SDK's unrelated
  deprecated-legacy-import warning remains present.

## What passed and what remains unknown

v0.2.4's engine-tested paths now include in-map ARM/start refusal, accepted
menu ARM, insertion/runtime registration, observer preflight/registration,
duplicate-start refusal, final direct state check, observer removal, native
array restoration and repeated cancellation. The installed version is correct.
The user's "it worked" supports node visibility/setup, not an observed upgrade
result. Sampled points/ranks were unchanged; save-file equality is not proven.

Zero callbacks means neither installed observer received a call during the
window. It is not an ownership-filter rejection (skipped was also zero), a
returned failure reason, or proof that either function never runs elsewhere.
Cause remains unresolved: these query paths may not be reached by ordinary
highlighting, another UI path may be active, or dispatch/hook behavior may differ.
Do not choose between those hypotheses without evidence. The callbacks' actual
UI ownership/selection/return wrapper behavior remains mock-tested only.
Cost, eligibility, purchase, refund, persistence and the node effect are unverified.

Do not ask the user to repeat the same two-hook test or force a query by buying.
Next useful work is a bounded, opt-in trace of loaded UI navigation/refresh
functions plus direct owned-UI selection data, using exact discovered metadata
and all existing solo/tree/point/rank guards. Confirm observed functions and
ownership rather than guessing paths, invoking queries or bypassing rules.
Purchase work still requires explicit user scope and point/grade/save recovery.

# v0.2.4: opt-in natural upgrade-call observers

The user's "next step" continues development after the completed v0.2.3
metadata diagnostic. This build obtains new evidence: actual normal UI query
results, without asking the user to spend points. It is not a purchase fix.
The initial live setup/cleanup result is now preserved, with zero callbacks;
see v024_live_observer_result.md. Actual query results remain unverified. The node remains inert and manual +15
seconds remains independent. All tested v0.2.1/v0.2.2/v0.2.3 ZIPs are preserved.

## Evidence used to select the observation

The preserved v0.2.3 log directly contains both loaded UFunction descriptors:

| Function | NumParams / ParamsSize / ReturnOffset | Parameter descriptors |
|--|--|--|
| SkillTreeGFxObject:CanUpgradeSkill | 1 / 1 / 0 | ReturnValue ByteProperty, flags 1408, offset 0, enum ESkillTreeFailureReason |
| WillowPlayerController:GetSkillUpgradeCost | 2 / 8 / 4 | Skill ObjectProperty flags 128 offset 0, class SkillDefinition; ReturnValue IntProperty flags 1408 offset 4 |

CanUpgradeSkill's other reflected fields have flags zero and are locals;
there is no skill-definition input descriptor. The eligibility observer reads
the UI's CurrentSkill and reports CurrentSkill_Rollover separately.
The [UnspecSkills author's source](https://github.com/ZetaDaemon/bl-sdk-mods/blob/main/UnspecSkills/__init__.py)
uses CurrentSkill, CurrentSkill_Rollover and WPCOwner in SkillTreeGFxObject
callbacks. That supports field names but does not verify this new observer's
live ownership/selection timing. No mutating code from that mod is used.

The installed pyunrealsdk v1.10.0 hooks stub documents POST as called after a
function is allowed to execute, with (obj,args,ret,func). Actual ret is used;
args.ReturnValue may differ. The observers return None and never invoke func.
SDK stubs are read as data only. Previous init traces establish hook support,
not these new query timings/results. No UFunction is invoked to check metadata.

## Implementation and bounds

New buttons 5/6 start/stop only the two POST hooks above. Import is inert.
Startup scans <=30000 loaded functions and <=16 fields each, requiring the
observed descriptors and known SDK enum type. Both registrations must succeed.
No PRE hooks, block/return/argument overrides or package loads.

Quiet bounded state reads verify exact current controller/Gaige/pawn/world/PRI,
recorded/current owned tree, sole local and roster players, SDK-named allowed
NetMode, exact native candidate/original arrays and empty gameplay effect/actions.
All three runtime entries must be unique and owned, with valid index/first tier.
Known nonnegative PRI general/specialist points and grades/indices are captured
at start and must remain unchanged. Candidate grade must be zero. STOP checks
final state too. Changed state is reported, never repaired/refunded.

UI callbacks require exact class SkillTreeGFxObject, WPCOwner==pc and CurrentSkill
among the three definitions. Cost callbacks require obj==pc and args.Skill among
them. Unknown ownership/selection refuses capture; bounded IGNORED logs assist
diagnosis. Eligibility ret must be a named member of the SDK's
ESkillTreeFailureReason type, including value-zero members; it is not Boolean.
Cost ret must be an exact nonnegative int. Unknown result types abort observation.

At most 24 captures, 2048 attempts including foreign calls, two copies of each
path/definition/result. Ninety seconds checked on the next call; no background
timer. Always manually STOP. Stop/cancel/disable/errors/session changes/limits
clear context before hook removal. Failed removals retain inert hooks for retry;
restart is refused while any remain. Summary [] means NOT OBSERVED.

Of 48 v0.2.1 functions, 47 remain AST-identical. Only cancel_init_node adds
stop_upgrade_trace before existing cleanup/rollback. The v0.2.3 snapshot changes
only its version header. Constructor, initialization, guards, rollback and
manual inspect/apply/restore remain unchanged. No save/point/grade/duration writes
are introduced by the observers. Existing explicitly armed insertion is still
mutating and still requires a backed-up solo Gaige, cancel and a fresh process.

## Local verification, not engine proof

57 unique mock tests passed (41 established, 16 new). They cover actual POST
ret versus mismatching args.ReturnValue; zero enum; selected versus rollover;
native comparisons; ownership/unknown types; exact metadata and bounds;
missing enum/points/rank/tree/concurrent trace; state/peer/point/rank/index/effect
changes; reentrancy/errors; capture/time/callback bounds; partial registration;
foreign hook ownership; removal failure/inert retry; cancel/disable cleanup;
final-point change without another UI call; import and preserved manual boost.
Observers never invoke the supplied native function, discovery or mutation APIs
in callbacks, and preserve the mocked game fields. Tests cannot establish engine
wrapper behavior, UI timing, query results, purchase or save-file equality.

Syntax compilation, exact-three-file ZIP/source/integrity inspection and isolated
packaged-runtime import pass. AST comparison verifies the exceptions above;
baseline ZIP hashes remain unchanged. New build hashes are recorded below after
packaging. Test steps/expected log tags are in docs/NEXT_CODEX_TASK.md.

## Review and later milestones

On "done", preserve/hash the log before another launch. Verify installed version,
START/RESULT/FINAL/STOP remaining=0 and native-array RESTORE result=True.
If there are no eligible calls, record that without claiming failure. Actual
returns describe UI checks at that moment; they do not prove successful point
spending/refunds, rank persistence or the +15-second node effect.
Only later, explicitly authorized purchase work may proceed after a concrete
point/grade/save recovery plan. Native-array rollback alone cannot undo a purchase.

# v0.2.5: owned UI selected Overclock and both originals; restoration passed

The user reported "done" after the requested v0.2.5 test. The preserved complete
log is v025_user_test.log (30099 bytes). Installed pyproject is v0.2.5 and the
installed runtime matches workspace/versioned-ZIP source byte for byte.
No runtime code changes during this review. Keep the v0.2.5 versioned ZIP
unchanged alongside all four earlier tested ZIPs.

## Observed on October 9, 2026, 23:16–23:17 Pacific

UTC timestamps below are October 10:

- 06:16:15.792: ARM accepted before Gaige loaded. Initialization again verified
  the solo session, inserted one inert candidate before native initialization,
  registered exactly one node plus both originals among 39 runtime skills,
  and removed initialization observers (remaining=0).
- 06:16:30.502: function discovery scanned 20120 objects, found 24 canonical
  SkillTreeGFxObject candidates and selected 10. Metadata reflection succeeded.
  START inventory scanned one UI object but found zero owned views; no live
  selection snapshot was printed. This does not prove no live UI existed.
- 06:16:30.510: START registered 20 PRE/POST_ANY observers with baseline
  points=(1,0), ranks=(0,0,0) in node/MorePep/Myelin order. Repeat start refused
  an active trace. The observed window lasted about 56.7 seconds, within limits.
- 06:16:36.868–.870: Init PRE had unavailable current/rollover; POST_ANY selected
  Skill_DeathTrap. Both phases verified exact UI class/WPCOwner and current
  Gaige/tree/session/point/rank guards. UI points=1 and target tier unlocked=True.
- extInitTree recorded four events, retaining Skill_DeathTrap selection.
- Navigation then selected the node and both originals, with matching hovered
  definitions, verified owned runtime registration/index, UI points=1 and
  target tier unlocked=True in every captured navigation event:

| UTC POST_ANY event | Function | Before -> after current/rollover |
|--|--|--|
| 06:16:38.805 | Nav_Down | Skill_DeathTrap -> UVH_DeathtrapOverclock |
| 06:16:40.143 | Nav_Left | UVH_DeathtrapOverclock -> MorePep |
| 06:16:44.691 | Nav_Right | MorePep -> UVH_DeathtrapOverclock |
| 06:16:50.919 | Nav_Right | UVH_DeathtrapOverclock -> Myelin |

- 06:17:27.201: FINAL points=(1,0), ranks=(0,0,0), unchanged_from_start=True.
  STOP inventory again scanned one UI object and printed zero owned views.
- 06:17:27.208: STOP remaining=0, captured=14, callbacks=16, skipped=2.
  Captured counts: Init 2, extInitTree 4, Nav_Down 2, Nav_Left 2, Nav_Right 4.
  No IGNORED owner/class entries appear; the two skips are duplicate suppression.
  There was no error or limit abort. Final UI/upgrade/init observer counts were zero.
- The same cancellation verified RESTORE result=True: native MorePep/Myelin
  skills and True/False/True occupancy restored, then NATIVE ARRAYS RESTORED.
  A repeat cancellation at 06:17:27.652 found no remaining patch and observers
  stayed zero. The log proves restoration; the user's "done" follows the
  instructions to exit. Process closure was not independently probed.
- No ERROR or Traceback appears. An unrelated SDK legacy-import deprecation
  warning remains present. No save files were read, edited or restored by Codex.

## What this establishes

The new observer callback path works in engine, and its guarded UI ownership/
selection reads accepted the real wrapper types. The owned native UI navigated
to Overclock and both originals with one available UI point and the target
tier unlocked. The custom definition participates in current and rollover
selection. Sampled PRI points and all three grades stayed unchanged; cleanup
and native-array rollback passed. This is useful evidence beyond visibility.

POST_ANY does not independently prove a native function executed if another
hook blocked it; the actual before/after selection fields are direct observations.
One UI point and an unlocked tier are not an eligibility result. Cost/purchase/
refund/save persistence and the node's +15-second effect remain unverified.
The start/stop inventories did not expose owned views outside Skills, so do
not infer that the live UI was missing from those counts. Save equality is not proven.

## Candidate-selection limitation and next useful change

The broad selection-name filter prioritized artifact-related functions before
the skill-navigation helpers, consuming four slots in the ten-function cap.
Selected paths were Init, extInitTree, ArtifactSelect, EquipSelectedArtifact,
Flash_UpdateArtifactSelection, Nav_Back, Nav_Down, Nav_DownArtifact, Nav_Left,
Nav_Right. No artifact function event was captured; these observers did not
invoke/equip anything. They nevertheless reduced relevant coverage.

Navigate, PostNav, HandleInputKey, UpdateInfoBox and both
Flash_SetSkillPointProperties variants were DISCOVERED but NOT HOOKED.
The log therefore says nothing about their call activity. Cost/eligibility
observers were not started in this run; their empty STOP summaries are not
an observation of those functions during this window.

Next useful work: explicitly prioritize these now-discovered core skill UI
paths, exclude artifact/equip functions and retain the proven navigation/Init
anchors inside a bounded observer set. Re-discover/verify loaded metadata each
run; never hook an undiscovered path or call a function to manufacture evidence.
Preserve ownership/solo/unchanged-point/rank guards, passive callbacks and cleanup.
Add a regression where unrelated artifact candidates would otherwise crowd out
PostNav/input/info/point-display coverage. No new runtime or test is ready yet.
Do not repeat unchanged v0.2.5 solely for selection confirmation or buy a point
