```markdown
# v0.2.5: bounded read-only UI navigation/refresh trace

The user authorized continuing with "lets start" after v0.2.4 setup/stop/
restoration passed with zero callbacks despite all three skills being highlighted.
This is a different observation: discovered navigation/refresh functions and
owned UI selection snapshots, not another run of the same cost/eligibility hooks.
Source/package is v0.2.5; the later live selection/restoration result is now
recorded in v025_live_ui_trace_result.md. Actual eligibility/cost are unverified. Purchase/effect/persistence
remain out of scope. Preserve all five tested versioned ZIPs unchanged.

## Why these observations

The v0.1.9 game log captured SkillTreeGFxObject.Init and extInitTree when Skills
opened, so loaded versions of those functions are preferred anchors. The
[UnspecSkills author's source](https://github.com/ZetaDaemon/bl-sdk-mods/blob/main/UnspecSkills/__init__.py)
uses HandleInputKey, PostNav, UpdateInfoBox and other UI refresh methods, plus
CurrentSkill, CurrentSkill_Rollover, WPCOwner and NumSkillPoints. This supports
names only; current loaded metadata must still supply every hook path.
No mutating code or native calls from that mod are copied. UI field semantics
and navigation timing must be verified in our engine run, not assumed from it.

Installed pyunrealsdk v1.10.0 hooks documentation supports PRE and
POST_UNCONDITIONAL (used as POST_ANY in logs). PRE returns None; POST_ANY runs
even if another hook blocks the function. Neither phase invokes func, reads or
edits args/ret, blocks or overrides. Events report phase/selected state and do
not establish that a blocked function executed or returned an eligibility result.
SDK stubs were read as data only, never executed.

## Discovery and scope

Explicit button 7 only. Scan <=30000 loaded Function objects, accepting exact
Class Function / Outer SkillTreeGFxObject / canonical WillowGame.Class:Method
metadata; reject nested/state/foreign and duplicate paths. Method-name filters
cover navigation, rollover, selection, input, info, initialization and refresh.
Cost/CanUpgradeSkill/RequestSkillUpgrade are not selected by those filters.
Prioritize observed Init/extInitTree anchors, then navigation, input and info.
Log <=24 candidates and <=8 raw field descriptors for each of <=10 hooked
functions. Raw fields include locals and are not callable signatures. No args
are accessed, and no native function is invoked to verify them. Reflection or
registration failure aborts and cleans up all owned partial registrations.

Reuse the unchanged v0.2.4 _upgrade_state guard at start and every callback:
same Gaige/controller/pawn/world/PRI/current recorded tree, inert grade-zero
node, exact native candidate/original arrays, unique owned runtime entries,
valid indices/first tier, SDK-named solo mode and exactly one owned local and
roster player. Both PRI point fields and all three grades/indices stay unchanged.
Changed/unknown state removes observers without refund, repair or native-array edits.

Read CurrentSkill/CurrentSkill_Rollover only on exact SkillTreeGFxObject whose
WPCOwner equals the guarded controller. Each non-null definition must have the
exact SkillDefinition class, one runtime registration owned by this tree and
a valid index resolving to that definition. Foreign/unknown selection receives
an unverified/unavailable label, not an inferred skill identity. Verified other
skills may be logged to show where navigation starts. NumSkillPoints must be
an exact nonnegative int; target first-tier bUnlocked must be Boolean. These
are direct UI/tier fields, not proof of eligibility or cost.

Start/stop also scan <=32 SkillTreeGFxObject instances and print <=4 owned views.
No owned UI at start is allowed because first opening Skills may create it.
These snapshots can supply selected/hovered state even with zero hook callbacks;
the selection at STOP may differ after leaving Skills. No selection is forced.

## Limits and cleanup

<=10 functions / 20 hooks, 48 captured events, 2048 callback attempts (including
foreign UI), two copies of each path/phase/view, 90 seconds checked on the next
call. There is no background timer; always press STOP. Reentrancy is ignored.
Context is cleared before stop/cancel/disable/error/state-change/limit cleanup.
Failed removal retains inert hooks for retry and prevents another trace start.
New UI and old upgrade traces refuse overlapping starts. Existing loading/legacy
buttons remain for history; use only 1,7,8,3 in this test.

Among the v0.2.4 functions, only three change: cancel_init_node adds UI cleanup;
inspect_overclock_purchase updates its version header; start_upgrade_trace adds
UI mutual exclusion and a version label. All other established functions remain
AST-identical, including _upgrade_state, manual duration and native insertion/
rollback. Of the original v0.2.1 functions, only cancellation adds cleanup.
No observer-driven game writes, game-console commands, save edits or effects.

## Local checks and evidence limits

71 unique mock tests pass: 57 established plus 14 UI cases. New cases cover
PRE/POST_ANY selection changes without args/ret/native calls/writes; direct
zero-call inventories; unknown/foreign selection/ownership; exact metadata,
priority and scan/field/function/object/output bounds; no UI yet; missing state;
mutual exclusion; peer/point/rank/tree/effect changes; duplicate/event/time/
callback limits; partial registration and foreign hook preservation; inert
failed-removal retry; reentrancy/errors; cancel/disable and final-point changes.
Syntax, exact-three-file ZIP/source/integrity and isolated import checks pass.
Mocks cannot establish UI events, real wrappers, eligibility, cost or save equality.

## Test and review

Close BL2, replace one mod folder from v0.2.5 ZIP. Offline/backed-up solo Gaige.
Verify MODS title v0.2.5; press 1 at MAIN MENU before Continue. In map press 7,
then open Skills and hover/highlight Overclock/More Pep/Myelin, also using arrow
keys/controller navigation if available, about five seconds each. Do not press
purchase controls, respec or travel. Finish within 90 seconds. Press 8, then 3,
fully exit and tell Codex done. An abort/empty result is evidence, not a reason
to buy or invoke a function. See docs/NEXT_CODEX_TASK.md for expected tags.

On done, preserve the final log before relaunch and confirm restoration/closure.
Review discovered paths and PRE/POST_ANY events plus owned start/stop snapshots;
distinguish callbacks=0 from foreign-owner skips or unverified selections.
Require final points/ranks unchanged, both trace types/init observers removed
and native-array RESTORE result=True. Purchase work still needs actual
eligibility evidence plus explicit authorization and point/grade/save recovery.
```

### evidence/v026_core_ui_trace_plan.md

Origin: Project file. Original bytes: 6448. SHA256: 4c98ffa6d1a7fc082ee1b91b85d91d6125ff1aa2cfc39ab96e8272c9093d13d6. UTF-8 BOM: False. Original newline style: CRLF. Trailing LF: True.

```markdown
# v0.2.6: prioritize discovered core skill UI functions

Later live result: v026_live_core_ui_result.md verifies all six helpers,
event-limit cleanup and restoration. This document records the build design.

This build follows the preserved v0.2.5 live result, not a purchase attempt.
See v025_live_ui_trace_result.md: native owned selection/restoration passed,
but the ten-function cap selected four artifact paths and omitted six helpers.
Those helpers were discovered, not hooked; no call conclusion follows.
At build time no v0.2.6 game result existed.

## Runtime change

Only _ui_candidates changes behavior. Exclude method names containing artifact
or equip (case-insensitive) before descriptor reflection. Prioritize this exact
order among the canonical loaded descriptors actually found:

1. PostNav
2. Navigate
3. HandleInputKey
4. UpdateInfoBox
5. Flash_SetSkillPointProperties
6. Flash_SetSkillPointProperties_AS
7. Init
8. Nav_Down
9. Nav_Left
10. Nav_Right

All ten names were discovered in the preserved game log. Init and the three
navigation methods produced useful owned selection events. extInitTree,
Nav_Up, Nav_Back and Flash_SendInitialSkillData are lower-priority fallbacks,
followed by the other discovered matching methods in deterministic path order.
The priority list never creates a hook path. Each run revalidates exact Function
class, SkillTreeGFxObject outer and canonical WillowGame.SkillTreeGFxObject path.
Nested/foreign/duplicate metadata is rejected as before.

The cap stays ten functions/twenty hooks. CANDIDATE remains discovery only;
new SELECTED entries identify the actual chosen set alongside raw METADATA.
Reflection stays <=8 fields per selected function, discovery <=30000 objects,
candidate logging <=24. Raw properties may include locals; no signature inference.

Among the other existing functions, inspect_overclock_purchase,
start_upgrade_trace and start_ui_trace change version labels only.
The other 59 functions remain AST-identical to the v0.2.5 ZIP. Insertion,
native rollback, solo/current-state guard, UI callbacks/cleanup and verified
manual +15-second duration prototype are unchanged. Factory metadata/title
and button 7's display label identify v0.2.6. The same 17 buttons remain.

## Preserved observation requirements

PRE and POST_UNCONDITIONAL callbacks return None. POST_ANY can fire for a
call another mod blocked; it does not establish execution. No args/ret reads,
native invocation, overriding/blocking, package loads or observer game-state
writes. Normal UI activity is the sole source of events.

Reuse the unchanged current Gaige/controller/pawn/world/PRI/tree, exact owned
inert patch/runtime registration/index, both sole-player rosters and known
unchanged point/rank guard. Candidate grade remains zero. Require exact UI
class and WPCOwner==pc before reading its selection. Current and rollover
are separate; each definition must have a unique owned runtime entry/index.
Unknown data is unavailable/unverified, never guessed.

Direct UI points/tier-unlock/selection observations are not actual eligibility
or cost. Merely observing a point-display function still does not read its
arguments. Inventories remain <=32 objects/<=4 printed owned views; zero owned
views outside Skills does not establish that a live UI is missing.

Bounds stay 48 events, 2048 attempts including foreign UI, two copies per
state, 90 seconds checked on the next callback. No background timer: STOP
is required. Stop/cancel/disable/error/state change/limits clear capture first.
Failed hook removals stay inert and retained for retry; refuse overlapping
UI/upgrade/init/loading traces. Do not widen or bypass guards to get events.

## Local validation and game test

74 unique mocks pass. Three new regressions cover:

- All 24 names from the v0.2.5 live discovery plus 30 unrelated selection
  candidates. The six missed helpers and four proven anchors fit ten slots,
  independent of discovery order. Selected helpers register passive callbacks,
  capture owned state and remove cleanly without point changes.
- Missing/foreign/nested/wrong-class priority methods cannot manufacture
  paths. Loaded dot-form paths normalize to the existing canonical form.
- Artifact/equip descriptors are excluded before reflection, using poison
  descriptors to detect accidental inspection.

Before the fix, the UI suite ran 17 cases with two failures: the live crowding
case omitted all six core helpers and the poison artifact case refused startup.
The missing/foreign metadata case already passed. After the fix, all 74 tests
passed. Syntax and isolated package import/layout/source checks are required
before shipping. All five tested v0.2.1-v0.2.5 ZIPs and the v0.2.5 log stay intact.

Follow docs/NEXT_CODEX_TASK.md: close BL2, install only this project folder,
verify exact v0.2.6 title at main menu, 1 ARM before Continue as backed-up Gaige
Offline, 7 START in map, open Skills/navigate all three without clicking/buying,
8 STOP, 3 CANCEL, fully exit. Use only 1,7,8,3; no point spending/respec/travel.
Preserve/hash the final log before relaunch. Partial/empty/limit results are
evidence, not a reason to buy or force a native query.

Verify installed version/hash, actual SELECTED paths, owned events per method,
sampled final points/ranks, zero observers and RESTORE result=True with original
MorePep/Myelin and True/False/True occupancy. Clarify completion if final
cleanup/exit evidence is missing. No node effect, refund/save persistence,
co-op or release claim. Any later purchase needs explicit authorization and
```

### evidence/v027_focused_state_plan.md

Origin: Project file. Original bytes: 10384. SHA256: bb6a3f2d5a0cc2375bdd610eaa713ea2ac6997a3a6ea726016e1e9bb0e4d6f09. UTF-8 BOM: False. Original newline style: LF. Trailing LF: True.

```markdown
# v0.2.7: passive target query/description observation

This is the pre-test design record. The run is now complete; see
v027_live_focused_state_result.md and the later result section below.

v0.2.6 verified all six core helpers, including node UpdateInfoBox, but broad
input/navigation traffic consumed 48 events before Myelin. Preserve that log
and the six tested versioned ZIPs. This build observes only three natural calls
with capture quotas per function/target. At build time no v0.2.7 game result existed.

## SDK finding that changes the design

Installed unrealsdk v3.2.0 / pyunrealsdk v1.10.0 stubs were read as documentation
only, never executed. hooks.add_hook documents a separate actual ret argument;
args.ReturnValue may be incorrect. POST runs only for an allowed function.
BoundFunction.__call__'s output tuple is a different API and is not a hook return.
The Python hook binding converts only the return property before dispatching
the callback. See the [primary binding implementation](https://github.com/bl-sdk/pyunrealsdk/blob/master/src/pyunrealsdk/hook.cpp).

The BL2 implementation copies/extracts args before native execution and passes
that same copy to post hooks; it updates the separate return proxy, not copied
out fields. Therefore reading args.OutSkillState as the final native output
would be unsound. v0.2.7 never reads that field. This interpretation follows
the [primary BL2 hook implementation](https://github.com/bl-sdk/unrealsdk/blob/master/src/unrealsdk/game/bl2/hooks.cpp).
The [installed-commit hook contract](https://github.com/bl-sdk/unrealsdk/blob/b1852aa440277afcce8a13566b5487aeae5a7ae9/src/unrealsdk/hook_manager.h)
also distinguishes args from actual return proxy. Exact installed-commit
implementation pages were unavailable through browsing; reviewed master
implementation and installed stub agree on copy/return semantics. The design
avoids output-struct reads entirely and does not infer their final values.

## Loaded schemas required each run

Metadata comes from v0.2.3's live diagnostic log and v0.2.6's UpdateInfoBox log.
Startup scans <=30000 loaded Function objects, accepts only exact canonical
class/outer/path and rejects missing/duplicate/changed descriptors. No guessed
path is hooked. Each function has <=16 reflected fields; unknown additional
parameter/out/return flags refuse startup. Raw locals are logged, never read.

| Function | NumParams / ParamsSize / ReturnValueOffset | Required inputs/return |
|--|--|--|
| PlayerSkillTree:GetSkillState | 3 / 28 / 24 | SkillDef ObjectProperty flags128 offset0 (SkillDefinition); OutSkillState StructProperty flags384 offset4 (SkillTreeSkillStateData); ReturnValue BoolProperty flags1408 offset24 |
| SkillTreeGFxObject:GetSkillDescriptionForGrade | 6 / 32 / 20 | SkillDef ObjectProperty flags128 offset0; Grade IntProperty flags128 offset4; GradeModifier IntProperty flags128 offset8; PlayerOwner ObjectProperty flags128 offset12 (WillowPlayerController); bIncludeHTML BoolProperty flags128 offset16; ReturnValue StrProperty flags4195712 offset20 |
| SkillTreeGFxObject:UpdateInfoBox | 0 / 0 / 65535 | No parameters/return; reflected strings/SkillState are locals |

Required array dimensions are one; SkillDef PropertyClass must be SkillDefinition.
OutSkillState's descriptor must have exact ScriptStruct class/name. Reflect at
most 12 raw struct property descriptors (class/flags/offset/dimension) for future
design; no struct instance reads or evaluation. No constraints are followed.

## Passive reads and guard order

Three POST observers, returning None. Actual ret can reflect another hook's
override; the observation is not an exclusive native-semantic claim.

- Every callback first counts toward attempt/time limits, then runs unchanged
  _upgrade_state: same current Gaige/controller/pawn/world/PRI/tree, both
  sole-player rosters, exact owned inert patch, unique runtime registrations/
  indices/tier and known unchanged PRI points/ranks. Node grade stays zero.
- GetSkillState requires obj==the guarded current tree before any args reads,
  args._type==the verified function, and SkillDef identity among the three
  targets. Actual ret must be exact bool. Record QUERY_RETURN only. Never
  read OutSkillState, args.ReturnValue or reinterpret a tuple. A Boolean
  means the observed query returned that value, not an eligibility result.
- Descriptions require exact SkillTreeGFxObject/WPCOwner==pc before args/text;
  reuse validated separate current/rollover runtime identities. Matching
  args._type, target SkillDef and PlayerOwner==pc are required. Grade is exact
  int 0..128, modifier exact int -128..128, bIncludeHTML exact bool, actual
  ret exact str. Requested definition must appear in verified current/rollover.
  Record inputs, original text length, first 512 characters and separate UI
  view. Preserve empty strings. Returned preview is not the rendered prompt.
- UpdateInfoBox reads only guarded target current/rollover/UI points/tier;
  choose a target rollover identity, otherwise target current identity, while
  retaining both values. UI_VIEW describes that UI observation only. Never
  inspect args, ret, NextGradeText or other locals. Foreign/other selection
```

```markdown
and string return representations, all three target identities, separate
```

### evidence/v028_presentation_snapshot_plan.md

Origin: Project file. Original bytes: 10819. SHA256: c21d74d4f8d9d8b27cfe606337eb7f34eeae83c31ad82ce0d789087597d0da0c. UTF-8 BOM: False. Original newline style: LF. Trailing LF: True.

```markdown
# v0.2.8: bounded read-only presentation comparison

## Evidence driving the change

v0.2.7's live trace captured all nine skill/function buckets. Overclock's
GetSkillDescriptionForGrade return was empty for Grade1/modifier0/HTML=False;
MorePep and Myelin returned bonus text for the same inputs. Sampled FINAL
points/ranks remained unchanged, observers were removed and native rollback
passed. See v027_live_focused_state_result.md. This difference does not prove
the cause of the rendered orange prompt's absence or a purchase failure.

At design time the inert constructor did not populate SkillEffectPresentations
and its actual default array remained unobserved. v0.1.5's real log shows four MorePep and one
one-rank ExplosiveClap AttributePresentationDefinition references. v0.2.8
compares the three current owned target arrays and inspects bounded raw class
property metadata to identify a next safe display-data investigation.
No presentation instances are copied, evaluated or changed.

## Deliberate scope

Button 4 now routes to inspect_overclock_presentations, instead of the older
general purchase snapshot. It remains a synchronous explicit diagnostic with
no observers. Other options remain in place; total stays 19. The old purchase
function remains in source and regressions, with only its version label changed.

Four new functions: _presentation_metadata, _presentation_class_fields,
_presentation_details and inspect_overclock_presentations. Of 68 v0.2.7
functions, 64 are AST-identical, including constructor/insertion/rollback,
_upgrade_state, UI/current-session guards, observer callbacks/cleanup and the
verified manual duration prototype. The other four change version labels only:
inspect_overclock_purchase, start_upgrade_trace, start_ui_trace,
start_skillstate_trace. Factory metadata and button 4's route/label change.
No new global capture state, import-time game access or automated gameplay.

## Reflection and payload checks

Installed SDK stubs were read as documentation only. UClass._find_prop is SDK
property reflection; _properties iterates raw descriptors; UObject._path_name
is an SDK identity helper. WrappedArray is the documented SDK array type.
The [primary Python array binding](https://github.com/bl-sdk/pyunrealsdk/blob/master/src/pyunrealsdk/unreal_bindings/wrapped_array.cpp)
also exports that wrapper. Its _type attribute's array/inner semantics were
not established for the installed commit; this design never reads or changes
_type or relies on a guessed interpretation. Exact installed-commit source
was unavailable through browsing. No stubs were executed or packaged.

Reuse unchanged _upgrade_state with a local baseline: current owned Gaige/
controller/pawn/world/PRI/tree, both sole-player rosters, exact inert patch,
unique registrations/indices/tier, grade-zero node and known nonnegative PRI
points/ranks. Refuse while initialization/loading/UI/upgrade/focused traces
are active or failed hooks remain. No observer cleanup is performed by button
4; existing CANCEL/disable remain the restoration path.

Require each target's exact shared SkillDefinition UClass identity. Resolve
only SkillEffectPresentations via _find_prop; do not scan the skill class.
Require property Name, Outer==that class, ArrayProperty with ObjectProperty
Inner, actual UClass named AttributePresentationDefinition. Both descriptors
need dimension1, exact integer flags in [0,2^64), no parameter/out/return bits
(mask0x580), exact integer offset0..1048576. These structural checks are not
a previously game-verified fixed offset/flag schema; actual native matches
remain a live-test question. Unknown metadata refuses payload reads.

Recheck current state after metadata and before array access. Require an actual
SDK WrappedArray. Read length; refuse >256 before entries. Log count, sample
size and explicit cap. Inspect at most four references per target, each an
actual SDK UObject with Class identical to the declared presentation class.
Shared references need not be child objects of the skill. Only call SDK path
identity after class/state checks; path must be nonempty exact string <=384,
logged with repr escaping. No object repr/owner graph or instance display/
attribute/struct/array/function values are read. Recheck state before/after
reference access and array length/definition class after sampling.

Reflect the common presentation UClass once per button invocation, at most
16 property descriptors with one bounded lookahead. Reject duplicate/absent/
oversized field names, missing/non-property kinds or untyped/out-of-bound
flags/offset/dimensions. Log raw name/type/flags/offset/dimension and bounded
metadata type names for referenced class/struct/enum/inner; never their payloads.
Metadata names/skill labels <=96, error detail <=180, object paths <=384.
No scalar presentation values are guessed; decide any value allowlist from
the actual native metadata after this run.

## Reporting and refusal

Each of three target summaries distinguishes VERIFIED array count/reference
sample from UNAVAILABLE data. Empty is count0, never a substitute for a failed
read. Metadata has separate COMPLETE/CAPPED/UNAVAILABLE status; an unavailable
class metadata iterator does not turn a verified count into zero. The function
returns True only if all three arrays/reference samples verified; this is not
proof that all metadata or all references beyond the four-entry cap were read.

Current-state failures abort before proceeding to another target. Each call
samples its own baseline; no cross-call point/rank claim. FINAL compares the
complete state, prints points/ranks unchanged_from_start=True only on success,
then END verified_arrays=N/3 observers_added=0. Metadata/payload errors report
partial data; state changes cause ABORT, never repair/refund. The snapshot
does not buy/save/load/evaluate/copy effects/constraints, register/remove hooks,
invoke native query/formatting functions or override any return/text.

## Local verification and one game test

108 unique local mocks passed, including 18 new presentation tests. New cases
cover empty/nonempty verified arrays, missing/invalid metadata, wrong SDK/
native classes, wrong wrappers/references, absent/oversized paths, shared refs,
four-reference/16-property bounds, oversized/unreadable arrays, metadata errors,
changed points/ranks/class/array lengths, observer overlap, no mutation/native
invocation, and preserved cancel/disable rollback. They do not establish
engine behavior or the cause of missing text. Runtime syntax compilation passed.

Before shipping: exact three-file single-folder ZIP integrity/source match and
isolated 19-option import without game access. Preserve seven tested ZIPs,
v0.2.7 log and tested source snapshot unchanged. New v0.2.8 ZIP gets its own
filename; no game installation is performed by Codex.

Test: close BL2, install only this mod from v0.2.8 ZIP, verify exact title
UVH v0.2.8 - OVERCLOCK PRESENTATION SNAPSHOT. Main menu 1 ARM, Continue as
backed-up Gaige alone Offline, in map 4 INSPECT once, 3 CANCEL/RESTORE, fully
exit and report done. No Skills highlighting or observer START needed for this
snapshot. Do not spend points or use any other diagnostic/boost/respec/travel.
On partial/error: cancel and exit; never force a native function/purchase.
Preserve/hash the final log before relaunch. Verify three summaries/raw metadata,
sampled final unchanged state, zero owned observers and RESTORE result=True.
No v0.2.8 game result yet. The node remains inert; later purchase/refund/
persistence/automatic effects/co-op/release need separate scope and recovery.

## Completed artifact checks

108 tests passed, including all 90 prior tests. Runtime syntax compilation,
isolated packaged import with 19 options and no game access, exact single-mod
folder/three-file layout, ZIP integrity and byte equality to current source
all passed. No additional runtime changes after these tests.

Created dist/UltimateVaultHunterDeathtrapBoost_v0.2.8_folder_install.zip
exclusively, without overwriting any versioned artifact. It is 30,016 bytes,
matches the checked default ZIP byte for byte, and passed separate integrity,
layout/source and packaged syntax checks. SHA-256:
`93b2ae7f8cae8412d3af6637d1c6e0739cadf7b6b0cc07b3961c5758674940c2`.

Runtime SHA-256:
`4dae701cc263c3d4be1fb8b602f0f5d0987ad173b2cfd477bd784a7ddeb706a5`.
pyproject SHA-256:
`0393dfc7317910731465da0a19aa62f5bb5b4bf777b5c8e8c4b6315de8cd12b1`.

Final AST checks confirmed 64 prior functions unchanged and the other four
changed only version strings, plus four new functions. All seven tested ZIP
hashes, the v0.2.7 preserved log and tested-runtime snapshot were checked
unchanged. No game files were installed/edited and no v0.2.8 engine behavior
was established at build time. User installation and the 1,4,3 test were pending.

## First live run review

See v028_live_presentation_result.md. Installed three files matched the
original v0.2.8 ZIP. Live insertion/visibility and native-array restoration
passed, with zero observers. The screenshot shows0/1, one skill point and
[Enter] Spend Point; that rendered input hint is not orange bonus text or
proof of eligibility/purchase. The user confirmed they did not select item4.
Zero [UVH-PRESENT] messages means the presentation diagnostic was not run;
schema/counts/references/metadata and snapshot FINAL comparison remain unknown.
Collect this omitted step using the already verified v0.2.8 in a fresh process,
selecting item4 in mod options. Preserve the retry log under a distinct name.
All eight original versioned ZIP hashes/integrity were checked unchanged;
exact tested files are archived in archive/tested_runtime/v0.2.8. The previous
v0.2.7 snapshot/log remain intact. Runtime/pyproject are frozen. Documentation
updates rebuild only the default ZIP; a new runtime/version is unnecessary.

## Completed live presentation inspection

The fresh retry is preserved as v028_presentation_retry.log, with review in
v028_live_presentation_retry_result.md. Two completed calls verified arrays
Overclock0/0, MorePep4/4 and Myelin2/2; all reference samples covered their
arrays, while class metadata was explicitly CAPPED after16 properties.
All three loaded array/inner/class schemas were accepted. Both calls sampled
PRI points=(1,0)/ranks=(0,0,0) unchanged at FINAL, verified_arrays=3/3 and
observers_added=0. Cancellation restored original arrays/cells with observers0;
repeat cancellation found no patch and the process was closed. No ERROR/
Traceback, UNAVAILABLE or ABORT. Installed files matched the original ZIP.
The empty candidate array is now verified, but causation/eligibility/effects
remain unproven. Next design uses the observed string/display field metadata,
not another identical count test. Runtime/all eight original ZIPs remain frozen.
```

```markdown
# v0.2.9: bounded native presentation string comparison

## Evidence and scope

v0.2.8's real retry verified presentation arrays Overclock=0, MorePep=4 and
Myelin=2, all six reference identities and16 capped raw class descriptors.
Both calls sampled FINAL points/ranks unchanged; hooks0 and native restoration
passed. The actual four string values were not read. v0.2.7's empty candidate
grade-preview return and the empty array are consistent with missing display
data but do not prove causation or purchase behavior. See the preserved results.

Button4 now routes to inspect_overclock_presentation_text; factory19 options.
The old count-only diagnostic remains available in source/regressions, with
only its version label changed. New behavior is explicitly synchronous and
read-only. The four allowed string names/offsets are Description68,
NoConstraintText80, Prefix104 and Suffix92, all observed StrProperty,
flags4227075/dimension1. Require exact loaded name/owner/class/type/numbers
before a named SDK value read. Owner identity was not printed in the prior
class scan, so this is a new fail-closed check, not an engine-verified match.
No instance Booleans/floats/Attribute values or unobserved fields are read.

Installed SDK documentation was read only: UObject.__getattr__ documents
named Unreal field reads, UStruct._find_prop documents targeted property
lookup (missing raises), and UObject._path_name documents identity strings.
These helpers were already used in tested v0.2.8; no new SDK API or guessed
WrappedArray._type interpretation. No documentation stubs were executed.

## Guards, bounds and reporting

Reuse _upgrade_state unchanged with a local baseline: current owned Gaige/
controller/tree/pawn/world/PRI, both sole-player rosters, inert owned patch,
unique runtime registrations/indices/tier and exact known unchanged points/
ranks. Refuse active/failed initialization/loading/upgrade/UI/focused observers.
No observer registration/removal is added by this inspector.

Existing _presentation_metadata checks the loaded target array/inner/element
class before payload reads. Cache only common class identity per call.
At most256 entries allowed, sample at most4 per target. Every entry must be
an SDK UObject with the exact declared class. Revalidate metadata and fresh
current array membership/count/class before/after each text read, using value
identity of entry references, never Python array-wrapper identity assumptions.
Path strings are exact nonempty str<=384, repr-escaped.

Four fields per sampled entry, maximum48 text reads per call. Every scalar
descriptor is targeted separately via _find_prop; no class/instance scanning.
Require exact str payloads before length/slice/repr. Output clips to512
characters, reports full length and clipped flag, escapes the string and
does not interpret templates/HTML. Unknown objects are never repr'd/coerced.

VALUE failures are UNAVAILABLE, distinct from verified empty strings. After
field failure, recheck all guards before another field. Array count/reference
sample and text field totals have separate statuses; empty arrays are
NOT_APPLICABLE with0/0 fields. Known array count alone does not imply text
coverage. Sample beyond4 is explicitly capped. Unknown/changing arrays or
references abort before another target. State changes abort with no repair/
refund and no successful FINAL claim. Each call compares its own baseline;
FINAL unchanged_from_start=True is only printed after full state comparison.
Success means all sampled text fields passed, not rendered previews or gameplay.

Reused _presentation_metadata logs [UVH-PRESENT] SCHEMA during these guarded
reads. New BEGIN/ARRAY/REFERENCE/VALUE/SUMMARY/FINAL/END use [UVH-TEXT].
Repeated schema lines are membership verification, not repeated old traces.

No native query/formatter invocation, constraints/effects/presentation copying,
Attribute traversal/evaluation, return/text overrides, game-state writes,
package loads, new hooks, purchases, save/grade/point API calls or automatic
duration effect. Existing constructor/rollback/manual duration remain intact.

## Scope proof and local tests

Of72 v0.2.8 functions,67 remain AST-identical. Five change version labels only:
inspect_overclock_presentations, inspect_overclock_purchase,
start_upgrade_trace, start_ui_trace and start_skillstate_trace.
Four new functions: _presentation_text_property, _presentation_text_reference,
_presentation_text_details, inspect_overclock_presentation_text. A fixed
four-field tuple is added. Factory metadata/button4 route change, still19
options. Two prior version assertions and one factory-route assertion update;
their other tests/behavior remain unchanged.

127 unique mocks passed (108 established plus19 new tests). New cases cover
allowlisted strings and known empty arrays, no writes/native calls/discovery/
class scan, missing/invalid descriptor before poisoned payload, exact type
refusal without conversion, empty versus getter errors, escaped clipped text,
template non-evaluation, four-entry/four-field caps, invalid sessions/ranks,
active/failed hook overlap, points changing at metadata, rank changes during
values, stale replaced references, metadata/class changes between reads,
invalid/oversized/unreadable arrays, path type/bounds, array length changes,
unallowlisted field refusal and preserved cancel/disable rollback.
The clipping test's character-count expectation was corrected from1010 to1011;
no runtime repair was needed. Full127 suite passed in10.284 seconds.
Runtime syntax and AST proof passed. Mocks do not establish v0.2.9 engine
behavior or its new scalar-owner match.

## Packaging and one game test

Before shipping verify default ZIP/source/layout/integrity and isolated import
with19 options/no game access, then create a distinct v0.2.9 ZIP exclusively.
Preserve eight original v0.2.1–v0.2.8 ZIPs, tested snapshots v0.2.7/v0.2.8 and
all prior logs/PNG unchanged. Package only one mod folder with three files,
no SDK/game assets/saves/tests/scaffolding. Codex does not install game files.

Test: close BL2, replace only this project mod from the v0.2.9 ZIP, exact title
UVH v0.2.9 - OVERCLOCK PRESENTATION TEXT. Main menu item1 ARM before Continue
as backed-up solo Gaige Offline, in map open mod options/select item4 INSPECT
PRESENTATION TEXT once, item3 CANCEL/RESTORE, full exit and report done.
These numbers are mod-option labels, not in-map keyboard shortcuts.
No highlighting/other observers, point spending, respec, travel or boosts.
Partial/error: cancel and exit; never force a formatter/purchase.

Preserve/hash log before relaunch under a new evidence filename. Verify actual
scalar owner/schema/data, coverage/limits, FINAL state, hooks0 and RESTORE
result=True. Raw strings are not rendered previews/eligibility/effect proof.
No v0.2.9 game result yet. Later purchases/persistence/automatic effects/co-op/
release need separate scope and point/grade/save recovery; arrays cannot undo
those state changes or clear caches. Restart after every test.

## Completed artifact checks

127 tests, runtime syntax and AST proof passed. The default ZIP passed exact
source/layout/integrity and isolated19-option import with no game access.
The new v0.2.9 ZIP was created exclusively and checked byte-identical to that
verified default, with a separate integrity/source/layout/compile check:

pyproject SHA-256:

Packaged README SHA-256:
`c88222fd33b4bb69cab713e2ef57d9a34e8106824524986b08c9b0f64463d098`.

All eight original ZIP hashes/integrity, tested snapshots v0.2.7/v0.2.8 and
checked v0.2.5–v0.2.8 logs/PNG remained unchanged. No runtime change after
the passing suite; only documentation was finalized. No game installation/
SDK/save edits or save parsing. User installation and the1,4,3 test are next.

## Completed game review

The subsequent1,4,3 run is now preserved separately in v029_user_test.log and

Overclock0/0 fields were NOT_APPLICABLE; native Description values contain

The above no-live statements describe build-time status only. Exact tested
```

```markdown
| bUseCustomNumberPlacement | BoolProperty | 3 | 116 | 1 |

Validate targeted loaded descriptors via SDK _find_prop: exact field/owner,
type/flags/offset/dimension, actual declared UClass/name for Attribute. No
packed masks inferred from the shared Boolean offset; let SDK getattr read
an exact bool. Bool-like integers and unknown payloads are UNAVAILABLE.
Read only typed SDK Attribute reference identity: None is VERIFIED absence;
actual UObject with Class identical to declared AttributeDefinition is eligible
for bounded escaped SDK _path_name. Subclasses or same-name different classes
are unverified and refuse. Do not traverse or evaluate attributes, enumerate
their fields, read their values or invoke native methods/formatters.

## Guards, finite coverage and changed references

Reuse _upgrade_state and _presentation_text_reference unchanged. Validate exact
owned current Gaige/tree/pawn/world/PRI, named solo roles/both sole-player
rosters, known unchanged points/ranks/indices/tier, unique registrations and
owned inert grade0 patch. Refuse overlapping/failed loading/init/upgrade/UI/
focused observers. Per-call baseline; no repair/refund after a state change.

three flags and one Attribute field per reference: maximum36 Boolean fields
and12 attribute identity/absence records,48 total distinct captures per call.

identity rechecks); total named instance reads<=84/call. No text reread.
```

```markdown
# v0.2.11 combined read-only Attribute class test

The user authorized the next step, then asked to do more tests per game run.
One explicit item4 will collect the refused Myelin reference's wrapper status,
actual loaded class identity and bounded metadata ancestry together. It will
not rerun completed flags/text/identity comparisons or combine old observers.
This is a new diagnostic build, not an effect or purchase test. No live result
exists yet. Preserve the v0.2.10 originals; current source may advance to11.

Before edits, 44 original ZIP/snapshot/log/PNG files were hashed in
v031_preserved_baseline.json. Ten versioned ZIPs and four tested snapshots are
present; current runtime bytes equal archive/tested_runtime/v0.2.10.

## Design and SDK documentation

Read SDK documentation only, never execute/import/package the stubs:
sdk_mods/.stubs/unrealsdk/unreal/_uobject.pyi documents UObject.Class as UClass,
Name as str and _path_name() as SDK path reflection. _uobject_children.pyi
documents UStruct.SuperField as UStruct|None, UClass derives from UStruct,
and _superfields() includes self. Use explicit SuperField reads to enforce
an eight-class limit and cycle detection; do not call the unbounded iterator
or _inherits(), or any native function. Require every traversed class to be an
actual SDK UClass. Only exact loaded identities in the observed chain establish
the relationship to the descriptor's declared UClass; names are insufficient.

Use unchanged _upgrade_state and _presentation_text_reference, current solo
Gaige/owned inert grade0 patch and baseline points/ranks/index/tier/session.
Reject overlapping or failed observers. Inspect only Myelin index1 after a
bounded actual WrappedArray count and exact previously observed presentation
```

```python
"""Verify the install ZIP and import its runtime alone with inert SDK mocks."""
import subprocess
import re
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from zipfile import ZipFile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
FOLDER = 'UltimateVaultHunterDeathtrapBoost'
ARCHIVE = ROOT / 'dist' / (FOLDER + '_folder_install.zip')
EXPECTED = {FOLDER + '/' + name for name in ('__init__.py', 'pyproject.toml', 'README.txt')}
VERSION = re.search(r'^version\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"',
                    (ROOT / 'sdk_mods' / FOLDER / 'pyproject.toml').read_text(), re.M).group(1)
SMOKE = '''
import runpy, sys, types
def forbidden(*args, **kwargs):
    raise AssertionError('runtime import unexpectedly accessed game state')
base = types.ModuleType('mods_base')
base.ButtonOption = lambda *args, **kwargs: kwargs
base.CoopSupport = types.SimpleNamespace(ClientSide='client')
base.Game = types.SimpleNamespace(BL2='bl2')
base.get_pc = forbidden
registered = []
base.build_mod = lambda **kwargs: registered.append(kwargs)
sdk = types.ModuleType('unrealsdk')
sdk.logging = types.SimpleNamespace(info=forbidden)
sdk.find_object = sdk.find_all = sdk.find_enum = sdk.load_package = sdk.construct_object = forbidden
sys.modules['mods_base'] = base
sys.modules['unrealsdk'] = sdk
runpy.run_path(sys.argv[1])
assert len(registered) == 1
assert registered[0]['version'] == sys.argv[2]
assert registered[0]['on_disable'].__name__ == 'shutdown'
assert len(registered[0]['options']) == 19
print('PASS: isolated packaged runtime import; no game access or scaffolding')
'''

with ZipFile(ARCHIVE) as archive:
    assert len(archive.namelist()) == len(EXPECTED)
    assert set(archive.namelist()) == EXPECTED, archive.namelist()
    assert archive.testzip() is None
    for name in EXPECTED:
        assert archive.read(name) == (ROOT / 'sdk_mods' / name).read_bytes(), name
    compile(archive.read(FOLDER + '/__init__.py'), FOLDER + '/__init__.py', 'exec')
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='uvh_package_check_', dir=ROOT / 'dist') as temporary:
        archive.extractall(temporary)
        subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-c', SMOKE,
                        str(Path(temporary) / FOLDER / '__init__.py'), VERSION],
                       cwd=temporary, check=True)

print('PASS: ZIP integrity, exact single-folder layout and source match')
```

```python
"""UVH: manual Deathtrap boost, opt-in inert node test and loading diagnostics.

No automatic gameplay changes. The optional trace observes native calls without
blocking or overriding them. Node insertion writes shared definitions only on an
explicit menu button; keep a backed-up Gaige save and never buy the test node.
"""
import math
from mods_base import ButtonOption, CoopSupport, Game, build_mod, get_pc
from unrealsdk import logging

TAG = '[UVH-BOOST]'
EXTRA_SECONDS = 15.0
EXPECTED_DEFAULT = 60.0
MAX_DURATION = 180.0
_record = None


def log(message):
    logging.info('{} {}'.format(TAG, message))


def read(obj, field):
    try:
        return getattr(obj, field)
    except Exception:
        return None


def name(obj):
    return str(read(obj, 'Name') or '')


def finite_num(value):
    return type(value) in (float, int) and math.isfinite(value)


def near(a, b):
    return finite_num(a) and finite_num(b) and math.isclose(a, b, rel_tol=0, abs_tol=0.05)


def signature(skill):
    # Names sometimes get reused by UE; activation time distinguishes each summon.
    return (name(skill), read(skill, 'ActivatedTime'), name(read(skill, 'SkillInstigator')))


def find_live():
    """Return (skill, action, pc) for our own active Deathtrap or (None, ...)."""
    pc = get_pc(possibly_loading=True)
    if pc is None:
        log('No local controller. Load Gaige into a map.')
        return None, None, None
    if name(read(pc, 'PlayerClass')) != 'CharClass_Mechromancer':
        log('Not Gaige. No gameplay changes.')
        return None, None, pc
    action = read(read(pc, 'Pawn'), 'MyActionSkill')
    if name(read(action, 'Class')) != 'DeathtrapActionSkill':
        log('Deathtrap is not summoned. Summon first.')
        return None, action, pc
    try:
        manager = pc.GetSkillManager()
        skills = read(manager, 'ActiveSkills')
        count = len(skills)
    except Exception as exc:
        log('Could not access ActiveSkills ({})'.format(type(exc).__name__))
        return None, action, pc
    for i in range(min(count, 64)):
        try:
            skill = skills[i]
            if name(read(skill, 'Definition')) != 'Skill_DeathTrap':
                continue
            instigator = read(skill, 'SkillInstigator')
            if name(instigator) != name(pc) or not name(pc):
                log('Deathtrap skill owner did not match player controller; aborting.')
                return None, action, pc
            return skill, action, pc
        except Exception as exc:
            log('Could not read ActiveSkills[{}] ({})'.format(i, type(exc).__name__))
    log('No active Skill_DeathTrap instance found.')
    return None, action, pc


def display(skill):
    log('Skill={} | Grade={} | Duration={} | Base={} | ActivatedTime={} | modifiers={}'.format(
        name(skill), read(skill, 'Grade'), read(skill, 'Duration'),
        read(skill, 'DurationBaseValue'), read(skill, 'ActivatedTime'),
        _modifier_count(skill)))


def _modifier_count(skill):
    stack = read(skill, 'DurationModifierStack')
    if stack is None:
        return 'unavailable'
    try:
        return len(stack)
    except Exception:
        return 'unavailable'


def inspect(_option=None):
    log('BEGIN inspect v0.1.1')
    try:
        skill, _action, _pc = find_live()
        if skill is not None:
            display(skill)
            if _record is not None:
                log('Last test record: {} -> {} on {}'.format(
                    _record['before'], _record['after'], _record['sig']))
            else:
                log('No duration change recorded in this session.')
    except Exception as exc:
        log('ERROR inspect: {}: {}'.format(type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:130]))
    finally:
        log('END inspect')


def apply(_option=None):
    global _record
    log('BEGIN experimental +15 seconds (live skill instance only)')
    try:
        skill, _action, _pc = find_live()
        if skill is None:
            return
        sig = signature(skill)
        if _record is not None:
            if sig == _record['sig']:
                log('NOT APPLIED: Already tested on this summon; prevents stacking.')
                display(skill)
                return
            log('Previous summon ended. Clearing stale duration record.')
            _record = None

        current = read(skill, 'Duration')
        base = read(skill, 'DurationBaseValue')
        modifier_count = _modifier_count(skill)
        display(skill)
        if not near(current, EXPECTED_DEFAULT) or not near(base, EXPECTED_DEFAULT):
            log('NOT APPLIED: Expected unmodified Duration and DurationBaseValue ~= 60.0.')
            return
        if modifier_count != 0:
            log('NOT APPLIED: Skill has duration modifiers or modifiers inaccessible.')
            return
        after = current + EXTRA_SECONDS
        if after > MAX_DURATION:
            log('NOT APPLIED: requested Duration exceeds safety limit.')
            return
        try:
            skill.Duration = float(after)
        except Exception as exc:
            log('WRITE REJECTED: {}: {}'.format(type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:110]))
            return
        observed = read(skill, 'Duration')
        if not near(observed, after):
            log('WRITE NOT VERIFIED: expected {}, got {}; attempting rollback.'.format(after, observed))
            try:
                skill.Duration = current
            except Exception as rollback_exc:
                log('WARNING rollback failed: {}'.format(type(rollback_exc).__name__))
            return
        _record = {'sig': sig, 'before': current, 'after': after}
        log('WRITE VERIFIED: live Skill_DeathTrap.Duration {} -> {}'.format(current, observed))
        log('DurationBaseValue left unchanged. A successful write does not yet prove longer in-game lifespan.')
        log('No shared definitions, tree points, cooldown pools or saves changed.')
    except Exception as exc:
        log('ERROR apply: {}: {}'.format(type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:130]))
    finally:
        log('END apply')


def restore(_option=None):
    global _record
    log('BEGIN restore live duration')
    try:
        if _record is None:
            log('Nothing to restore; no successful modification recorded.')
            return
        skill, _action, _pc = find_live()
        if skill is None or signature(skill) != _record['sig']:
            log('Original Deathtrap summon is no longer active. No other skill touched.')
            _record = None
            return
        current = read(skill, 'Duration')
        if not near(current, _record['after']):
            log('NOT RESTORED: current Duration {} changed independently; avoiding overwrite.'.format(current))
            _record = None
            return
        before = _record['before']
        skill.Duration = before
        checked = read(skill, 'Duration')
        if near(checked, before):
            log('RESTORED: live Skill_DeathTrap.Duration {} -> {}'.format(current, checked))
            _record = None
        else:
            log('RESTORE READBACK MISMATCH: got {}'.format(checked))
    except Exception as exc:
        log('ERROR restore: {}: {}'.format(type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:130]))
    finally:
        log('END restore')




def _tree_info(val):
    if val is None:
        return '<none>'
    if type(val) in (str, int, bool, float):
        return repr(val)[:160]
    label = name(val)
    clazz = name(read(val, 'Class'))
    if label:
        return '{} [{}]'.format(label[:75], clazz[:75] or type(val).__name__)
    try:
        return '<{} len={}>'.format(type(val).__name__, len(val))
    except Exception:
        return '<{}>'.format(type(val).__name__)


def _tree_fields(label, obj):
    if obj is None:
        log('[UVH-TREE] {} unavailable'.format(label))
        return
    tokens = ('skill', 'tree', 'train', 'point', 'branch', 'grade', 'purchase', 'unlock', 'node')
    try:
        fields = sorted(set(k for k in dir(obj) if not k.startswith('_')
                            and any(t in k.lower() for t in tokens)))
    except Exception as exc:
        log('[UVH-TREE] {} names ERROR {}'.format(label, type(exc).__name__))
        return
    log('[UVH-TREE] {} matching names ({}): {}'.format(
        label, len(fields), ', '.join(fields[:85]) or '<none>'))
    for key in fields[:80]:
        try:
            val = getattr(obj, key)
            if callable(val):
                continue
            log('[UVH-TREE] {}.{} = {}'.format(label, key, _tree_info(val)))
            # Sample a few referenced tree/branch structs, without walking the entire graph.
            if any(x in key.lower() for x in ('tree', 'branch', 'node')) and not isinstance(val, (str, bytes)):
                if isinstance(val, (tuple, list)):
                    for i, entry in enumerate(val[:3]):
                        log('[UVH-TREE] {}.{}[{}] = {}'.format(label, key, i, _tree_info(entry)))
        except Exception as exc:
            log('[UVH-TREE] {}.{} READ ERROR {}'.format(label, key, type(exc).__name__))


def inspect_native_tree(_option=None):
    """Inspect native Gaige skill-tree access, never spend or mutate points."""
    log('[UVH-TREE] BEGIN v0.1.2 native tree/skill-point inspection (READ ONLY)')
    try:
        pc = get_pc(possibly_loading=True)
        if pc is None:
            log('[UVH-TREE] No player controller; load Gaige and retry.')
            return
        cls = read(pc, 'PlayerClass')
        if name(cls) != 'CharClass_Mechromancer':
            log('[UVH-TREE] Current class {} is not Gaige; skipping.'.format(name(cls)))
            return
        pri = read(pc, 'PlayerReplicationInfo')
        log('[UVH-TREE] Class={} SkillTreePath={}'.format(name(cls), _tree_info(read(cls, 'SkillTreePath'))))
        log('[UVH-TREE] GeneralSkillPoints={} SpecialistSkillPoints={}'.format(
            _tree_info(read(pri, 'GeneralSkillPoints')),
            _tree_info(read(pri, 'SpecialistSkillPoints'))))
        _tree_fields('PlayerClass', cls)
        _tree_fields('PlayerReplicationInfo', pri)
        _tree_fields('PlayerController', pc)
        try:
            import unrealsdk
            trees = unrealsdk.find_all('SkillTreeDefinition', exact=False)
            log('[UVH-TREE] Loaded SkillTreeDefinition count={}'.format(len(trees)))
            for i, tree in enumerate(trees):
                if i >= 16:
                    break
                log('[UVH-TREE] loadedTree[{}] = {}'.format(i, _tree_info(tree)))
                if 'mechro' in name(tree).lower() or 'gaige' in name(tree).lower():
                    _tree_fields('GaigeSkillTree', tree)
        except Exception as exc:
            log('[UVH-TREE] find_all SkillTreeDefinition ERROR {}: {}'.format(
                type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:100]))
        log('[UVH-TREE] FINISHED; no new skill, point spending, save, or native UI modification.')
    except Exception as exc:
        log('[UVH-TREE] ERROR {}: {}'.format(type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:120]))
    finally:
        log('[UVH-TREE] END')



# Native skill branches referenced by BL2 skill-tree patch mods.  We only inspect
# these objects (and their original packages); no asset or save property writes.
def _find_native(path, types=('Object',)):
    import unrealsdk
    for kind in types:
        try:
            obj = unrealsdk.find_object(kind, path)
            if obj is not None:
                return obj, kind
        except Exception:
            pass
    return None, None


def _native_describe(obj):
    if obj is None:
        return '<missing>'
    try:
        return '{} | {}'.format(_tree_info(obj), str(obj)[:190])
    except Exception:
        return _tree_info(obj)


def _read_tiers(label, obj):
    fields = ('Branches', 'Tiers', 'Skills', 'SkillTreeBranches', 'Layout',
              'RequiredPoints', 'PointsToUnlockNextTier', 'bCellIsOccupied',
              'SkillDefinition', 'SkillTree', 'SkillName', 'SkillDescription')
    for field in fields:
        value = read(obj, field)
        if value is None:
            continue
        log('[UVH-NODES] {}.{} = {}'.format(label, field, _native_describe(value)))
        if isinstance(value, (str, bytes)):
            continue
        try:
            count = len(value)
        except Exception:
            continue
        log('[UVH-NODES] {}.{} length={}'.format(label, field, count))
        for i in range(min(count, 7)):
            try:
                item = value[i]
                log('[UVH-NODES] {}.{}[{}] = {}'.format(label, field, i, _native_describe(item)))
                for nested in ('Skills', 'PointsToUnlockNextTier', 'bCellIsOccupied',
                               'SkillDefinition', 'SkillName'):
                    v = read(item, nested)
                    if v is not None:
                        log('[UVH-NODES] {}.{}[{}].{} = {}'.format(
                            label, field, i, nested, _native_describe(v)))
                        if nested in ('Skills', 'bCellIsOccupied'):
                            try:
                                for j in range(min(len(v), 4)):
                                    log('[UVH-NODES] {}.{}[{}].{}[{}] = {}'.format(
                                        label, field, i, nested, j, _native_describe(v[j])))
                            except Exception:
                                pass
            except Exception as exc:
                log('[UVH-NODES] {}.{}[{}] inspect failed {}'.format(
                    label, field, i, type(exc).__name__))


def inspect_native_branch_assets(_option=None):
    # Non-mutating asset/package check for Gaige native tree branches.
    log('[UVH-NODES] BEGIN v0.1.3 locate native Gaige tree/branches (NO SKILL EDITS)')
    try:
        pc = get_pc(possibly_loading=True)
        if pc is None or name(read(pc, 'PlayerClass')) != 'CharClass_Mechromancer':
            log('[UVH-NODES] Gaige not loaded; abort.')
            return
        import unrealsdk
        stream = read(read(pc, 'PlayerClass'), 'SkillTreePath')
        log('[UVH-NODES] PlayerClass.SkillTreePath = {}'.format(repr(stream)))
        objects = (
            ('TreeFromClass', stream, ('SkillTreeDefinition', 'Object')),
            ('BranchFriends', 'GD_Tulip_Mechromancer_Skills.SkillTrees.Branch_BestFriendsForever', ('Object',)),
            ('BranchTrouble', 'GD_Tulip_Mechromancer_Skills.SkillTrees.Branch_LittleBigTrouble', ('Object',)),
            ('BranchChaos', 'GD_Tulip_Mechromancer_Skills.SkillTrees.Branch_OrderedChaos', ('Object',)),
            ('LayoutTrouble', 'GD_Tulip_Mechromancer_Skills.SkillTrees.Layout_LittleBigTrouble', ('Object',)),
        )
        for label, path, kinds in objects:
            if not isinstance(path, str) or not path:
                continue
            obj, kind = _find_native(path, kinds)
            log('[UVH-NODES] BEFORE {} {} => {}'.format(label, path, _native_describe(obj)))
        # The streaming package alone was not enough in prior trials.  Test the
        # distinct package used by native BL2 Gaige branch modders.
        pkg = 'GD_Tulip_Mechromancer_Skills'
        try:
            result = unrealsdk.load_package(pkg)
            log('[UVH-NODES] load_package({}) returned {} (None may be normal; verify objects below)'.format(
                pkg, _native_describe(result)))
        except Exception as exc:
            log('[UVH-NODES] load_package({}) raised {}: {}'.format(
                pkg, type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:130]))
        resolved = 0
        for label, path, kinds in objects:
            if not isinstance(path, str) or not path:
                continue
            obj, kind = _find_native(path, kinds)
            log('[UVH-NODES] AFTER {} [{}] {} => {}'.format(
                label, kind or '-', path, _native_describe(obj)))
            if obj is not None:
                resolved += 1
                _read_tiers(label, obj)
        for class_kind in ('SkillTreeDefinition', 'SkillTreeBranchDefinition', 'SkillTreeBranchLayoutDefinition'):
            try:
                matches = unrealsdk.find_all(class_kind, exact=False)
                matches = [x for x in matches if name(x).lower().find('default__') != 0]
                log('[UVH-NODES] loaded {} count (non-default) = {}'.format(class_kind, len(matches)))
                for obj in matches[:12]:
                    log('[UVH-NODES] loaded {} => {}'.format(class_kind, _native_describe(obj)))
            except Exception as exc:
                log('[UVH-NODES] scan {} => {} {}'.format(class_kind, type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:90]))
        log('[UVH-NODES] RESOLVED {} of 5 asset paths (0 is a diagnostic result, not a crash)'.format(resolved))
        log('[UVH-NODES] READ ONLY: no skill grade, points, HUD, save, or skill duration changed.')
    except Exception as exc:
        log('[UVH-NODES] ERROR {}: {}'.format(type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:150]))
    finally:
        log('[UVH-NODES] END')



# Stage for a new, genuinely native skill-tree node: inspect object metadata,
# branch layout, and the SDK object creation API WITHOUT creating or modifying.
def inspect_node_blueprint(_option=None):
    log('[UVH-NODEPREP] BEGIN v0.1.5 inspect prerequisites for a NEW skill (read only)')
    try:
        pc = get_pc(possibly_loading=True)
        if pc is None or name(read(pc, 'PlayerClass')) != 'CharClass_Mechromancer':
            log('[UVH-NODEPREP] Load Gaige in a map first.')
            return
        import unrealsdk
        pairs = (
            ('LittleBigTrouble', 'GD_Tulip_Mechromancer_Skills.SkillTrees.Branch_LittleBigTrouble',
             'GD_Tulip_Mechromancer_Skills.SkillTrees.Layout_LittleBigTrouble'),
            ('BestFriendsForever', 'GD_Tulip_Mechromancer_Skills.SkillTrees.Branch_BestFriendsForever',
             'GD_Tulip_Mechromancer_Skills.SkillTrees.Layout_BestFriendsForever'),
        )
        for branch_name, branch_path, layout_path in pairs:
            branch, _ = _find_native(branch_path, ('SkillTreeBranchDefinition', 'Object'))
            layout, _ = _find_native(layout_path, ('SkillTreeBranchLayoutDefinition', 'Object'))
            log('[UVH-NODEPREP] {}: branch={} layout={}'.format(
                branch_name, _native_describe(branch), _native_describe(layout)))
            if branch is None or layout is None:
                continue
            tiers = read(branch, 'Tiers')
            occupied_tiers = read(layout, 'Tiers')
            if tiers is None or occupied_tiers is None:
                log('[UVH-NODEPREP] {} missing Tiers properties'.format(branch_name))
                continue
            n = min(6, len(tiers), len(occupied_tiers))
            for i in range(n):
                try:
                    skills = read(tiers[i], 'Skills')
                    cells = read(occupied_tiers[i], 'bCellIsOccupied')
                    if skills is None or cells is None:
                        continue
                    contents = [name(s) for s in skills]
                    layout_slots = [bool(x) for x in cells]
                    log('[UVH-NODEPREP] {} tier={} skills={} cells={} (read-only)'.format(
                        branch_name, i, contents, layout_slots))
                    if len(layout_slots) == 3 and sum(layout_slots) == len(contents):
                        mapping = []
                        idx = 0
                        for col, used in enumerate(layout_slots):
                            mapping.append('{}:{}'.format(col, contents[idx] if used else '<empty>'))
                            if used:
                                idx += 1
                        log('[UVH-NODEPREP] {} tier={} map {}'.format(branch_name, i, ', '.join(mapping)))
                    else:
                        log('[UVH-NODEPREP] WARN tier={} skill count != occupied slots'.format(i))
                except Exception as exc:
                    log('[UVH-NODEPREP] Tier {} error {}: {}'.format(i, type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:90]))
        # Compare a multi-rank native skill and a one-point skill to see which
        # minimum fields a separately created Deathtrap Overclock would need.
        samples = (
            ('multi-rank MorePep', 'GD_Tulip_Mechromancer_Skills.LittleBigTrouble.MorePep'),
            ('one-point ExplosiveClap', 'GD_Tulip_Mechromancer_Skills.BestFriendsForever.ExplosiveClap'),
        )
        for label, path in samples:
            obj, kind = _find_native(path, ('SkillDefinition', 'Object'))
            log('[UVH-NODEPREP] SAMPLE {} => {} (lookup kind {})'.format(label, _native_describe(obj), kind))
            if obj is None:
                continue
            try:
                keys = [k for k in dir(obj) if not k.startswith('_') and any(
                    needle in k.lower() for needle in (
                        'skill', 'icon', 'grade', 'effect', 'present', 'cost',
                        'point', 'description', 'name', 'dependency', 'unlock'))]
                log('[UVH-NODEPREP] SAMPLE {} fields={}'.format(label, ','.join(sorted(set(keys))[:90])))
            except Exception as exc:
                log('[UVH-NODEPREP] SAMPLE field listing failed {}'.format(type(exc).__name__))
            for attr in ('SkillName', 'SkillDescription', 'MaxGrade', 'DefaultStartingGrade',
                         'bSubjectToGradeRules', 'SkillIcon', 'SkillEffectDefinitions',
                         'SkillEffectPresentations', 'bCanBeDeactivated'):
                val = read(obj, attr)
                if val is None:
                    log('[UVH-NODEPREP] SAMPLE {}.{} = <not exposed>'.format(label,attr))
                else:
                    try:
                        length = len(val)
                        extra = ' length={}'.format(length)
                    except Exception:
                        extra = ''
                    log('[UVH-NODEPREP] SAMPLE {}.{} = {}{}'.format(
                        label,attr,_native_describe(val)[:170],extra))
        # Inspect, but NEVER invoke, object creation in this release.
        creator = getattr(unrealsdk, 'construct_object', None)
        log('[UVH-NODEPREP] SDK construct_object available={}'.format(callable(creator)))
        if callable(creator):
            try:
                import inspect
                log('[UVH-NODEPREP] SDK construct_object signature={}'.format(inspect.signature(creator)))
            except Exception as exc:
                log('[UVH-NODEPREP] SDK construct_object signature unavailable {}'.format(type(exc).__name__))
            log('[UVH-NODEPREP] SDK construct_object docs={}'.format(
                (getattr(creator, '__doc__', None) or '<none>')[:300].replace('\n', ' ')))
        log('[UVH-NODEPREP] FINISHED READ ONLY: no tree, layout, skills, points, or save mutated.')
    except Exception as exc:
        log('[UVH-NODEPREP] ERROR {}: {}'.format(type(exc).__name__,str(exc)[:160]))
    finally:
        log('[UVH-NODEPREP] END')



# v0.1.6: EXPERIMENTAL native skill node creation and branch insert.
# No save changes or point spending are performed by this mod.
# The new skill is intentionally inert until native UI/purchase handling is proven.
_uvh_node_state = None


def _node_first_tier():
    """Only use this exact verified Gaige branch and its unused middle column."""
    branch_path = 'GD_Tulip_Mechromancer_Skills.SkillTrees.Branch_LittleBigTrouble'
    layout_path = 'GD_Tulip_Mechromancer_Skills.SkillTrees.Layout_LittleBigTrouble'
    branch, _ = _find_native(branch_path, ('SkillTreeBranchDefinition', 'Object'))
    layout, _ = _find_native(layout_path, ('SkillTreeBranchLayoutDefinition', 'Object'))
    if branch is None or layout is None:
        log('[UVH-NEWNODE] Missing assets: branch={} layout={}'.format(
            _native_describe(branch), _native_describe(layout)))
        return None
    try:
        btier = branch.Tiers[0]
        ltier = layout.Tiers[0]
        originals = [x for x in btier.Skills]
        occupied = [bool(x) for x in ltier.bCellIsOccupied]
        if [name(x) for x in originals] != ['MorePep', 'Myelin'] or occupied != [True, False, True]:
            log('[UVH-NEWNODE] First tier is not in expected pristine state; no writes.')
            return None
        return branch, layout, btier, ltier, originals, occupied
    except Exception as exc:
        log('[UVH-NEWNODE] Cannot inspect first tier: {}: {}'.format(type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:110]))
        return None


def _node_has_exact_contents(btier, ltier, new):
    try:
        skills = [x for x in btier.Skills]
        flags = [bool(x) for x in ltier.bCellIsOccupied]
        return (len(skills) == 3 and
                name(skills[0]) == 'MorePep' and skills[1] == new and
                name(skills[2]) == 'Myelin' and flags == [True, True, True])
    except Exception:
        return False


def _node_set_array(owner, prop, values):
    """Try property array assignment; then element-level mutation if supported."""
    try:
        setattr(owner, prop, list(values))
        if list(getattr(owner, prop)) == list(values):
            return True, 'assign'
    except Exception as exc:
        log('[UVH-NEWNODE] {} assignment unsupported: {}: {}'.format(prop, type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:90]))
    arr = read(owner, prop)
    if arr is None:
        return False, 'missing'
    try:
        arr[:] = list(values)
        if list(read(owner, prop)) == list(values):
            return True, 'slice'
    except Exception as exc:
        log('[UVH-NEWNODE] {} slice unsupported: {}'.format(prop, type(exc).__name__))
    try:
        # Useful for WrappedArray implementations supporting clear/extend.
        arr.clear()
        arr.extend(list(values))
        if list(read(owner, prop)) == list(values):
            return True, 'clear+extend'
    except Exception as exc:
        log('[UVH-NEWNODE] {} list methods unsupported: {}'.format(prop, type(exc).__name__))
    return False, 'unsupported'


def _node_restore_snapshot(record):
    """Restore both native branch and layout arrays and verify the readback."""
    btier, ltier = record['btier'], record['ltier']
    old_skills, old_cells = record['skills'], record['cells']
    success_skills, how_skills = _node_set_array(btier, 'Skills', old_skills)
    success_cells, how_cells = _node_set_array(ltier, 'bCellIsOccupied', old_cells)
    try:
        observed = [name(x) for x in btier.Skills]
        flags = [bool(x) for x in ltier.bCellIsOccupied]
        success = (success_skills and success_cells and
                   observed == ['MorePep', 'Myelin'] and flags == [True, False, True])
    except Exception:
        success = False
        observed, flags = '<cannot read>', '<cannot read>'
    log('[UVH-NEWNODE] RESTORE result={} skills={} cells={} (methods {}, {})'.format(
        success, observed, flags, how_skills, how_cells))
    if not success:
        log('[UVH-NEWNODE] SAFETY: Exit BL2 WITHOUT SAVING and restart before playing.')
    return success


def _node_make_candidate(branch):
    import unrealsdk
    template, _ = _find_native(
        'GD_Tulip_Mechromancer_Skills.LittleBigTrouble.MorePep', ('SkillDefinition', 'Object'))
    if template is None:
        log('[UVH-NEWNODE] Existing MorePep template missing.')
        return None
    # Creating inside a known UObject guarantees a valid Unreal outer even if
    # this SDK version does not expose UObject.Outer. Does NOT overwrite template.
    outer = read(template, 'Outer') or branch
    for path in (
        'GD_Tulip_Mechromancer_Skills.SkillTrees.Branch_LittleBigTrouble.UVH_DeathtrapOverclock',
        'GD_Tulip_Mechromancer_Skills.LittleBigTrouble.UVH_DeathtrapOverclock',
    ):
        existing, _ = _find_native(path, ('Object',))
        if existing is not None:
            log('[UVH-NEWNODE] Candidate name already exists; restart before another test. No overwrite.')
            return None
    try:
        obj = unrealsdk.construct_object('SkillDefinition', outer, 'UVH_DeathtrapOverclock')
    except Exception as exc:
        log('[UVH-NEWNODE] construct_object FAILED {}: {}'.format(type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:170]))
        return None
    if (obj is None or name(read(obj, 'Class')) != 'SkillDefinition'
            or name(obj) != 'UVH_DeathtrapOverclock' or obj == template):
        log('[UVH-NEWNODE] Candidate construction did not return SkillDefinition.')
        return None
    # Never copy another active skill's gameplay effects or activation actions.
    for attr in ('SkillEffectDefinitions', 'SkillActivationActions', 'SkillDeactivationActions'):
        val = read(obj, attr)
        try:
            if val is None or len(val) != 0:
                log('[UVH-NEWNODE] ABORT: candidate {} is missing or nonempty'.format(attr))
                return None
        except Exception:
            log('[UVH-NEWNODE] ABORT: cannot verify empty {}'.format(attr))
            return None
    requested = (
        ('SkillName', 'Deathtrap Overclock'),
        ('SkillDescription', 'Prototype: Extends Deathtrap duration by 15 seconds. (Not active in this node test.)'),
        ('MaxGrade', 1),
        ('DefaultStartingGrade', 0),
        ('bSubjectToGradeRules', True),
    )
    for prop, val in requested:
        try:
            setattr(obj, prop, val)
            if read(obj, prop) != val:
                log('[UVH-NEWNODE] {} readback mismatch; abort.'.format(prop))
                return None
        except Exception as exc:
            log('[UVH-NEWNODE] {} write failed {}: {}'.format(prop, type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:95]))
            return None
    try:
        obj.SkillIcon = template.SkillIcon  # temporary built-in icon, not custom art
    except Exception as exc:
        log('[UVH-NEWNODE] Icon binding failed {}, continuing with no icon.'.format(type(exc).__name__))
    log('[UVH-NEWNODE] NEW SkillDefinition created: {} | max rank={} | effects=0'.format(
        _native_describe(obj), read(obj, 'MaxGrade')))
    return obj


def add_overclock_node(_option=None):
    global _uvh_node_state
    log('[UVH-NEWNODE] BEGIN v0.2.1 EARLY MENU node insertion (NO POINT SPENDING)')
    record = None
    try:
        if _init_armed or _init_hooks:
            log('[UVH-NEWNODE] NOT INSERTED: initialization experiment is armed; use its CANCEL button first.')
            return
        try:
            pc = get_pc(possibly_loading=True)
        except Exception:
            pc = None
        if pc is not None and read(pc, 'Pawn') is not None:
            log('[UVH-NEWNODE] NOT INSERTED: character already loaded. Return to the MAIN MENU and try there.')
            return
        log('[UVH-NEWNODE] Menu preflight: controller={} class={} pawn={}'.format(
            name(pc) or '<none>', name(read(pc, 'PlayerClass')) or '<none>',
            name(read(pc, 'Pawn')) or '<none>'))
        # The exact Gaige branch may not be in memory on the main menu.
        # Load its data package before accessing it, without changing saves.
        import unrealsdk
        try:
            pkg = unrealsdk.load_package('GD_Tulip_Mechromancer_Skills')
            log('[UVH-NEWNODE] load_package completed; returned {} (None is not necessarily failure)'.format(
                _tree_info(pkg)))
        except Exception as exc:
            log('[UVH-NEWNODE] load_package raised {}: {}'.format(type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:140]))
        if _uvh_node_state is not None:
            log('[UVH-NEWNODE] Already inserted this session; will not stack.')
            return
        objects = _node_first_tier()
        if objects is None:
            log('[UVH-NEWNODE] Gaige skill assets unavailable at main menu or unexpected layout; no changes made.')
            return
        branch, layout, btier, ltier, originals, occupied = objects
        new = _node_make_candidate(branch)
        if new is None:
            return
        record = dict(btier=btier, ltier=ltier, skills=originals, cells=occupied, node=new)
        wanted = [originals[0], new, originals[1]]
        s_ok, s_method = _node_set_array(btier, 'Skills', wanted)
        l_ok, l_method = _node_set_array(ltier, 'bCellIsOccupied', [True, True, True])
        # Confirm through a fresh native lookup too, not just the local struct proxy.
        re_branch, _ = _find_native(
            'GD_Tulip_Mechromancer_Skills.SkillTrees.Branch_LittleBigTrouble',
            ('SkillTreeBranchDefinition', 'Object'))
        re_layout, _ = _find_native(
            'GD_Tulip_Mechromancer_Skills.SkillTrees.Layout_LittleBigTrouble',
            ('SkillTreeBranchLayoutDefinition', 'Object'))
        observed_live = (re_branch is not None and re_layout is not None and
                         _node_has_exact_contents(re_branch.Tiers[0], re_layout.Tiers[0], new))
        if not s_ok or not l_ok or not _node_has_exact_contents(btier, ltier, new) or not observed_live:
            log('[UVH-NEWNODE] INSERT NOT VERIFIED: skills={}, layout={}; rolling back.'.format(s_ok, l_ok))
            _node_restore_snapshot(record)
            return
        _uvh_node_state = record
        log('[UVH-NEWNODE] INSERT VERIFIED: Tier0=[MorePep, DeathtrapOverclock, Myelin]')
        log('[UVH-NEWNODE] Layout.Tier0=[True, True, True] (methods {}, {})'.format(s_method,l_method))
        log('[UVH-NEWNODE] Visual test only! DO NOT BUY the new node. 15s bonus still via manual button.')
        log('[UVH-NEWNODE] Now load Gaige via CONTINUE (do not buy node); inspect Skills tab.')
    except Exception as exc:
        log('[UVH-NEWNODE] ERROR {}: {}'.format(type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:160]))
        if record is not None and _uvh_node_state is None:
            _node_restore_snapshot(record)
    finally:
        log('[UVH-NEWNODE] END')


def remove_overclock_node(_option=None):
    global _uvh_node_state
    log('[UVH-NEWNODE] BEGIN remove prototype node')
    try:
        if _uvh_node_state is None:
            log('[UVH-NEWNODE] Nothing added by this mod session.')
            return
        record = _uvh_node_state
        if 'init_tree' in record:
            cancel_init_node()
            return
        if not _node_has_exact_contents(record['btier'], record['ltier'], record['node']):
            log('[UVH-NEWNODE] Other modifications detected; will not overwrite them. Restart game.')
            return
        if _node_restore_snapshot(record):
            _uvh_node_state = None
            log('[UVH-NEWNODE] Prototype node removed; original tree restored.')
    except Exception as exc:
        log('[UVH-NEWNODE] Removal ERROR {}: {}'.format(type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:160]))
    finally:
        log('[UVH-NEWNODE] END remove')


def check_overclock_preload(_option=None):
    """Read-only comparison of the *current* native branch with the insertion snapshot."""
    log('[UVH-PRELOAD] BEGIN check current tree state (READ ONLY)')
    try:
        try:
            pc = get_pc(possibly_loading=True)
        except Exception:
            pc = None
        log('[UVH-PRELOAD] Controller={} class={} pawn={}'.format(
            name(pc) or '<none>', name(read(pc, 'PlayerClass')) or '<none>',
            name(read(pc, 'Pawn')) or '<none>'))
        branch, _ = _find_native(
            'GD_Tulip_Mechromancer_Skills.SkillTrees.Branch_LittleBigTrouble',
            ('SkillTreeBranchDefinition','Object'))
        layout, _ = _find_native(
            'GD_Tulip_Mechromancer_Skills.SkillTrees.Layout_LittleBigTrouble',
            ('SkillTreeBranchLayoutDefinition','Object'))
        if branch is None or layout is None:
            log('[UVH-PRELOAD] Branch/layout not loaded in current world; no writes.')
            return
        skills = list(branch.Tiers[0].Skills)
        cells = [bool(x) for x in layout.Tiers[0].bCellIsOccupied]
        log('[UVH-PRELOAD] CURRENT branch={} skills={} layout={}'.format(
            _native_describe(branch), [name(x) for x in skills], cells))
        if _uvh_node_state is not None:
            record = _uvh_node_state
            log('[UVH-PRELOAD] State saved: current branch is same object={} node still in current tree={}'.format(
                branch == record['btier'] or branch.Tiers[0] == record['btier'],
                len(skills) == 3 and skills[1] == record['node']))
        else:
            log('[UVH-PRELOAD] No node inserted by this mod session.')
        # Check the streaming tree too, but never attempt to edit it.
        try:
            obj, _ = _find_native(
                'GD_Tulip_Mechro_Streaming.SkillTree.SkillTree_Mechromancer',
                ('SkillTreeDefinition','Object'))
            log('[UVH-PRELOAD] Top-level streaming SkillTreeDefinition = {}'.format(_native_describe(obj)))
        except Exception as exc:
            log('[UVH-PRELOAD] Top-level inspection {}: {}'.format(type(exc).__name__,str(exc)[:100]))
    except Exception as exc:
        log('[UVH-PRELOAD] ERROR {}: {}'.format(type(exc).__name__,str(exc)[:160]))
    finally:
        log('[UVH-PRELOAD] END')

# v0.1.8 diagnostics never load packages, construct skills, call native gameplay
# functions, or write UObject/struct properties. SDK _path_name is a metadata API.
_DIAG_PATHS = (
```
